content_cn: 本发明涉及电力交易数据结算领域，具体为一种基于大数据的电力交易数据结算方法及系统；根据电力交易数据的特点，对第一基础数据中的异常数据进行筛选，选择出异常区域进行后续的进一步计算，通过基于区域和用户两个角度，建立用电量矩阵和用电变化矩阵，并通过关联矩阵进行关联，根据关联矩阵计算平均值矩阵和标准差矩阵，从而进一步构建判断矩阵来表示用户的用电量范围，通过构建评估矩阵，并计算异常阈值，从而能够根据评估矩阵中各用户的异常指数与异常阈值进行对比，以判断各用户在一定时间内是否存在异常；解决了目前在电力交易数据结算的过程中，采集的数据准确性难以保证，导致电力交易数据结算结果的准确性较差的问题。
content_en: The present invention relates to the field of electric power transaction data settlement, and specifically to a big-data-based electric power transaction data settlement method and system. According to characteristics of electric power transaction data, abnormal data in first basic data is screened, and abnormal regions are selected for subsequent further calculation. An electricity consumption matrix and an electricity consumption variation matrix are established from the two perspectives of regions and users and are correlated through an incident matrix. A mean matrix and a standard deviation matrix are calculated according to the incident matrix, thereby further constructing a determination matrix for representing an electricity consumption range of each user. By constructing an evaluation matrix and calculating an abnormality threshold, an abnormality index of each user in the evaluation matrix can be compared with the abnormality threshold to determine whether each user exhibits an abnormality within a certain period of time. The present invention solves the problem that, during current electric power transaction data settlement, the accuracy of collected data is difficult to ensure, resulting in poor accuracy of electric power transaction data settlement results.

content_en: The present invention discloses a system and method for implementing intelligent control of household appliances based on a femtocell base station. The system comprises a control terminal, a femtocell base station, an intelligent household appliance control gateway, and an intelligent household appliance execution device. The control terminal capable of accessing the femtocell base station transmits a control message comprising a control command for performing intelligent control of a household appliance. The indoor femtocell base station receives the control message and transmits a control packet to a corresponding intelligent household appliance control gateway. The intelligent household appliance control gateway receives the control packet transmitted by the femtocell base station and, according to execution information contained therein, converts the control packet into execution information for a household appliance control network. The intelligent household appliance execution device performs a corresponding control operation. The present invention enables a femtocell base station purchased for a home to be used to control intelligent household appliances in the home.

content_cn: 为了获得的μc和Σc的最大后验概率估计，必须指定这些参数的先验分布。其中，目标与虚拟键盘上的按键相关，基于键盘布局可凭经验设置先验分布（均值和协方差），该先验分布的适当选择为正态逆维舍特分布（normal inverse Wishart distribution,NIWD），因为正态逆维舍特分布是带有未知均值和协方差的高斯分布的共轭先验分布。此外，还可使用其他先验分布。在下文中将讨论一些其他的先验分布。共轭先验分布的定义为：如果先验分布与似然函数共轭，则后验分布与（可能带有不同参数的）该先验分布具有相同的分布形式。共轭分布（先验及后验分布）的参数则被称为超参数（因为这些参数使模型实际参数的分布参数化），而最大后验概率的学习可被制定成较为简单的超参数重算。
content_en: To obtain maximum a posteriori estimates of μc and Σc, prior distributions of these parameters must be specified. The targets are associated with keys on a virtual keyboard, and the prior distributions (mean and covariance) may be empirically set based on the keyboard layout. An appropriate choice for the prior distributions is the normal inverse Wishart distribution (NIWD), because the normal inverse Wishart distribution is a conjugate prior distribution for a Gaussian distribution having an unknown mean and covariance. Other prior distributions may also be used. Some other prior distributions will be discussed below. A conjugate prior distribution is defined as follows: if a prior distribution is conjugate to a likelihood function, the posterior distribution has the same distributional form as the prior distribution, possibly with different parameters. The parameters of the conjugate distributions (the prior and posterior distributions) are referred to as hyperparameters because these parameters parameterize the distributions of the actual parameters of the model, and maximum a posteriori learning may be formulated as relatively simple hyperparameter recalculation.

content_en: The present invention relates to the technical field of seismic event detection and provides a seismic event detection method based on a combination of CDIL-CNN and a convolutional attention mechanism. The method comprises: using a three-component seismic dataset to construct a network model, wherein the network model comprises convolution combination modules, an information fusion module, a convolutional attention module, a flattening layer, a first fully connected layer, a third activation layer, a random neuron dropout layer, a second fully connected layer, and a fourth activation layer. Three convolution combination modules are provided, and circular dilated convolution modules are used to perform dilated convolution operations to extract features from the three components of seismic data, respectively. The information fusion module performs a weighted average calculation on outputs of the convolution combination modules according to a minimum mean square error function to obtain a preliminary detection result. The convolutional attention module performs weight adjustment. After network training, the present invention can efficiently and accurately complete seismic event detection without manual annotation or adjustment of parameters and thresholds.

content_en: In the case of TCP, the amount of data that can be transmitted at one time varies according to network conditions or buffer conditions at a receiving side and is determined immediately before transmission. Therefore, at a transmitting side, after determining the size of a packet to be transmitted next, packet data is read and a check sum is calculated. Subsequently, the check sum is stored in a header of the packet, and after header information is transmitted, the data is read again and transmitted.

content_cn: 尽管阻塞问题是树结构范式不可避免的结果，但是已经在该范式内开发了各种解决方案以减少该问题的影响。一种技术是通过在网络中的高流量节点之间加入额外的链路来向网络中建立冗余。参考图8，这可能意味着在核心层网络设备I和聚合层网络设备Ⅱ和Ⅲ之间加入额外的链路。以太信道和分裂的以太信道等是实现这种方法的示例。或者，可以用更高的带宽链路取代标准带宽电路来替换添加更多的链路，但是效果是基本相同的，虽然链路故障的后果会比具有冗余链路更严峻。针对链路故障，在参考图8时应该注意的是尽管冗余链路是在核心和聚合层之间被采用，但是在该简单示例中每4个链路中有1个链路故障会通过因子2减少网络的对分带宽(“对分带宽”会在下文详细讨论)。因此，显然具有内建的冗余，树结构网络仍具有固有限制，当然，存在与实施基于硬件的冗余相关联的成本。
content_en: Although the blocking problem is an unavoidable consequence of the tree-structure paradigm, various solutions have been developed within this paradigm to reduce the impact of the problem. One technique is to build redundancy into the network by adding additional links between high-traffic nodes in the network. Referring to FIG. 8, this may involve adding additional links between core-layer network device I and aggregation-layer network devices II and III. EtherChannel and split EtherChannel are examples of implementations of this approach. Alternatively, rather than adding more links, standard-bandwidth circuits may be replaced with higher-bandwidth links, with substantially the same effect, although the consequences of a link failure would be more severe than in an arrangement having redundant links. With respect to link failure, it should be noted with reference to FIG. 8 that, although redundant links are employed between the core layer and the aggregation layer, in this simple example, failure of one out of every four links reduces the bisection width of the network by a factor of two (the “bisection width” is discussed in detail below). Thus, it is apparent that, even with built-in redundancy, tree-structured networks still have inherent limitations, and costs are, of course, associated with implementing hardware-based redundancy.

According to the law of reflection of light, reflected light and incident light are symmetrically distributed on opposite sides of the surface normal. For a purely specular surface, light incident on a surface element is reflected unidirectionally in strict accordance with the law of reflection of light, with the angle of reflection being equal to the angle of incidence.

content_en: Driven by current market demand, there is an urgent need for an efficient automated processing process to replace these cumbersome manual operations. By introducing advanced automation technology, production efficiency can be significantly improved, labor costs can be reduced, and product consistency and precision can be enhanced. Accordingly, the present invention aims to provide a full-process automated manufacturing production line for square plates of pipe piles and a production method thereof. A shearing machine, a punching machine, a spinning machine, an edge milling machine, an attack angle machine, and other equipment are continuously and cooperatively operated under programmable logic controller (PLC) control by using technologies such as robotic arms, trusses, and intelligent tracks, thereby achieving full-process automation including automatic plate shearing, automatic punching, automatic spinning, automatic edge milling, and automatic attack angle.

content_en: The absorption refrigeration system comprises a steam generator III, a rectifier, a condenser II, a throttling valve, a regenerator II, an evaporator, and an absorber. Liquid discharged from the absorber is delivered by a pump sequentially to the regenerator II for heat exchange and to the steam generator III for heating, thereby generating saturated vapor. The saturated vapor enters a rectification column for rectification to obtain a dilute saturated solution. A dilute solution discharged from the bottom of the steam generator III sequentially undergoes heat exchange in the regenerator II and throttling by the throttling valve, and then enters the absorber. High-purity vapor from an outlet of the rectifier enters the condenser II and is condensed into a saturated solution, and the saturated solution is throttled by the throttling valve and then enters the evaporator. Vapor from an outlet of the evaporator enters the absorber.

content_en: The present disclosure relates to a fuel system, a control method for the fuel system, and a vehicle, comprising: a power supply, a fuel pump, a first switch, a second switch, a voltage-dividing resistor, and an electronic control unit. The fuel pump, the first switch, and the power supply are sequentially connected to form a first circuit. The fuel pump, the voltage-dividing resistor, the second switch, and the power supply are sequentially connected to form a second circuit. Power supplied to the fuel pump by the first circuit is greater than power supplied to the fuel pump by the second circuit. The electronic control unit is configured to identify an operating condition of an engine and provide an idle signal or a non-idle signal to the first switch and the second switch. In response to the idle signal, the first switch switches to an open state, and the second switch switches to a closed state. In response to the non-idle signal, the first switch switches to the closed state, and the second switch switches to the open state. The solution of the present disclosure can reduce idle noise.

content_en: The utility model discloses a gate valve having a residue-cleaning structure, comprising a valve cage. The valve cage is internally and slidably connected to a valve plate. An arcuate sliding groove is formed inside the valve cage, and a residue-cleaning brush is slidably connected inside the arcuate sliding groove and is cooperatively mounted with the valve plate. A guide post is disposed inside the arcuate sliding groove, and a longitudinally movable seat is mounted on the guide post. Uniformly distributed synchronizing rods are disposed on an upper side of the longitudinally movable seat, and a rotating ball is disposed at an upper end of each synchronizing rod. Uniformly distributed greater-than-semicircular grooves are formed in an outer arcuate surface of the residue-cleaning brush, and each rotating ball is rotatably connected to an adjacent greater-than-semicircular groove. content_en: The present invention belongs to the technical field of auxiliary equipment for automobile manufacturing, and particularly relates to a molding sand treatment device for processing automobile parts. The device of the present invention mainly comprises a crushing box, a crushing assembly, and a separation box. A sand mold enters a crushing chamber of the crushing box through a material guide opening by means of a circulating feed belt. A hydraulic push rod in the crushing assembly operates to drive crushing rods downward via a mounting base, thereby crushing the sand mold. During crushing, the crushing rods are capable of adaptively retracting, thereby avoiding damage caused by excessive pressure. Crushed sand lumps enter the separation box and are rolled into fine sand by a pair of rolling rollers. The fine sand is spread flat by a circulating discharge belt, and metal particles mixed in the molding sand are then effectively adsorbed by a circulating metal adsorption belt. An active material-turning roller is additionally disposed between horizontal sections of the circulating discharge belt and the circulating metal adsorption belt, thereby ensuring that the metal particles are fully adsorbed. A scraping box provided with a scraping plate is mounted below an inclined lifting section of the circulating metal adsorption belt, thereby facilitating collection of the metal particles.

content_en: The present invention discloses a hemostatic material and a preparation method thereof. The hemostatic material comprises shellac and gelatin. The gelatin is added to a shellac solution, uniformly mixed, and then freeze-dried to obtain the hemostatic material. The hemostatic material of the present invention has strong hemostatic capability and, compared with medical gauze and commercial gelatin sponges, significantly reduces hemostasis time and blood loss. The hemostatic material has a high water absorption rate and a high water absorption speed, and can rapidly expand after absorbing water to quickly block a wound. Upon contact with the wound, the hemostatic material can rapidly absorb liquid, accelerate aggregation of platelets and posterior cells, and rapidly achieve hemostasis. The hemostatic material also has good shape-memory properties, can rapidly absorb blood, quickly return to an original state, and block irregular and deep wounds, and exhibits good hemostatic performance and biocompatibility. Furthermore, the hemostatic material has good antibacterial performance and coagulation performance, and has application prospects in biomedical applications such as wound coagulation and hemostasis and tissue repair.

A Cr8 material is used for a working layer, namely an outer layer, of the centrifugally composite-cast backup roll, and graphitic steel is used for a core and an intermediate layer. The working layer, the intermediate layer, and the outer layer are sequentially formed under specified temperature conditions, thereby enhancing the diffusion and penetration of Cr and inducing changes in the microstructures and properties of the cast-steel materials of the intermediate layer and the core. Furthermore, graphitic steel is used as the material of the intermediate layer and the core, and a steel-to-steel interface is bonded. Through adaptation of the process, the backup roll is provided with favorable mechanical properties.

content_cn: 所有盘面上的同一直径的磁道被看成一个整体，就像圆柱体的外表面一样，称为柱面。
content_en: All tracks having the same diameter on the disk surfaces are regarded as a whole, analogous to the outer surface of a cylindrical body, and are referred to as a cylinder.

content_cn: 网元集为有限集的网。特殊网理论中讨论的网（佩特里网的基网）都是有限网。
content_en: A net having a finite set of net elements. The nets discussed in special net theory, namely the underlying nets of Petri nets, are each a finite net.

content_cn: 中央处理器（CPU）与内存之间的第二级高速缓存，它的速度比第一级高速缓存慢，但容量比第一级高速缓存大。
content_en: A second level cache disposed between a central processing unit (CPU) and a memory, having a lower speed but a larger capacity than a first-level cache.

content_cn: 得到图像中物体对象轮廓的方法。
content_en: A method for obtaining contouring of an object in an image.

content_cn: 若对固定的ε>0和问题的一个输入规模为 n 的实例，用近似格式表示的算法是多项式时间算法，则称为多项式时间近似格式。
content_en: If, for a fixed ε > 0 and an instance of the problem having an input size n, an algorithm represented by an approximation scheme is a polynomial-time algorithm, the approximation scheme is referred to as a polynomial-time approximation scheme.

content_cn: 图灵机读写带上的一种专门字符，通常用B表示。当读写带上的某个格没有写上实质性（输入、输出、边界）字符时，就说该格存放着空白符B。
content_en: A special character on a read-write tape of a Turing machine, usually represented by B. When no substantive character, namely an input, output, or boundary character, is written in a cell on the read-write tape, the cell is said to store a blank B.

content_cn: 对于给定的数据，在候选假设集中选取具有最大后验概率的假设。
content_en: For given data, a hypothesis having a maximum a posteriori probability is selected from a set of candidate hypotheses.

content_cn: 供图灵机读写使用的带子。通常一个带是双向无穷的，它被分成一些格子，每个格子可以存放一个符号。
content_en: A tape for reading and writing by a Turing machine. Generally, a tape is infinite in both directions and is divided into cells, each of which can store one symbol.

content_cn: 一个 n 元布尔函数指从(2)到GF(2)上的一个映射，这里GF(2)是二元域。
content_en: An n-variable Boolean function is a mapping from (2) to GF(2), where GF(2) is the binary field.

content_cn: 泛指企业信息系统的开发与应用，常见于詹姆斯·马丁（James Martin）的著作中。
content_en: Generally refers to the development and application of enterprise information systems, and is commonly found in the works of James Martin.

content_cn: 由角谷良彦（Yoshihiko Kakutani）提出，不采用厄米（Hermite）矩阵作为量子谓词，而是把邓哈托（Den Hartog）的概率霍尔逻辑扩充为概率量子霍尔逻辑。这个逻辑称为QHL，是针对塞林格（Selinger）的QPL语言设计的。其中所有的概率状态被替换成混合量子态，而在逻辑公式中则加进了酉变换。需要获取信息时只能通过测量获取它的经典值。
content_en: Yoshihiko Kakutani proposed probabilistic quantum Hoare logic by extending Den Hartog's probabilistic Hoare logic, rather than using Hermite matrices as quantum predicates. QHL is designed for Selinger's QPL language. All probabilistic states therein are replaced with mixed quantum states, and unitary transformations are incorporated into the logical formulas. When information is required, the corresponding classical value can be obtained only through measurement.

content_cn: 统计自然语言处理中常用的一类统计机器学习模型，对随机生成观察数据的过程进行建模。一般包含隐变量，形式上是观察变量和隐藏变量的联合概率分布，典型的生成模型包括隐马尔可夫模型、概率上下文无关模型等。
content_en: A class of statistical machine learning models commonly used in statistical natural language processing models the process of randomly generating observed data. Such models generally include latent variables and are formally represented by a joint probability distribution of observed variables and latent variables. Typical examples of a generative model include a hidden Markov model and a probabilistic context-free model.

content_cn: 对于有些问题，不存在一个有界的近似算法，则称该问题具有不可近似性。
content_en: For certain problems, no bounded approximation algorithm exists, and such a problem is therefore said to exhibit inapproximability.

content_cn: 连接两个使用不同网络体系结构和协议的计算机网络的功能单元。例如LAN 网关、邮件网关。
content_en: A functional unit configured to connect two computer networks that use different network architectures and protocols, for example, a LAN gateway or a mail gateway.

content_cn: 考虑负载在回路中的实际分布位置、连线不是理想导体等因素的一种负载模型。分布负载的电路行为可由麦克斯韦方程组描述。
content_en: A load model that takes into account factors such as the actual distribution positions of loads in a circuit and interconnections not being ideal conductors. The circuit behavior of a distributed load may be described by Maxwell's equations.

content_cn: 由一系列原子事务组成的长事务。原子事务可以按序执行和提交，长篇事务具有语义原子性。
content_en: A long transaction composed of a series of atomic transactions. The atomic transactions may be sequentially executed and committed, and sagas have semantic atomicity.

content_cn: 采用因特网技术建立的企业内部网络。其核心技术是基于万维网的计算。
content_en: An intranet established using Internet technology. The core technology is World Wide Web-based computing.

content_cn: 以磁性元件作为控制和调整环节的供电设备。一般磁放大器电源以快速磁放大器作为电压补偿元件，以晶体管直流放大器作为误差检测和信号放大元件来构成负反馈有差调整系统。磁放大器稳压电源的优点是可靠性高，体积小，不会发生振荡。
content_en: A power supply apparatus employing a magnetic element as a control and regulation stage. Generally, the magnetic amplifier power supply employs a high-speed magnetic amplifier as a voltage compensation element and a transistor DC amplifier as an error detection and signal amplification element, thereby forming a negative-feedback, non-zero-error regulation system. The magnetic-amplifier regulated power source has the advantages of high reliability, small size, and freedom from oscillation.

content_cn: 一种语言知识描述方式，由有限个“特征-值”对组成，特征值可以是不可分解的原子值，也可以是另外的复杂特征集。
content_en: A language knowledge representation method comprising a finite number of “feature-value” pairs, wherein a feature value may be an indivisible atomic value or another complex feature set.

content_cn: 如果控制系统模型参数或干扰是不确定的，称相应的控制系统为不确定性控制系统。
content_en: If model parameters or disturbances of a control system are uncertain, the corresponding control system is referred to as a non-deterministic control system.

content_cn: 一种面向自然语言话语（语篇）处理的形式化系统，通过动态的处理策略建立代表话语意义的话语表示结构。话语表示结构形式上由有限个话语指示（discourse referent）及条件（condition）组成。按照话语表示理论，话语分析和解释可被视作是一个逐句分析并动态更新话语表示结构的过程。
content_en: A formal system for processing natural-language discourse (text), which establishes a discourse representation structure representing the meaning of the discourse through a dynamic processing strategy. Formally, the discourse representation structure consists of a finite number of discourse referents and conditions. According to discourse representation theory, discourse analysis and interpretation may be regarded as a process of sentence-by-sentence analysis and dynamic updating of the discourse representation structure.

content_cn: 一个复杂性类。在的定义中交换全称量词和存在量词就给出了类。
content_en: A complexity class. Interchanging the universal quantifier and the existential quantifier in the definition of yields the class.

content_cn: （1）当一台计算机A仿真另一台计算机B时，称A机为宿主机。（2）用于开发在另一台计算机上运行的软件的计算机。
content_en: (1) When a computer A emulates another computer B, computer A is referred to as a host machine. (2) A computer used to develop software that runs on another computer.

content_cn: 以B样条基函数为加权系数对控制顶点进行线性组合构造样条的方式。
content_en: A method for constructing a spline by linearly combining control vertices using B-spline basis functions as weighting coefficients.

content_cn: 存放在只读存储器中的有序指令和数据集合。固件在一定条件下可以改动。
content_en: An ordered collection of instructions and data stored in a read-only memory. The firmware may be modified under certain conditions.

content_cn: 由金属-氧化物-半导体场效应管构成的存储器。主要分为动态金属氧化物半导体存储器和静态金属氧化物半导体存储器。
content_en: A memory comprising metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors. The memory is mainly classified into dynamic metal-oxide-semiconductor memory and static metal-oxide-semiconductor memory.
special_cn: 金属氧化物半导体存储器

content_cn: 唯一标识操作系统内核对象并保存其属性的专用数据结构。用于管理控制该内核对象，如进程控制块、文件控制块等。
content_en: A dedicated data structure that uniquely identifies an operating system kernel object and stores attributes of the operating system kernel object. The dedicated data structure is used to manage and control the operating system kernel object, such as a process control block, a file control block, and the like.

content_cn: 给定集合 A ，如果它既有形式，又有形式，则称 A 有形式。
content_en: Given a set A, if A has both the form and the form, then A is said to have the -form.

content_cn: 不存在图灵机接受的语言为非递归可枚举语言。
content_en: There does not exist a Turing machine that accepts a non-r.e. langu-age.

content_cn: 主要功能是获取真实空间中实际物体的形状信息，将其数字化后直接输入计算机，并通过配套的软件将此数字信息组织和整理后转换成计算机三维实体造型的通用格式文件。三维数字化仪主要用于计算机仿真设计。
content_en: The primary function is to acquire shape information of an actual object in real space, digitize the shape information, directly input the digitized shape information into a computer, and organize and process the digitized shape information by means of supporting software to convert the digitized shape information into a file in a general-purpose format for computer-based three-dimensional solid modeling. The three-dimensional digitizer is primarily used for computer simulation design.

content_cn: 一个算法的最坏情况时间复杂性，是指对每一个整数 n ，耗时最多的长为 n 的输入所用的时间。
content_en: The worst-case time complexity of an algorithm refers to, for each integer n, the time required by the most time-consuming input having a length of n.

content_cn: 域上的一个代数线路是一个有向无圈图，输入节点标记为，取值于某数域，有两个特殊节点：1或0（域元素）。每一个内部节点称为一个门，标记为一个算术运算，加（+）或乘（×），每一个门的入度为2，有一个输出节点。
content_en: An algebraic circuit over a field is a directed acyclic graph, wherein input nodes are labeled as and take values in a number field. The graph has two special nodes labeled 1 and 0, respectively, which are field elements. Each internal node is referred to as a gate and is labeled with an arithmetic operation, namely addition (+) or multiplication (×). Each gate has an indegree of 2, and the graph has one output node.

content_cn: 软件中关于真实世界业务处理部分的描述。包括数据如何创建、存储、修改、表示等业务规则细节。软件中除了包括业务逻辑，通常还包括各种系统服务、人机接口等业务无关部分。
content_en: A description, in software, of a portion relating to real-world business processing, including details of business rules concerning how data is created, stored, modified, represented, and the like. In addition to business logic, the software generally further includes business-independent portions such as various system services and human-machine interfaces.

content_cn: 在佩特里网Σ= ( S,T;F,)中，T 的元素称为变迁。
content_en: In the Petri net Σ = (S, T; F, ), each element of T is referred to as a transition.

content_cn: 使用体系结构建模符号建立软件体系结构模型的过程。
content_en: A process of establishing a software architecture model using architecture modeling notation.

content_cn: 在条件/事件系统中，假定一个事件既可向前发生（即按佩特里网原义发生），也可向后发生。向前可达性即按佩特里网原义的可达性。
content_en: In a condition/event system, it is assumed that an event can occur both forward (i.e., in the original sense of a Petri net) and backward; forward reachability means reachability in the original sense of a Petri net.

content_cn: 在给定一组事务的较多事务中出现的项集称为频繁项集。
content_en: Itemsets appearing in a relatively large number of transactions within a given set of transactions are referred to as frequent itemsets.

content_cn: 问题求解所需的信息的总和。其中信息是经过整理的、结构化的。知识具有产生或者有助于产生新信息的能力。
content_en: The totality of information required for problem solving, wherein the information is organized and structured. The knowledge is capable of generating or facilitating the generation of new information.

content_cn: 受控加标图中的受控变迁称为受控事件。
content_en: A controlled transition in a controlled marked graph is referred to as a controlled event.

content_cn: 一种使用双手的三维交互。基于人类的支配手和非支配手之间工作的分配控制机制，可分为对称双手三维交互和非对称双手三维交互。前者指两只手执行同一行为（包括同步的和异步的），后者又称协同操作，指两只手的动作虽然不同但紧密配合以完成相同任务。与虚拟手技术类似，双手交互允许用户将其日常操作经验和技能直接应用于虚拟环境中，从而有效降低用户在使用虚拟环境时的认知负荷。
content_en: A three-dimensional interaction method using both hands. Based on a control mechanism for allocating operations between the dominant hand and the non-dominant hand of a human, the method may be classified into symmetric bimanual three-dimensional interaction and asymmetric bimanual three-dimensional interaction. The former refers to the two hands performing the same action, either synchronously or asynchronously, while the latter, also referred to as coordinated operation, refers to the two hands performing different but closely coordinated actions to complete the same task. Similar to virtual hand technology, two-hand interaction allows a user to directly apply everyday operational experience and skills in a virtual environment, thereby effectively reducing the cognitive load on the user when using the virtual environment.

content_cn: 相对万维网1.0版的新的一类互联网应用的统称。万维网1.0版的主要特点在于用户通过浏览器获取信息。万维网2.0版则更注重用户的交互作用，用户既是网站内容的浏览者，也是网站内容的制造者。代表性的网站包括推特、脸书、维基百科和YouTube等。
content_en: A collective term for a new category of Internet applications relative to Web 1.0. A main characteristic of Web 1.0 is that users obtain information through browsers. Web 2.0 places greater emphasis on user interaction, whereby users are both viewers and creators of website content. Representative websites include Twitter, Facebook, Wikipedia, and YouTube.

content_cn: 从一个发送方实时地传送给一个或多个接收方的文本报文。一些即时报文服务也允许传送图像或声音文件等作为对文本报文的补充。
content_en: A text message is transmitted in real time from a sender to one or more recipients. Some instant message services also permit transmission of image files, audio files, or the like as supplements to the text message.

content_cn: 一种封锁类型。持有数据的排他型锁的事务可以读取和更新该数据，运行时只允许一个事务持有同一数据的排他型锁。
content_en: A lock type. A transaction holding an exclusive lock on data can read and update the data, and at runtime only one transaction is permitted to hold an exclusive lock on the same data.

content_cn: 一类多体复合系统的量子态。其密度算符不能由子系统密度算符直积的概率组合表示。例如，一个含有两子系统的体系如果不能表示为：，则其量子态称为两体系纠缠态。
content_en: A quantum state of a many-body composite system. The density operator thereof cannot be represented as a probabilistic combination of direct products of subsystem density operators. For example, if a system comprising two subsystems cannot be represented as , the quantum state thereof is referred to as a two-system entangled state.

content_cn: 语言的同态运算的反向操作：设 h :Σ→是一个同态，，则逆同态为：( L )={ w ∈∑｜ h(w)∈L }。
content_en: The reverse operation of a homomorphic operation on a language is defined as follows: let h: Σ→ be a homomorphism, , and the inverse homomorphism is: (L) = {w ∈ ∑ | h(w) ∈ L}.

content_cn: 当系统的执行器、传感器或元部件发生故障时，闭环控制系统仍然是稳定的，并具有较理想的特性，称这样的控制为容错控制。
content_en: When an actuator, a sensor, or a component of a system fails, a closed-loop control system remains stable and exhibits desired characteristics; such control is referred to as fault-tolerant control.

content_cn: 具有特定的功能，用来完成特定任务的一组软件。可分为应用软件包和系统软件包两大类。
content_en: A set of software having specific functions and configured to perform a specific task. The software may be classified into two major categories: an application software package and a system software package.

content_cn: 在构造中，一个策略可能被无穷次损害，在这种情况下怎样为一个需求设计一个策略使其最终能满足需求，解决这一问题的方法就是一个无穷损害优先方法。
content_en: During construction, a strategy may be injured infinitely many times. In such a case, a method for designing a strategy for a requirement such that the strategy can ultimately satisfy the requirement is an infinite injury priority method.

content_cn: 一种由传感器、遥控操作器和自动控制器等机构组成的具有移动功能的机器人系统。能代替人在危险或恶劣环境下进行作业，比一般机器人有更大的机动性和灵活性。分为地面、空中、水面和水下移动机器人，其移动机构有轮式、履带式、足式、混合式、特殊式等类型。
content_en: A robot system having a movement function and comprising mechanisms such as a sensor, a remote-control operator, and an automatic controller. The robot system is capable of performing operations in place of a human in dangerous or harsh environments and has greater maneuverability and flexibility than a conventional robot. The mobile robot is classified into ground, aerial, water-surface, and underwater categories, and movement mechanisms thereof include wheeled, tracked, legged, hybrid, and special types.

content_cn: 交易双方为了某种货物或者业务，通过移动设备进行商业交易。移动支付所使用的移动终端可以是手机、掌上电脑、笔记本电脑等。
content_en: Two transaction parties conduct a commercial transaction for goods or services through mobile devices. A mobile terminal used for mobile payment may be a mobile phone, a personal digital assistant, a notebook computer, or the like.

content_cn: 分组密码用于构造序列密码的一种工作模式。以分组密码输出的密文中的一部分作为密钥，按序列密码方式加密明文，又将序列加密的密文反馈作用到分组密码的输入。如此继续，实现用分组密码构造序列密码。
content_en: A mode of operation for constructing a stream cipher using a block cipher is provided. A portion of ciphertext output by the block cipher is used as a key to encrypt plaintext in a stream-cipher manner, and cipher feedback generated through stream encryption is applied to an input of the block cipher. By repeating this process, the stream cipher is constructed using the block cipher.

content_cn: 一种为匹配不同传输速率的数据而设置的存储区。可作为两种不同速度的存储器或两种计算机部件之间的同步装置，分为输入缓冲器和输出缓冲器。
content_en: A storage area configured to accommodate data having different transmission rates. The storage area may serve as a synchronization device between memories operating at two different speeds or between two computer components, and may be classified into an input buffer and an output buffer.

content_cn: 单独封装的基本电子元件。如电阻、电容、电感、晶体管等。分立元件的概念是与集成电路相对的。
content_en: A basic electronic element packaged individually, such as a resistor, a capacitor, an inductor, or a transistor. The concept of a discrete component is distinguished from that of an integrated circuit.

content_cn: 两个公式之间的逻辑关系，如果满足其中一个公式的任意解释都满足另一个公式，则称前者蕴涵后者。
content_en: For a logical relationship between two formulas, if every interpretation satisfying one formula also satisfies the other formula, the former formula is said to have an implication with respect to the latter formula.

content_cn: 电子交易的当事人，包括消费者、厂商和金融机构，使用安全电子支付手段，通过网络进行的货币支付或资金流转。
content_en: Parties to an electronic transaction, including consumers, manufacturers, and financial institutions, conduct monetary payment or fund transfer over a network using secure electronic payment means.

content_cn: 利用光电记录原理将信息记录在光学可读的介质上以存储信息的装置和设备。常见的光存储器有CD-ROM，DVD，BD等。
content_en: Devices and equipment configured to store information by recording the information on an optically readable medium according to a photoelectric recording principle. Common types of optical memory include CD-ROM, DVD, BD, and the like.

content_cn: 一种归结策略。如果归结过程中，每次做归结的两个子句中，都有一个是单元（只含一个文字的）子句或单元因子，这种归结的形式称为单元归结。
content_en: A resolution strategy. If, during a resolution process, one of two clauses subjected to resolution each time is a unit clause containing only one literal or a unit factor, this form of resolution is referred to as unit resolution.

content_cn: 给定分布 D ，如果存在一个确定型多项式时间图灵机来计算：对任意 x ，如下定义的累积概率，，那么称 D 是一个多项式时间可计算分布。
content_en: Given a distribution D, if there exists a deterministic polynomial-time Turing machine for calculating, for any x, the cumulative probability defined as follows: , then D is referred to as a polynomial time computable distribution.
special_cn: 多项式时间可计算分布

content_cn: （1）系统或其他事物及过程的抽象表示。（2）元模型体系结构中的一个层次，是元模型的一个实例。
content_en: (1) An abstract representation of a system or other thing or process. (2) A level in a meta-model architecture, which is an instance of a meta-model.

content_cn: 在基本网系统 (B,E;F,)中，c是一个情态，若存在b∈B和e∈E使得且，就说这个系统中，在情态c下，条件b 处存在冲撞（或接触）。
content_en: In a basic net system (B,E;F,), c is a mode. If there exist b∈B and e∈E such that and , it is said that, in this system, under mode c, contact (or touching) exists at condition b.

content_cn: 一个程序段或一个数据块中所有字节的算术和。在数据存储或传输之前，计算其检验和；在数据取出或到达目的地之后，通过再次计算检验和以检测是否正确。
content_en: The arithmetic sum of all bytes in a program segment or a data block. Before the data is stored or transmitted, the check sum thereof is calculated; after the data is retrieved or reaches a destination, the check sum is calculated again to detect whether the data is correct.

content_cn: 用计算机对被控参数进行检测，再根据设定值和控制算法进行运算，然后输出到执行机构进行控制，使被控参数稳定在给定值上。由于计算机的输出直接作用于控制对象，故称直接数字控制。
content_en: A computer detects a controlled parameter, performs calculations according to a set value and a control algorithm, and then provides an output to an actuator for control, thereby stabilizing the controlled parameter at a specified value. Because the output of the computer directly acts on a controlled object, this control method is referred to as DDC.

content_cn: 文法中异于变量（非终极符）的另一种字符。文法推导的目标就是要推导出全部由终极符组成的串，即句子。只能在语法规则右部出现的符号。是构成句子的最小单位。
content_en: A type of symbol in a grammar that is distinct from a variable (a symbol other than a terminal). The objective of grammatical derivation is to derive a string composed entirely of terminal symbols, namely, a sentence. A symbol permitted to appear only on the right-hand side of a grammar rule. The smallest unit constituting a sentence.

content_cn: 设 G 为一个上下文无关文法，在 G 的一个产生式 A→β的右边串β前面、后面或任意两个字符之间加上一个小圆点，称为G 的一个项（LR项）。
content_en: Let G be a context-free grammar. A small dot is placed before, after, or between any two symbols of the right-hand string β of a production A→β of G, thereby forming an item (LR-item) of G.

content_cn: 使得分离镜像的内容和产生该镜像的存储设备的内容保持一致的过程。如果采用快速镜像再同步，则只需要复制自上次分离之后原始内容被修改的数据。
content_en: A process for maintaining consistency between the content of a split mirror and the content of the storage device from which the mirror was generated. If fast mirror resynchronization is employed, only data in the original content that has been modified since the last split needs to be copied.

content_cn: 网络管理者的辅助功能单元。驻留在包含网络管理者的计算机系统中，并且被网络管理者所控制；数据库管理系统可以被用作网络助手。
content_en: An auxiliary functional unit of a network manager, residing in a computer system comprising the network manager and controlled by the network manager. A database management system may be used as the network assistant.

content_cn: 数据库的工作版本（部分或整个数据库）常驻内存的数据库。不能存储在当前内存中的数据仍然需要使用外存来进行存储，因此内存数据库仍然可能存在着输入和输出。内存数据库中的活动事务通常只与实时内存中的数据打交道。基于数据存储介质的变化，内存数据库在数据的存储组织与存取方法、事务处理、并发控制、故障恢复等方面也进行了相应的改进和优化，数据处理速度比传统数据库要快很多。
content_en: A database in which the working version of the database, including part or all of the database, resides permanently in memory. Data that cannot be stored in the currently available memory still needs to be stored in external storage; therefore, a main memory database may still involve input and output. Active transactions in a main memory database generally interact only with data in real-time memory. In view of changes in data storage media, a main memory database is correspondingly improved and optimized in terms of data storage organization and access methods, transaction processing, concurrency control, failure recovery, and other aspects, thereby providing a data processing speed much higher than that of a conventional database.

content_cn: 可被程序调用的相对独立的一个程序模块。通常用于实现程序的部分功能或某个特定功能，可以接受调用方传递的参数，并作为函数值返回调用结果。
content_en: A relatively independent program module capable of being called by a program. The program module is generally configured to implement a portion of the operations of the program or a particular operation, can receive a parameter passed by a calling party, and returns a call result as a function value.

content_cn: 如果控制系统模型参数及干扰均为确定的，称相应的控制系统为确定性控制系统。
content_en: If the model parameters and disturbances of a control system are deterministic, the corresponding control system is referred to as a deterministic control system.

content_cn: 句子中名词性成分所充当的角色。包括句法角色（表层格）和语义角色（深层格）。
content_en: The roles served by nominal components in a sentence include syntactic roles (surface case) and semantic roles (deep case).

content_cn: 如果控制系统有位于 s 右半开平面上的极点或零点，则称该系统为非最小相位。
content_en: If a control system has a pole or zero located in the right half of the s-plane, the system is referred to as non-minimum phase.

content_cn: 具有重复过程的活动中，每一次对过程的重复被称为一次迭代。每一次迭代得到的结果会被用来作为下一次迭代的初始值，其目的通常是为了逼近所需的目标或结果。
content_en: In an activity having a repetitive process, each repetition of the process is referred to as an iteration. A result obtained from each iteration is used as an initial value for a next iteration, generally for the purpose of approximating a desired target or result.

content_cn: 运用特定的模型，研究信息系统其功能和性能的规则和程序。如采用结构化分析方法。
content_en: Rules and procedures for studying the functions and performance of an information system by using a specific model, for example, by adopting a structured analysis method.

content_cn: 信息系统用来确认实体（用户）资质的认证系统。
content_en: A certification system used by an information system to verify qualifications of an entity (user).

content_cn: 若佩特里网Σ中的一个变迁 t 在Σ的运行中永远不具备发生的条件，就称 t 为Σ中的死变迁。
content_en: If a transition t in a Petri net Σ never satisfies the condition for firing during operation of Σ, t is referred to as a dead transition in Σ.

content_cn: 将网络分成节点数最接近的两个子网，在所有分法中，连接两个子网的链路带宽最小值为该网络的对分带宽。
content_en: A network is divided into two subnetworks having the closest numbers of nodes, and among all division schemes, the minimum bandwidth of links connecting the two subnetworks is the bisection width of the network.

content_cn: 通常指使用多台处理器组成的高性能计算系统所执行的计算。
content_en: Generally, this refers to computation performed by a high performance computing system composed of multiple processors.

content_cn: 对网的网元或网结构施加一些操作，如增删，用一个子网代替一个网元（或相反）等，这些操作合称为网运算。
content_en: Certain operations are performed on net elements or net structures of a net, such as addition, deletion, replacement of a net element with a subnet, or vice versa, and these operations are collectively referred to as a net operation.

content_cn: （1）在一般语境中，泛指软件、硬件或任何其他系统的组成部分。（2）在软件复用和基于构件的软件工程中，特指按某种构件标准设计，并可在多个系统中重复使用的软件构造块。（3）在体系结构设计中，特指体系结构的基本要素之一，是软件和硬件系统基本构成元素的抽象。
content_en: (1) In a general context, a constituent part of software, hardware, or any other system. (2) In software reuse and software engineering based on component, a software building block designed according to a particular component standard and reusable in multiple systems. (3) In architecture design, one of the fundamental elements of an architecture, constituting an abstraction of the basic constituent elements of software and hardware systems.

content_cn: 信息进、出计算机的通路。通过通道，计算机可与外部设备、其他计算机系统、通信系统相连接。
content_en: A path through which information enters and exits a computer. Through a channel, the computer may be connected to external devices, other computer systems, and communication systems.

content_cn: 设 M是佩特里网Σ的一个可达标识，若对从M可达的任一个标识M′，M都从M′可达，那么就说M 是Σ中的一个家态。
content_en: Let M be a reachable marking of a Petri net Σ. If, for any marking M′ reachable from M, M is reachable from M′, then M is said to be a home state in Σ.

content_cn: 狭义的基因工程仅指用体外重组DNA技术去获得新的重组基因；广义的基因工程则指按人们意愿设计，通过改造基因或基因组而改变生物的遗传特性。如用重组DNA技术，将外源基因转入大肠杆菌中表达，使大肠杆菌能够生产人所需要的产品；将外源基因转入动物，构建具有新遗传特性的转基因动物；用基因敲除手段，获得有遗传缺陷的动物等。
content_en: In a narrow sense, genetic engineering refers only to obtaining new recombinant genes by in vitro recombinant DNA technology; in a broad sense, genetic engineering refers to intentionally altering the genetic characteristics of an organism by modifying a gene or genome according to a predetermined design. Examples include introducing an exogenous gene into Escherichia coli by recombinant DNA technology for expression, thereby enabling Escherichia coli to produce a desired product; introducing an exogenous gene into an animal to construct a transgenic animal having new genetic characteristics; and obtaining an animal having a genetic defect by means of gene knockout.

content_cn: 在H.264/MPEG-4 AVC视频压缩标准提出的，一个使用单一视频流对于多台摄像机同时采集的视频进行高效编码的编码标准。多视点视频编码主要用于编码立体（双视图）的视频，以及自由视点电视和多视图三维电视。
content_en: A coding standard proposed in the H.264/MPEG-4 AVC video compression standard, which uses a single video stream to efficiently encode videos simultaneously captured by multiple cameras. MVC is mainly used for encoding stereoscopic (dual-view) videos, as well as free-viewpoint television and multi-view three-dimensional television.

content_cn: 由镜面反射形成的反射光。根据表面具体材质，镜面反射光沿各个反射方向强度不等，呈不均匀分布。
content_en: Reflected light formed by specular reflection. Depending on the specific material of the surface, the specular reflection light has different intensities in respective reflection directions and exhibits a non-uniform distribution.

content_cn: 计算机推理程序。在一定的推理机制下，根据知识库中的知识和动态数据库中的实时数据进行推理判断，同时把中间结果送入动态数据库，直到达到预期目标。
content_en: Computer reasoning program. Under a specified inference engine mechanism, the program performs reasoning and determinations based on knowledge in a knowledge base and real-time data in a dynamic database, and feeds intermediate results into the dynamic database until an expected objective is achieved.

content_cn: 语篇中，用代词等语言表达指称文中出现，或虽未出现但语义上隐含的某个实体的现象。通常称指代和被指代者为照应语和先行语。
content_en: In discourse, anaphora is a phenomenon in which a linguistic expression, such as a pronoun, refers to an entity that appears in the text or that, although not appearing in the text, is semantically implicit. Generally, anaphora and the entity referred to are respectively termed an anaphor and an antecedent.

content_cn: 液流角与叶片角的差值，液流冲向叶片正面的为正冲角，反之为负冲角。
content_en: The difference between the fluid flow angle and the blade angle is a positive attack angle when the fluid flow impinges on a front surface of the blade, and is a negative attack angle otherwise.

content_cn: 常温下在冷镦机上将棒料镦粗的加工方法。
content_en: A processing method in which bar stock is upset on a cold heading machine at room temperature.

content_cn: 基孔制的孔为基准孔，标准规定的基准孔，其下偏差为零。
content_en: In the hole-basis system, the hole is a basic hole, and the lower deviation of a basic hole specified by the standard is zero.

content_cn: 适用于多种场合的特殊胎面花纹。如公路花纹与越野花纹的混合花纹、纵向花纹和横向花纹的混合花纹等。
content_en: A special tread pattern applicable to various operating conditions. Examples include an on/off-road pattern combining a highway pattern and an off-road pattern, an on/off-road pattern combining a longitudinal pattern and a transverse pattern, and the like.

content_cn: 风轮在风力机运行中相对于塔架的位置。风轮位置分为上风向和下风向。
content_en: The position of the rotor relative to the tower during operation of the wind turbine. The rotor position is classified as upwind or downwind.

content_cn: 一种分隔式燃烧室的副室，有一个或多个较窄通道与燃烧室的主室相通。开始燃烧后预燃室内形成强烈的无组织湍流。
content_en: An auxiliary chamber of a divided combustion chamber has one or more relatively narrow passages communicating with a main chamber of the combustion chamber. After combustion begins, intense disorganized turbulence is formed in the pre-combustion chamber.

content_cn: 在多孔式喷油嘴中，包容各喷孔轴线所组成的锥形夹角。特殊型式的喷油嘴可能有多个喷雾锥角。
content_en: In a multi-hole fuel injection nozzle, the conical included angle encompasses the axes of all injection holes. A fuel injection nozzle of a special type may have multiple values of spray cone angle.

content_cn: 在连续烧结炉内进行的烧结工艺。
content_en: A sintering process performed in a continuous sintering furnace.

content_cn: 由溶质和溶剂组成的均匀液体。未指明溶剂时一般指水溶液。
content_en: A homogeneous liquid composed of a solute and a solvent. When the solvent is not specified, the term generally refers to an aqueous solution.

content_cn: 烟气流动的通道。它包括锅炉内部烟道和锅炉外部烟道，其中有的布置有受热面。
content_en: A passage through which flue gas flows. The passage includes an internal boiler flue duct and an external boiler flue duct, some of which are provided with heating surfaces.

content_cn: 桥架型或臂架型起重机的回转部分在水平面的角运动。
content_en: Angular movement in a horizontal plane of the slewing portion of a bridge-type or jib-type crane.

content_cn: 针头大小的出现在铸件表层或内部的成群小孔。铸件表面在机械加工1～2mm后可以去掉的圆孔称表面针孔。在机械加工或热处理以后才能发现的长孔称皮下气孔。
content_en: Needle-sized small holes occurring in clusters in a surface layer or an interior of a casting. A round hole that can be removed after machining 1–2 mm from the surface of the casting is referred to as a subsurface pinhole. An elongated hole that can be detected only after machining or heat treatment is referred to as a subsurface blowhole.

content_cn: 在非线性系统中，当激振力幅值保持不变而频率缓慢地单调增大或单调减小时，受迫振动响应的振幅或相位会出现突然变化的现象。前者称为振幅跳跃，后者称为相位跳跃。
content_en: In a nonlinear system, when the amplitude of the excitation force remains constant while the frequency slowly and monotonically increases or decreases, the amplitude or phase of the forced vibration response may undergo a sudden change. The former is referred to as an amplitude jump, and the latter as a phase jump.

content_cn: 在圆柱齿轮上，其齿顶圆柱面与端平面的交线。
content_en: On a cylindrical gear, the tip circle is the line of intersection between the tooth-tip cylindrical surface and an end plane.

content_cn: 用非线性方程来描述的非线性控制系统。系统中包含有非线性元件或环节。
content_en: A nonlinear con-trol system described by nonlinear equations. The system comprises nonlinear elements or links.

content_cn: 滚动轴承标准中推力轴承尺寸方案的一部分。轴承高度的递增系列，对每一直径系列的轴承内径，有一高度系列。
content_en: A part of the dimensional plan for thrust bearings in rolling bearing standards. The bearing heights form an incremental sequence, and one height series is provided for the bearing bore diameter of each diameter series.

content_cn: 渐开线圆柱齿轮(或摆线圆柱齿轮)上的一个假想圆，形成渐开线齿廓的发生线(或形成摆线齿廓的发生圆)在此假想圆的圆周上做纯滚动时，此假想圆就称为基圆。
content_en: An imaginary circle on an involute cylindrical gear (or a cycloidal cylindrical gear) is referred to as the base circle when the generating line forming the involute tooth profile (or the generating circle forming the cycloidal tooth profile) rolls without slipping along the circumference of the imaginary circle.

content_cn: 带有电极送进系统并用水冷铜滑块控制渣池深度和焊缝成形的电渣焊设备。根据电极形状可分为丝极电渣焊机、板极电渣焊机等。
content_en: Electro-slag welding equipment includes an electrode feeding system and uses water-cooled copper slides to control the depth of a slag pool and weld formation. According to the shape of the electrode, the equipment may be classified as a wire-electrode electro-slag welding machine, a plate-electrode electro-slag welding machine, or the like.

content_cn: 与内齿圈或针轮啮合，并能在活齿架的孔中做往复运动和回转运动的构件。
content_en: A component that meshes with an internal gear ring or a pin wheel and is capable of reciprocating and rotating in a hole of an oscillating tooth carrier.

content_cn: 在给定温度下，压力等于其饱和蒸气压的蒸气。当蒸气与物质的凝聚相处于热力学平衡时，蒸气始终处于饱和状态。
content_en: At a given temperature, vapor having a pressure equal to the saturated vapor pressure thereof. When the vapor and the condensed phase of the substance are in thermodynamic equilibrium, the vapor is always in a saturated state.

content_cn: 金属在特定的组织条件、温度条件和变形速度下变形时，塑性比常态提高几倍到几百倍(如有的伸长率d >1000%)，而变形抗力降低到常态的几分之一甚至几十分之一。这种异乎寻常的性质称为超塑性。超塑性有细晶超塑性(又称恒温超塑性)和相变超塑性等。
content_en: When a metal is deformed under specific microstructural conditions, temperature conditions, and deformation rates, the plasticity thereof is increased by several times to several hundred times relative to the normal state (for example, some metals have an elongation d > 1000%), while the deformation resistance is reduced to a fraction, or even several hundredths, of that in the normal state. This extraordinary property is referred to as superplasticity. Superplasticity includes fine-grained superplasticity (also referred to as isothermal superplasticity), phase-transformation superplasticity, and the like.

content_cn: 以锡为主要合金元素的铜基合金。后来开发出一些无锡青铜，如铝青铜、铍青铜等。习惯上，除黄铜﹑白铜以外的铜合金均称青铜，并常在青铜名字前冠以第一主要添加元素的名。
content_en: A copper-based alloy having tin as the principal alloying element. Subsequently, certain tin-free bronze alloys were developed, such as aluminum bronze and beryllium bronze. Conventionally, copper alloys other than brass and cupronickel are collectively referred to as bronze, and the designation of bronze is often preceded by the name of the first principal added element.

content_cn: 指某波长与另一波长之间的连续波长区间。在产品标准中，波长范围指仪器所能工作的波长范围。在红外区域，波长范围用波数范围表示。
content_en: A continuous wavelength interval between one wavelength and another. In a product standard, the wavelength range denotes the wavelength range over which the instrument is capable of operating. In the infrared region, the wavelength range is expressed as a wavenumber range.

content_cn: 燃烧前留在气缸内的新鲜充气质量，与相应于活塞在增压空气歧管压力和温度状况下所扫过的新鲜充气质量之比。充气效率=给气比×扫气利用系数。
content_en: The ratio of the mass of fresh charge remaining in the cylinder before combustion to the mass of fresh charge corresponding to that swept by the piston under the pressure and temperature conditions in the charge-air manifold. charging efficiency = delivery ratio × scavenging utilization coefficient.

content_cn: 用具有齿形的研轮与被研齿轮或一对配对齿轮加研磨剂对滚研磨，以进行齿面的精加工。
content_en: Gear lapping is performed by adding an abrasive and roll-lapping either a toothed lapping wheel with a gear to be lapped or a pair of mating gears, thereby finish-machining the tooth surfaces.

content_cn: 能与油质物质反应，使之易于用水洗涤的物质。分为亲水性乳化剂和亲油性乳化剂两种。
content_en: A substance capable of reacting with oily substances to facilitate washing thereof with water. Such substances are classified into two types: hydrophilic emulsifier and lipophilic emulsifier.

content_cn: (1)圆柱齿轮的节圆柱面与端平面的交线。(2)基准节圆柱面与带轮轴线的垂直平面的交线。
content_en: (1) The line of intersection between the pitch cylindrical surface of a cylindrical gear and an end plane, defining the pitch circle. (2) The line of intersection between the reference pitch cylindrical surface and a plane perpendicular to the pulley axis, defining the pitch circle.

content_cn: 孔的尺寸减去相配合的轴的尺寸所得的代数差，此差为正时是间隙。
content_en: The algebraic difference obtained by subtracting the dimension of a mating shaft from the dimension of a hole is a clearance when the difference is positive.

content_cn: 蜗轮节圆柱面与中间平面的交线。
content_en: The line of intersection of the cylindrical surface of the pitch circle of wormwheel with the intermediate plane.

content_cn: 采用特殊的搅拌头，通过精确控制搅拌头各部件的相对运动，在搅拌头回撤的同时填充搅拌头在焊接过程中形成退出孔的焊接技术。搅拌摩擦点焊的搅拌头主要由三部分组成，分别为最内部的探针、中间层的袖筒以及最外层的夹套。其中，夹套在焊接时固定，不发生旋转，而中间层的袖筒和最内层的探针在焊接时既发生旋转也发生沿轴向的相对运动。
content_en: A welding technique employing a special stirring head fills an exit hole formed by the stirring head during welding while the stirring head is retracted, by precisely controlling the relative movement of the components of the stirring head. The stirring head for friction-stir spot welding mainly comprises three parts: an innermost probe, an intermediate sleeve, and an outermost jacket. During welding, the jacket remains fixed without rotating, whereas the intermediate sleeve and the innermost probe both rotate and move axially relative to each other.

content_cn: 锅炉机组处于非计划停运状态的小时数。按状态分为：第1类非计划停运小时数(UOH1)，指机组需立即停运或被迫不能按规定立即投入运行的小时数；第2类非计划停运小时数(UOH2)，指机组虽不需立即停运，但需在6h以内停运的小时数；第3类非计划停运小时数(UOH3)，指机组可延迟至6h以后，但需在72h以内停运的小时数；第4类非计划停运小时数(UOH4)，指机组可延迟至72h以后，但需在下次计划停运前停运的小时数；第5类非计划停运小时数(UOH5)，指计划停运的机组因故超过计划停运期限的延长停运小时数。
content_en: The number of hours during which a boiler unit is in an unplanned outage state. Such hours are classified by state as follows: Category 1 unplanned outage hours (UOH1), meaning the number of hours during which the unit must be shut down immediately or is forced to be incapable of being placed into operation immediately as required; Category 2 unplanned outage hours (UOH2), meaning the number of hours during which the unit does not need to be shut down immediately but must be shut down within 6 h; Category 3 unplanned outage hours (UOH3), meaning the number of hours during which shutdown of the unit may be deferred beyond 6 h but must occur within 72 h; Category 4 unplanned outage hours (UOH4), meaning the number of hours during which shutdown of the unit may be deferred beyond 72 h but must occur before the next planned outage; and Category 5 unplanned outage hours (UOH5), meaning the number of extended outage hours by which a planned outage of the unit exceeds the planned outage period for any reason.

content_cn: 试油从恩格勒黏度计流孔中流出200ml所需要的时间与蒸馏水在20℃流出相同体积的流量所需时间之比。
content_en: The ratio of the time required for 200 ml of test oil to flow out through the orifice of an Engler viscosity meter to the time required for the same volume of distilled water to flow out at 20°C.

content_cn: 蜗轮上，两个相邻的同侧齿廓之间的分度圆弧长。蜗轮分度圆齿距等于其配对蜗杆的轴向齿距。
content_en: For a worm wheel, this is the arc length along the reference circle between corresponding flanks of two adjacent teeth. The reference pitch of the worm wheel is equal to the axial pitch of the mating worm.

content_cn: 用以确定某一组分的仪器响应值的一种已知该组分浓度的混合气。通常与其他不同浓度的同类标定气一起使用，以定出分析仪的响应曲线。
content_en: A gas mixture having a known concentration of a component and used to determine the response value of an instrument to that component. The mixture is generally used together with calibration gas of the same type at other concentrations to establish the response curve of the analyzer.

content_cn: 内燃机燃油供给部分的总称。包括燃油箱、燃油管、燃油泵、燃油滤清器、蒸气返回管、化油器或喷射部件、燃油系统所有通风口和蒸发排放物控制系统或装置等。
content_en: A collective term for the fuel supply portion of an internal combustion engine. The fuel supply portion includes a fuel tank, a fuel pipe, a fuel pump, a fuel filter, a vapor return pipe, a carburetor or injection component, all vents of the fuel system, and an evaporative emission control system or device.

content_cn: 在斜撑式桅杆起重机中，连接在支承套与地梁之间的刚性支撑结构件。
content_en: In a mast crane provided with a back stay, a rigid support structural member connected between a support sleeve and a ground beam.

content_cn: 受载零件或构件在形状尺寸突然改变处出现应变增大的现象，应变集中处就是应力集中处。
content_en: The phenomenon in which strain increases at a location where the shape or dimensions of a loaded part or member change abruptly; the location of strain concentration is the location of stress concentration.

content_cn: 它是一种以数字模型文件为基础，运用金属或塑料等粉末材料以及黏合剂，通过逐层打印的方式来构造物体的技术。当三维打印机为小型化的设备时，此技术称为桌面三维打印。
content_en: This technology constructs an object by layer-by-layer printing based on a digital model file and using powdered materials, such as metals or plastics, and a binder. When a 3DP printer is a miniaturized device, this technology is referred to as desktop 3DP.

content_cn: 与气缸盖或机体分离，内部装有气门的零件。冷却式阀壳应标注“冷却式”的标记。
content_en: A component separate from a cylinder head or an engine body and having a valve disposed therein. A cooled valve cage shall bear a “cooled” marking.

content_cn: 碳的一种同素异构体——六方晶系的晶体。它是铸铁内常出现的以及石墨化钢内含有的一种组织组分。
content_en: Graphite is an allotrope of carbon and is a crystal belonging to the hexagonal crystal system. It is a microstructural constituent commonly present in cast iron and contained in graphitized steel.

content_cn: 在金属表面上无任何液相条件下，金属仅与气体腐蚀剂反应所发生的腐蚀。
content_en: Corrosion occurring when a metal reacts solely with a gaseous corrosion agent in the absence of any liquid phase on the metal surface.

content_cn: 螺旋弹簧两相邻有效圈的轴向间距。
content_en: The axial space between two adjacent active coils of a helical spring.

content_cn: 一种内方位元素已知的摄影物镜的畸变经过严格校正的摄影机。习惯上将具有框标的摄影机称为量测摄影机。
content_en: A camera having known interior orientation elements and a photographic objective with rigorously corrected distortion. Conventionally, a camera having fiducial marks is referred to as a metric camera.

content_cn: 具有强渗透力的油液与带色染料或荧光染料按一定的比例混合而成的溶液。分为水洗性渗透液，后乳化性渗透液，溶剂去除性渗透液。
content_en: A solution prepared by mixing, in a predetermined proportion, an oil having strong penetrating power with a colored dye or a fluorescent dye. The solution is classified as a water-washable penetrant, a post-emulsifiable penetrant, or a solvent-removable penetrant.

content_cn: 水轮机中将水能转化为机械能的旋转部件。在水泵水轮机的水泵工况，转轮也将机械能转化为水能。
content_en: A rotating component in a hydraulic turbine that converts hydraulic energy into mechanical energy. During pump operation of a pump-turbine, the runner also converts mechanical energy into hydraulic energy.

content_cn: 相对速度瞬心和绝对速度瞬心的总称。
content_en: A collective term for the relative instantaneous center of velocity and the absolute instantaneous center of velocity.

content_cn: 内装泡罩塔板，上升蒸汽穿过泡罩齿缝与液体接触，气液两相间进行传质传热的塔。
content_en: A bubble cap tray column internally provided with bubble cap trays, in which ascending vapor passes through toothed slots of the bubble caps to contact liquid, thereby performing mass transfer and heat transfer between the gas phase and the liquid phase.

content_cn: 流体在管道内流动所发生的能量损失。流体流动时的能量损失由摩擦阻力所引起的沿程能量损失和由流道形状变化引起的局部能量损失组成，通常用压差形式表示能量损失，即压力损失。
content_en: Energy loss occurring when a fluid flows through a pipeline. The energy loss during fluid flow consists of distributed energy loss caused by frictional resistance and local energy loss caused by changes in the shape of a flow passage, and is generally expressed in the form of a pressure difference, namely, pressure loss.

content_cn: 渐开线蜗杆基圆柱面与端平面的交线。
content_en: The line of intersection between the cylindrical surface of the base circle of involute helicoid worm and the end plane.
special_en: base circle of involute helicoid worm

content_cn: 柔轮筒壁与输出联接盘以内外花键联接的形式。
content_en: The cylindrical wall of the flexspline and the output coupling disc are connected by means of an internal-external spline coupling.

content_cn: 卷筒外周呈凹弧面，使卷入的起重挠性件能沿卷筒(绞盘头)轴向自动滑向弧底，不致产生轴向游移的单卷筒摩擦式绞车。
content_en: A single-drum friction winch having a drum with a concave arcuate outer circumferential surface, such that a hoisting flexible member wound onto the drum (capstan head) can automatically slide axially along the drum toward the bottom of the arcuate surface without axial displacement.

content_cn: 限定向心轴承宽度的两个套圈端面之间的轴向距离，对于单列圆锥滚子轴承是指外圈背面与内圈背面之间的轴向距离。
content_en: The axial distance between the two ring end faces defining the bearing width of a radial bearing; for a single-row tapered roller bearing, the axial distance between the back face of the outer ring and the back face of the inner ring.

content_cn: 利用发动机排气压力波，在曲轴带动的气波增压器的转子槽道内直接使新鲜充气增压的方法。
content_en: A method for directly pressurizing a fresh charge by utilizing engine exhaust pressure waves within rotor channels of an apparatus for pressure-wave supercharging driven by a crankshaft.

content_cn: 用塑料(一般为环氧树脂)制成的模样。以其他材料为基体，表面覆盖一层塑料的复合材料模，也属于塑料模。
content_en: A pattern made of plastic, generally epoxy resin. A composite pattern having a substrate made of another material and a surface covered with a layer of plastic also constitutes a plastic pattern.

content_cn: 赫兹(Hertz)提出的一种描述两个椭球表面固体接触的接触模型。在该接触下的面积称为赫兹接触面积，在该面积上的压力称为赫兹接触压力。注：在固体理想接触基础上，运用材料力学、弹性力学及弹塑性力学进行分析计算，得到由载荷产生的接触压力分布和接触区尺寸，进而获得接触表面附近及固体内部的应力分布。
content_en: A contact model proposed by Hertz for describing contact between two solid bodies having ellipsoidal surfaces. The area under such contact is referred to as the Hertzian contact area, and the pressure over such area is referred to as the Hertzian contact pressure. Note: Based on ideal contact between solid bodies, analytical calculations are performed using mechanics of materials, elasticity, and elastoplastic mechanics to obtain the distribution of contact pressure generated by a load and the dimensions of a contact region, thereby obtaining the stress distribution near the contact surfaces and within the solid bodies.

content_cn: 一种成形金属空心回转体件的工艺方法。在坯料随模具旋转或旋压工具绕坯料旋转中，旋压工具与坯料相对进给，从而使坯料受压并产生连续、逐点的变形。包含普通旋压和变薄旋压(即强力旋压)。
content_en: A process method for forming a metal hollow body of revolution. During rotation of a blank together with a die or rotation of a spinning tool around the blank, the spinning tool and the blank are fed relative to each other, thereby subjecting the blank to pressure and causing continuous, point-by-point deformation. The method includes conventional spinning and thinning spinning (i.e., power spinning).

content_cn: 横截面中梯形轮廓的高度。
content_en: The height of the trapezoidal profile in the cross section.

content_cn: 供平衡配重用的轮胎两侧对称的两个旋转平面(在呈水平姿态的轮胎上可分为上校正面和下校正面)。
content_en: Two rotational planes symmetrically located on both sides of a tire and used for balancing counterweights (the rotational planes being divided into an upper compensating side and a lower compensating side when the tire is in a horizontal orientation).

content_cn: 摩擦表面被液体润滑剂隔开的润滑。
content_en: Lubrication in which friction surfaces are separated by a fluid lubrication agent.

content_cn: 与车轮滚动阻力矩相等效的阻碍汽车行驶的力。
content_en: A force that impedes travel of the vehicle and is equivalent to the rolling resistance moment of the wheel.

content_cn: 为缩短工艺周期，或用一次回火代替多次回火，常采用提高回火温度的方法。即快速回火法。
content_en: To shorten the process cycle or replace multiple tempering operations with a single tempering operation, a method of increasing the tempering temperature is generally employed, namely, prompt tempering.

content_cn: 符合造型要求的混合料。有天然型砂和合成型砂两类。
content_en: A mixture that meets molding requirements. There are two types: natural molding sand and synthetic molding sand.

content_cn: 在非金属涂层下面的金属表面发生的一种细丝状腐蚀。
content_en: A type of fine filiform corrosion occurring on a metal surface beneath a non-metallic coating.

content_cn: 在双目仪器中，从左、右两系统观察同一个物体时，两像左右错开的角度。当右像位于左像的右方时，水平发散度规定为正。
content_en: In a binocular instrument, the angle by which the two images are horizontally displaced relative to each other when the same object is observed through the left and right systems. When the right image is located to the right of the left image, horizontal divergence is defined as positive.

content_cn: 产品不能执行规定功能的状态。预防性维修或其他计划性活动或缺乏外部资源的情况除外。故障通常是产品本身失效后的状态，但也可能在失效前就存在。
content_en: A state in which a product is unable to perform a specified function, excluding circumstances involving preventive maintenance, other scheduled activities, or a lack of external resources. A fault is generally a state occurring after failure of the product itself, but may also exist before the failure.

content_cn: 利用气固两相流态化实现固体燃料燃烧的燃烧方式。常用的燃烧方式分为鼓泡流化床燃烧和循环流化床燃烧两大类。
content_en: A combustion mode in which combustion of a solid fuel is achieved using gas-solid two-phase fluidization. Common combustion modes are classified into two categories: bubbling fluidized bed combustion and circulating fluidized bed combustion.

content_cn: 位置在支承跨度以外，如外悬质量，外悬校正平面。
content_en: The position is outside the bearing span, such as an overhung mass or an overhung correction plane.

content_cn: 准双曲面齿轮副中的任何一个齿轮。
content_en: Either gear in a hypoid gear pair.

content_cn: 对于斜齿轮，其齿线上某一点处的法平面与分度圆柱面的交线是一个椭圆，以此椭圆的最大曲率半径作为某一个假想直齿轮的分度圆半径，并以此斜齿轮的法向模数和法向压力角作为上述假想直齿轮的端面模数和端面压力角，此假想直齿轮就称为所述的斜齿轮的当量齿轮。
content_en: For a helical gear, an intersection line between a normal plane at a point on a tooth trace and a reference cylinder is an ellipse. The maximum radius of curvature of the ellipse is taken as the reference circle radius of a hypothetical spur gear, and the normal module and normal pressure angle of the helical gear are respectively taken as the transverse module and transverse pressure angle of the hypothetical spur gear. The hypothetical spur gear is referred to as the virtual gear of the helical gear.

content_cn: 使试样原子或分子电离并使之形成有一定形状、能量和强度的离子束的离子源。
content_en: An ion source configured to ionize atoms or molecules of a sample and form the ionized atoms or molecules into an ion beam having a predetermined shape, energy, and intensity.

content_cn: 应力作用在受损材料上引起的应变与有效应力作用在无损材料上引起的应变等价的假定。基于应变等价假定，受损结构的本构关系可通过无损时的形式描述，只需将其中名义应力换成有效应力即可。
content_en: An assumption that strain induced by stress acting on a damaged material is equivalent to strain induced by effective stress acting on an undamaged material. Based on the strain equivalence assumption, the constitutive relation of a damaged structure may be described in the same form as that of the undamaged structure, by replacing the nominal stress therein with the effective stress.

content_cn: 蜗杆节圆柱面与垂直于蜗杆轴线的平面的交线。
content_en: The pitch circle of worm is the line of intersection between the worm pitch cylindrical surface and a plane perpendicular to the axis of the worm.

content_cn: 开关中用于实现电路接通或分断的接触点。
content_en: A contact point in a switch for making or breaking a circuit.

content_cn: 由一个或两个大型逆流式筒形燃烧室组成的燃烧室，用法兰连接于透平与压气机气缸上。
content_en: A combustion chamber comprising one or two large reverse-flow silo combustor units is flange-connected to the turbine cylinder and the compressor cylinder.

content_cn: 由制动力矩作用而产生的负的纵向力。
content_en: A negative longitudinal force generated by the action of a braking force moment.

content_cn: 具有两个可以开合的钢质卡脚的测量工具。可分为内卡钳和外卡钳。
content_en: A measuring tool having two steel legs capable of opening and closing. The measuring tool may be classified as an inside calliper or an outside calliper.

content_cn: 螺距的实际值与其基本值之差。Ｎ个螺距偏差系指跨Ｎ牙螺距的实际值与其基本值之差。
content_en: The difference between the actual value of a pitch and the basic value thereof. The deviation in pitch over N teeth refers to the difference between the actual value of the pitch over N teeth and the basic value thereof.

content_cn: 闸块离合器中，外圆柱面固定有摩擦材料的部件。
content_en: A brake shoe is a component in a clutch, having a friction material fixed to an outer cylindrical surface thereof.

content_cn: 使型(芯)砂中的黏结剂产生化学反应而将砂粒固结在一起的材料。固化剂可为固体、液体或气体。
content_en: A material that causes a binder in molding (core) sand to undergo a chemical reaction, thereby bonding sand grains together. The hardener may be a solid, liquid, or gas.

content_cn: 组成瓦块轴承的扇形或其他形状元件。不能摆动的称为固定瓦块，可绕支点摆动的称为可倾瓦块。
content_en: A sector-shaped or otherwise shaped element constituting a pad bearing. The non-pivotable type is referred to as a fixed pad, and the type pivotable about a fulcrum is referred to as a tilting pad.

content_cn: 炉排锅炉作热备用时，暂停供给燃料但适当进行通风，使火床保持适量燃烧而不致熄灭的状态；鼓泡流化床锅炉则关闭快速风门，停送、引风机，使床料压火保温。
content_en: When a grate boiler is placed on hot standby, the fuel supply is suspended while appropriate ventilation is maintained, such that a fire bed maintains an appropriate degree of combustion without being extinguished; for a bubbling fluidized-bed boiler, a quick-closing air damper is closed, forced-draft and induced-draft fans are stopped, and bed material is subjected to banking fire for heat preservation.

content_cn: 用插齿刀按展成法或成形法加工内、外齿轮或齿条等的齿面。
content_en: The tooth surfaces of internal gears, external gears, racks, or the like are machined using a gear shaping cutter according to a generating method or a forming method.

content_cn: 在圆柱齿轮上，其齿根圆柱面与端平面的交线。
content_en: On a cylindrical gear, the root circle is the line of intersection between the tooth-root cylindrical surface and an end plane.

content_cn: 出口蒸汽压力一般为2.45～4.90MPa的锅炉。按我国电站锅炉现行的蒸汽参数系列，中压锅炉出口蒸汽压力规定为3.83MPa。
content_en: A boiler having an outlet steam pressure generally ranging from 2.45 MPa to 4.90 MPa. According to the current steam parameter series for utility boilers in China, the outlet steam pressure of a medium-pressure boiler is specified as 3.83 MPa.

content_cn: 对斜齿圆柱齿轮和蜗杆，当齿轮轴线立于观察者前方，所见轮齿向右上方倾斜者为右旋齿。对曲线齿锥齿轮，当观察者从锥顶朝大端看过去，轮齿上的背锥齿廓，相对中间锥面上的齿廓，按顺时针方向转过了一个角度时，此轮齿也称为右旋齿。
content_en: For a helical cylindrical gear or a worm, when the gear axis is positioned in front of the observer, teeth that appear to incline upward to the right are right hand teeth. For a spiral bevel gear, when viewed by an observer from the cone apex toward the large end, if the tooth profile on the back cone is rotated clockwise through an angle relative to the tooth profile on the mean cone, the teeth are also referred to as right hand teeth.

content_cn: 将燃料和空气按燃烧要求的浓度、速度、方向或旋流强度送进炉膛的孔口。不同燃烧器喷口具有不同的结构形状。
content_en: An opening through which fuel and air are delivered into a furnace chamber at a concentration, velocity, direction, or swirl intensity required for combustion. Different types of burner nozzle have different structural configurations.

content_cn: 给点火器通电的动作。
content_en: An action of energizing an ignition device.

content_cn: 电磁波在真空中的传播速度。通常光速为c=299792458m/s。
content_en: The propagation speed of electromagnetic waves in a vacuum. The velocity of light is generally c = 299792458 m/s.

content_cn: 由系统本身的质量和刚度所决定的频率。n自由度系统一般有n个固有频率，按频率的高低排列，最低的为第一阶固有频率。有阻尼的线性系统的自由振动频率称为“阻尼固有频率”。
content_en: A frequency determined by the mass and stiffness of the system itself. A system having n degrees of freedom generally has n natural frequency values, which are arranged in ascending order of frequency, with the lowest being the first-order natural frequency. The free-vibration frequency of a damped linear system is referred to as a “damped natural frequency.”

content_cn: 按平面应变压痕模量计算的试样的平均各向同性杨氏模量的估计值。
content_en: An estimated value of the average isotropic Young's modulus of the specimen, calculated based on the plane-strain indentation modulus.

content_cn: 使用的耗材是光固化树脂。数字光投影技术主要是以投影仪的数字光源，以面层为质量单元，实现材料逐层堆积的增材制造技术。
content_en: The consumable material used is a photocurable resin. digital light projection is an additive manufacturing technology that primarily uses a digital light source of a projector and takes a surface layer as a mass unit to achieve layer-by-layer accumulation of material.

content_cn: 以电阻特性为主要技术特征的合金，主要包括精密电阻合金，应变电阻合金，电热合金，热敏电阻合金，磁敏电阻合金，压敏电阻合金等。
content_en: An alloy having electrical resistance characteristics as its principal technical feature, mainly including precision electric resistance alloy, strain electric resistance alloy, electrothermal alloy, thermally sensitive electric resistance alloy, magnetically sensitive electric resistance alloy, pressure-sensitive electric resistance alloy, and the like.

content_cn: 符合一项试验筛标准规范的用于对待筛物料作粒度分析的筛子。
content_en: A sieve that complies with a standard specification for a test sieve and is used to perform particle size analysis of material to be sieved.

content_cn: 在单独制成的试块铸型中浇注的试块。单铸试块必须用与浇注铸件同炉或同包的金属液浇注。用于加工成试样供检验化学成分、金相组织和力学性能等。
content_en: A test bar cast in a separately prepared test-bar mold. The separated test bar of casting shall be cast using molten metal from the same furnace or ladle as that used for casting the casting. The test bar is machined into specimens for testing chemical composition, metallographic structure, mechanical properties, and the like.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种用于料理机的连接器及料理机，连接器包括：外连接组件，外连接组件包括上外连接件和下外连接件，外刀轴的下端与上外连接件相连，外驱动轴的上端与下外连接件相连，上外连接件与下外连接件可拆卸相连以实现外驱动轴和外刀轴之间的传动连接；内连接组件，内连接组件设于外连接组件内，内连接组件包括上内连接件和下内连接件，内刀轴的下端穿过上外连接件以与所述上内连接件相连，内驱动轴的上端穿过下外连接件以与下内连接件相连，上内连接件与下内连接件可拆卸相连以实现内驱动轴和内刀轴之间的传动连接。根据本发明的连接器可实现双轴连接以同时传递两个旋转运动，且连接方式简单、安全、可靠。
content_en: The invention discloses a connector for a food processer and the food processer. The connector comprises: an outer connecting assembly, which comprises an upper outer connecting piece and a lower outer connecting piece, wherein the lower end of an outer cutter shaft is connected to the upper outer connecting piece, the upper end of an outer driving shaft is connected to the lower outer connectingpiece, and the upper outer connecting piece and the lower outer connecting piece are detachably connected to achieve transmission connection between the outer driving shaft and the outer cutter shaft;and an inner connecting assembly, which is arranged in the outer connecting assembly, and comprises an upper inner connecting piece and a lower inner connecting piece, wherein the lower end of an inner cutter shaft penetrates through the upper outer connecting piece to be connected to the upper inner connecting piece, the upper end of an inner driving shaft penetrates through the lower outer connecting piece to be connected to the lower inner connecting piece, and the upper inner connecting piece is detachably connected to the lower inner connecting piece to achieve transmission connection between the inner driving shaft and the inner cutter shaft. According to the connector, double-shaft connection can be achieved so as to transmit two rotary motions at the same time, and the connectionmode is simple, safe and reliable.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开了一种净饮机，包括：水箱，水箱的箱体构造成具有腔室；浮子，浮子设在腔室内，浮子可在位于上方的第一位置和位于下方的第二位置之间移动；以及与浮子匹配的浮子位置感应器，浮子位置感应器设在净饮机的机体上靠近箱体外侧壁的位置上，用于检测箱体是否安装到位或/和浮子的位置变化。根据本实用新型的净饮机，通过在水箱内设置浮子，在净饮机的机体上设置浮子位置感应器，实现分离式水位监测。当水箱安装到位时，浮子位置感应器可以检测浮子的位置信息，可检测箱体是否安装到位或/和浮子的位置变化。
content_en: The utility model discloses a water purification dispenser. The water purification dispenser comprises a water tank, a floater and a floater position sensor; a tank body of the water tank is designed to be provided with a chamber; the floater which is arranged inside the chamber can move between a first position which is arranged on the upper portion and a second position which is arranged on the lower portion; the floater position sensor which is arranged at a water purification dispenser machine body position which is close to the external lateral wall of the tank body is used for detecting whether the tank body is installed in place or not or and change of floater positions. According to the water purification dispenser, the floater is arranged inside the water tank and the floater position sensor is arranged on the water purification dispenser machine body to achieve separating type water level monitoring and when the water tank is installed in place, the floater position sensor can detect floater position information, whether the tank body is installed in pace or not or and change of the floater positions.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开了一种餐具洗涤设备，该餐具洗涤设备包括内胆及水箱，内胆用于形成容纳待洗涤餐具的洗涤腔；水箱用于形成第一蓄水腔和第二蓄水腔，以容纳用于洗涤待洗涤餐具的洗涤水；其中，水箱呈L形设置，并至少局部覆盖内胆的侧壁和顶壁，第一蓄水腔和第二蓄水腔呈与水箱形状对应的L形设置，以使得第一蓄水腔内的洗涤水能够与第二蓄水腔内的洗涤水进行热交换。本实用新型能够实现对洗涤水的热量回收，节省加热洗涤水的电量，从而降低餐具洗涤设备的耗电量，有利于节能环保。
content_en: The utility model discloses tableware washing equipment which comprises an inner container and a water tank, and the inner container is used for forming a washing cavity for containing tableware to be washed. The water tank is used for forming a first water storage cavity and a second water storage cavity so as to contain washing water used for washing tableware to be washed. Wherein the water tank is arranged in an L shape and at least partially covers the side wall and the top wall of the inner container, and the first water storage cavity and the second water storage cavity are arranged in an L shape corresponding to the shape of the water tank, so that washing water in the first water storage cavity can exchange heat with washing water in the second water storage cavity. The washing water heat recovery device can recover heat of washing water and save electricity for heating the washing water, so that power consumption of the tableware washing equipment is reduced, and energy conservation and environmental protection are facilitated.

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种固定座及手持式吸尘器，包括本体及充电组件，本体上设置有用于固定吸尘器主体的固定位，所述充电组件与所述本体连接，充电组件包括充电线及分别连接于所述充电线两端的插头及接头，插头用于与外部电源电连接，所述接头用于与吸尘器主体电连接。当吸尘器主体吸尘完毕时，直接将吸尘器主体放置于本体上的固定位，然后根据需要选择是否给吸尘器主体充电，如当吸尘器主体需要充电时，将充电组件的插头与外部电源电连接，接头与充电器主体连接即可给吸尘器主体充电，固定座不但具有固定吸尘器主体的功能，还具有充电功能，在需要给吸尘器主体充电时直接放置于固定座充电即可，比较方便；且便于充电器的收纳。
content_en: The invention relates to a fixing base and a handheld dust collector. The fixing base comprises a body and a charging assembly, wherein the body is provided with a fixing position for fixing a dust collector body, the charging assembly is connected with the body and comprises a charging line, a plug and a connector, the plug and the connector are respectively connected to two ends of the chargingline, the plug is electrically connected with an external power supply, and the connector is used for electrical connection with the dust collector body. When the dust collector body completes dust collection, the dust collector body is directly put at the fixing position of the body, and then charging of the dust collector body or not is selected according to the demand; when the dust collector body needs to be charged, the plug of the charging assembly is electrically connected with the external power supply, the dust collector body can be charged by connecting the connector and a charger body, the fixing base has the function of fixing the dust collector body and also has a charging function, and when the dust collector body needs to be charged, the dust collector body is directly put on the fixing base for charging, and the operation is very convenient. In addition, the charger is convenient to store.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种食物料理机及其防堵转装置、方法，食物料理机包括搅拌杯和底座，搅拌杯内设有搅拌刀，底座内设有带动搅拌刀转动的电机，防堵转装置包括：电流检测电路和/或转速检测电路，电流检测电路包括电流互感器用以检测电机的电流，转速检测电路包括霍尔传感器，用以检测电机的转速；设置在底座上的电机控制电路，用以控制电机的转速；分别与电机控制电路、电流检测电路和/或转速检测电路相连的控制器，用于根据电机的电流和/或电机的转速判断电机是否发生堵转，并在电机发生堵转时，通过电机控制电路控制电机提高转速。该防堵转装置，能够判断电机是否发生堵转，并在电机发生堵转时提高电机转速以带动搅拌刀搅碎食物使电机恢复转动。
content_en: The invention discloses a food processer and an anti-rotation-blocking device and method thereof. The food processer comprises a stirring cup and a base, a stirring knife is arranged in the stirring cup, and a motor for driving the stirring knife to rotate is arranged in the base. The anti-rotation-blocking device comprises a current detection circuit and/or a rotating speed detection circuit, thecurrent detection circuit comprises a current mutual inductor for detecting the current of the motor, and the rotating speed detection circuit comprises a Hall sensor for detecting the rotating speedof the motor.
