The anti-rotation-blocking device further comprises a motor control circuit arranged on the base and used for controlling the rotating speed of the motor, and a controller connected with the motor control circuit, the current detection circuit and/or the rotating speed detection circuit, and used for judging whether rotation blocking occurs to the motor or not according to the current and/or rotating speed of the motor, and when rotation blocking occurs to the motor, the motor is controlled to increase the rotating speed through the motor control circuit. According to the anti-rotation-blocking device, whether rotation blocking occurs to the motor or not can be judged, and when rotation blocking occurs to the motor, the rotating speed of the motor is increased so as to drivethe stirring knife to crush food to enable rotation of the motor to be recovered.

content_cn: 本申请属于烹饪器具技术领域，具体涉及一种抽屉组件及具有该抽屉组件的烹饪装置。本申请的抽屉组件用于烹饪装置，抽屉组件包括抽屉本体、抽屉面板和拉手，抽屉面板连接于抽屉本体的一侧，抽屉面板的至少一个端面上设有第一开口，拉手包括面板部和凸起部，面板部设有第二开口，第二开口朝向背离面板部的方向延伸设置并形成凸起部，面板部与抽屉面板相连，凸起部插接至第一开口内，其中，拉手的导热系数小于抽屉面板的导热系数。根据本申请的抽屉组件，烹饪装置在工作过程中散发的热量不易传导至拉手上，从而减少拉手的温升，防止因拉手温度过高导致烫伤现象的发生，提高烹饪装置使用的安全性和可靠性。
content_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of cooking utensils, and particularly relates to a drawer assembly and a cooking device with the drawer assembly. The drawer assembly is used for the cooking device and comprises a drawer body, a drawer panel and a handle, the drawer panel is connected to one side of the drawer body, a first opening is formed in at least one end face of the drawer panel, the handle comprises a panel part and a protruding part, and the panel part is provided with a second opening; the second opening extends in the direction away from the panel part and forms a protruding part, the panel part is connected with the drawer panel, the protruding part is inserted into the first opening, and the heat conductivity coefficient of the handle is smaller than that of the drawer panel. According to the drawer assembly, heat dissipated in the working process of the cooking device is not easily conducted to the handle, so that the temperature rise of the handle is reduced, the scalding phenomenon caused by the too high temperature of the handle is prevented, and the use safety and reliability of the cooking device are improved.

content_cn: 本实用新型提供了一种电饭煲的上盖和电饭煲，其中，电饭煲的上盖包括面盖和面板，在面盖上设置胶槽，在胶槽内涂布固定胶，面板通过固定胶固定在面盖上，既保证了面板表面的平整度，从而保证了面板的美观性，又增大了固定胶与面盖之间的接触面积，从而有效地增强了固定胶的粘接力；胶槽的至少一侧设置有溢胶槽，使得在安装面板时，多余的固定胶可以储存在溢胶槽中，有效防止了固定胶流到面盖的外表面，而且，溢出的、位于胶槽与溢胶槽连通处的固定胶会与面板相连接，从而增加了固定胶与面盖的接触面积，进而使得面盖与面板的连接更牢固；胶槽和溢胶槽沿面盖的周向设置，从而使得固定胶在有效固定面板的同时，也可以起到密封面板和面盖的作用。
content_en: The utility model provides an upper cover of an electric cooker and the electric cooker. The upper cover of the electric cooker comprises a face cover and a face plate. The face cover is provided with a glue groove, the interior of the glue groove is coated with fixing glue, the face plate is fixed to the face cover through the fixing glue, the flatness of the surface of the face plate is ensured, the attractiveness of the face plate is ensured, the contact area between the fixing glue and the face cover is enlarged, and therefore the bonding force of the fixing glue is effectively improved. A glue overflow groove is formed in at least one side of the glue groove, when the face plate is installed, surplus fixing glue can be stored in the glue overflow groove, the fixing glue is effectively prevented from flowing to the outer surface of the face cover, the overflowing fixing glue located at the communication position of the glue groove and the glue overflow groove can be connected with the face plate, the contact area between the fixing glue and the face cover is enlarged, and the connection of the face cover and the face plate is firmer. The glue groove and the glue overflow groove are formed in the circumferential direction of the face cover, and therefore the function of sealing the face plate and the face cover can also be achieved while the face plate is effectively fixed through the fixing glue.

content_cn: 本实用新型提供一种饭盒，包括：底座；盖体，装配在所述底座上；触发键，设于所述盖体上；连接部，活动连接在所述盖体内，所述连接部与所述触发键抵接，所述连接部包括第一连接件，所述第一连接件具有连接底座的第一状态，以及与所述底座相互脱开的第二状态。触发键设置在盖体上，不会额外增加饭盒的体积，由于所述连接部与所述触发键抵接，用户通过按动触发键能够带动连接部发生运动，连接部与盖体之间活动连接，在触发键的推动下能够发生相对于盖体的运动，从而带动第一连接件在第一状态和第二状态之间运动，实现通过按键控制盖体与底座之间的连接。
content_en: The utility model provides a lunch box. The lunch box comprises a base; the cover body is assembled on the base; the trigger key is arranged on the cover body; and the connecting part is movably connected in the cover body, the connecting part abuts against the trigger key, the connecting part comprises a first connecting piece, and the first connecting piece has a first state of being connected with the base and a second state of being separated from the base. The trigger key is arranged on the cover body, the volume of the lunch box is not additionally increased, the connecting part is propped against the trigger key, a user can drive the connecting part to move by pressing the trigger key, the connecting part is movably connected with the cover body, and the connecting part can move relative to the cover body under the pushing of the trigger key, so that the lunch box is convenient to use. Therefore, the first connecting piece is driven to move between the first state and the second state, and connection between the cover body and the base is controlled through the key.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种快速制浆豆浆机及制作豆浆的方法。这种快速制浆豆浆机，包括机座、控制装置，设置在机座上的水箱、带有粉碎搅拌装置及渣浆分离装置的粉碎杯、豆浆桶，水箱与粉碎杯及豆浆桶之间分别设有流体通道，所述流体通道上设有依序连通水箱与粉碎杯及豆浆桶的控制阀；所述粉碎搅拌装置、渣浆分离装置、控制阀分别与控制装置电连接；所述粉碎杯上设有将浆液输送到豆浆桶内的浆液出口。相对于现有家用豆浆机在制作豆浆时一次性加入足量水的方式，由于先只加少量液体，打浆、煮浆时其总的容积较少，因此粉碎效率高，可以实现快速打浆和煮浆。同时粉碎杯不需要预留太大的为避免浆液上升及泡沫溢出的空间，因此粉碎杯容积小。
content_en: The invention discloses a soybean milk machine for rapidly preparing soybean milk and a method for preparing the soybean milk. The soybean milk machine for rapidly preparing the soybean milk comprises a machine base, a control device, a water tank arranged on the machine base, a crushing cup provided with a crushing and stirring device and a dreg and milk separation device, and a soybean milk barrel, wherein fluid channels are formed among the water tank, the crushing cup and the soybean milk barrel respectively, and are provided with control valves which are used for sequentially communicating the water tank, the crushing cup and the soybean milk barrel; the crushing and stirring device, the dreg and milk separation device and the control valves are electrically connected with the control device respectively; and the crushing cup is provided with a soybean milk outlet for conveying the soybean milk to the soybean milk barrel. Compared with a method that enough water is added at one time when the soybean milk is prepared by the conventional household soybean milk machine, the method has the advantages that: only a small amount of liquid is added first, and the total volume is smaller during beating and boiling, so the crushing efficiency is high, and the rapid beating and boiling can be realized. Meanwhile, the large space for avoiding the rise of the soybean milk and the overflow of foam is not required to be reserved in the crushing cup, so the crushing cup has a small volume.

content_cn: 本申请涉及一种扫地机器人及清洁设备，包括壳体、滚刷及刮条组件，壳体具有滚刷腔及与滚刷腔连通的吸尘口，滚刷可转动地设于壳体内，刮条组件包括刮条，刮条与壳体转动连接，刮条具有面向滚刷的一侧的第一导尘面，且第一导尘面的一端伸出壳体，另一端与吸尘口连通，在扫地机器人沿第一方向移动时，刮条位于滚刷下游且具有正常状态及遇障状态。当刮条处于正常状态，第一导尘面与第二方向呈第一预设锐角，当扫地机器人处于遇障状态，刮条相对固定件转动至第一导尘面与第二方向呈第二预设锐角，第一方向和第二方向相反，且第二预设锐角小于第一预设锐角。如此，能够保证刮条的第一导尘面在各种状态下的倾斜导尘作用。
content_en: The sweeping robot comprises a shell, a rolling brush and a scraping strip assembly, the shell is provided with a rolling brush cavity and a dust suction opening communicated with the rolling brush cavity, the rolling brush is rotatably arranged in the shell, the scraping strip assembly comprises a scraping strip, the scraping strip is rotatably connected with the shell, the scraping strip is provided with a first dust guide face facing one side of the rolling brush, and the first dust guide face is provided with a second dust guide face facing one side of the rolling brush. When the sweeping robot moves in the first direction, the scraping strip is located on the downstream portion of the rolling brush and has a normal state and an obstacle encountering state. When the scraping strip is in a normal state, the first dust guiding face and the second direction form a first preset acute angle, when the sweeping robot is in an obstacle encountering state, the scraping strip rotates relative to the fixing piece till the first dust guiding face and the second direction form a second preset acute angle, the first direction is opposite to the second direction, and the second preset acute angle is smaller than the first preset acute angle. In this way, the inclined dust guiding effect of the first dust guiding face of the scraping strip in various states can be guaranteed.

content_cn: 本实用新型是一种洗碗机发热管的支撑装置，包括发热管(1)，其中发热管(1)通过其两竖端(11)固定在水槽(2)内，中间部分(12)悬空，其特征在于所述发热管(1)悬空端与水槽(2)之间设有支撑架(3)。本实用新型由于发热管悬空端与水槽之间设有支撑架，发热管悬空端通过支撑架支撑，因此，其能够使发热管在运输过程或洗碗机洗涤过程中不会产生振动，确保发热管不受损害，而且大大提高了发热管与水槽之间密封性。
content_en: The utility model discloses a supporting device for a heating tube of a dishwasher, which comprises the heating tube (1), wherein the heating tube (1) is fixed in a sink (2) through two vertical ends of the heating tube (1), and the middle part (12) of the heating tube is hung in the air. The device is characterized in that a supporting frame (3) is arranged between the free end of the heating tube (1) and the sink (2). The supporting frame (3) is arranged between the free end of the heating tube and the sink, and the free end of the heating tube is supported through the supporting frame, so the device can ensure that the heating tube can not produce vibration during the transportation or the washing of the dishwasher, and ensure that the heating tube can not be damaged, thereby greatly improving the sealing performance between the heating tube and the sink.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种电压力锅的过压保护装置和具有其的电压力锅，所述电压力锅包括外锅和内锅，所述内锅的底部设有随内锅内压力可上下移动的加热件，所述过压保护装置包括：下座；上座，所述上座可活动地安装在下座上；动触点和静触点，所述动触点和静触点分别设在所述下座和上座的至少一个上；连接结构，所述连接结构设在上座和下座之间以使动触点和静触点闭合和断开；以及触发件，所述触发件由加热件驱动推动下座相对于上座移动触动连接结构。根据本发明的过压保护装置，可通过触发件触动连接结构以将静触点与动触点断开，从而起到了过压断电保护的作用，避免过压掀盖或爆锅，可靠性高且结构简单。
content_en: The invention discloses an overpressure protection device of an electric pressure cooker, and the electric pressure cooker with the same. The electric pressure cooker comprises an outer cooker body and an inner cooker body, a heating member capable of moving up and down according to pressure in the inner cooker body is arranged at the bottom of the inner cooker body, the overpressure protection device comprises a lower seat, an upper seat, a movable contact, a static contact, a connecting structure and a triggering member, the upper seat is movably mounted on the lower seat, the movable contact and the static contact are arranged at least one of the lower seat and the upper seat, the connecting structure is arranged between the upper seat and the lower seat to enable the movable contact and the static contact to be on and off, and the triggering member is driven by the heating member to push the lower seat to move relatively to the upper seat to trigger the connecting structure. According to the overpressure protection device, the static contact and the movable contact can be off by triggering the connecting structure through the triggering member, so that overpressure power-off protection effect is realized, overpressure cover lifting or cooker bursting is avoided, and the overpressure protection device is high in reliability and simple in structure.

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种槽罐正压清洗设备的闭锁机构，包括与槽罐的槽罐口适配密封连接的压紧盖，所述压紧盖上安装有通向槽罐内部的蒸汽进气管和排污管，所述蒸汽进气管或排污管上还设有气阀锁紧机构，所述气阀锁紧机构的内侧与所述蒸汽进气管相连通，气阀锁紧机构的外侧与所述槽罐的槽罐壁适配闭合连接。本发明的正压蒸汽通过所述蒸汽进气管对所述槽罐内部进行清洗后，所产生的废液或废气经由所述排污管排出槽罐；因此，在保证槽罐内压力符合设备安全要求的条件，使蒸汽在槽罐内尽量充分利用，提高蒸汽热能使用率，减少大气污染，并能回收一定的物料(油品，化学品等)。
content_en: The invention relates to a locking mechanism of tank positive-pressure cleaning equipment. The mechanism comprises a pressure cover in matched and sealed connection with a tank opening of a tank. A steam inlet pipe and a drainage pipe communicated with the internal part of the tank are installed on the pressure cover. An air valve locking mechanism is also arranged on the steam inlet pipe or the drainage pipe. The inner side of the air valve locking mechanism is communicated with the steam inlet pipe. The outer side of the air valve locking mechanism is in matched and closed connection with the tank wall of the tank. After the internal part of the tank is cleaned by positive-pressure steam through the steam inlet pipe, generated waste liquid or waste gas is discharged out of the tank through the drainage pipe; therefore, the pressure in the tank accords with the safety requirement conditions of the equipment; the steam in the tank is sufficiently utilized to the greatest extent; the use rate of the steam heat energy is increased; the atmospheric pollution is reduced; and a certain materials (oil products, chemical products and the like) can be recycled.

content_cn: 本实用新型实施例提供了一种旋振筛筛面堆料及破损预警装置，包括：激光雷达监测单元、称重单元和控制单元；所述激光雷达监测单元，与所述控制单元连接，安装在旋振筛的防尘盖上，用于监测筛面上料位高度；所述称重单元，与所述控制单元连接，用于称量合格产品的重量；所述控制单元，用于设定监测时长段，以及计算单位时长内合格产品重量。本实用新型实施例提供的旋振筛筛面堆料及破损预警装置，可以在旋振筛筛面发生堆料和/或筛面发生破损时，发出筛面异常报警。
content_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides a rotary vibrating screen surface stacking and damage early warning device. The rotary vibrating screen surface stacking and damage early warning device comprises a laser radar monitoring unit, a weighing unit and a control unit, the laser radar monitoring unit is connected with the control unit, is mounted on a dustproof cover of the rotary vibrating screen and is used for monitoring the height of the feeding level on the screen surface; the weighing unit is connected with the control unit and used for weighing qualified products; and the control unit is used for setting a monitoring duration section and calculating the weight of a qualified product in unit duration. According to the screen surface stacking and damage early warning device of the spin vibration screen, provided by the embodiment of the utility model, when the screen surface of the spin vibration screen is stacked and/or the screen surface is damaged, the abnormal alarm of the screen surface can be sent out.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开了一种水处理系统以及净水机，水处理系统包括：混气罐，混气罐内限定出混气腔，混气罐设有进水口、通气口和出水口，进水口、通气口和出水口均与混气腔连通；导气管，导气管与进水口、通气口连通；进气组件，进气组件与导气管连通；进水控制件和出水控制件，进水控制件与进水口连通，出水控制件与出水口连通。根据本实用新型实施例的水处理系统，可以使气体与混合腔内的水进行混合，在水中形成肉眼可见的微米级气泡和肉眼不可见的纳米级气泡，在利用带微泡的水清洗时，由于微气泡的物理特性，有效吸附污垢以及打破杂质黏结，达到更彻底的清洗效果。
content_en: The utility model discloses a water treatment system and a water purifier, the water treatment system comprises: a gas mixing tank, a gas mixing chamber is defined in the gas mixing tank, the gas mixing tank is provided with a water inlet, a gas vent and a water outlet, the water inlet, the gas vent and the water outlet are all communicated with the gas mixing chamber; the air guide pipe is communicated with the water inlet and the air vent; the air inlet assembly is communicated with the air guide pipe; the water inlet control piece is communicated with the water inlet, and the water outlet control piece is communicated with the water outlet. According to the water treatment system disclosed by the embodiment of the utility model, gas can be mixed with water in the mixing cavity, micron-scale bubbles visible to naked eyes and nano-scale bubbles invisible to naked eyes are formed in the water, and when the water with the micro-bubbles is used for cleaning, dirt is effectively adsorbed and impurity bonding is broken due to the physical characteristics of the micro-bubbles, so that the water treatment effect is improved. And a more thorough cleaning effect is achieved.

content_cn: 本发明涉及冷藏车技术领域，具体涉及一种防止冷凝水从出风口溢出的方法及其相关设备。其方法应用于冷藏车的空调系统中。方法包括：获取湿度检测器检测的湿度值；判断湿度值所在的湿度区间；若湿度值在高湿度区间，且持续时间达到第一预设时间，则通过挡板控制机构控制挡板上移；若湿度值在低度区间，且持续时间达到第二预设时间，则通过挡板控制机构控制挡板下移；根据挡板的移动距离调整风机的运行频率。本发明可以根据冷凝水量调节自动挡板的高度，避免冷凝水从冷藏车的出风口溢出，而且还根据挡板的移动距离调整制冷机组的运行频率，以使制冷量达标，制冷机组维持正常的体积即可，不会压缩冷藏车的运输空间，保证了运输效率。
content_en: The invention relates to the technical field of refrigerator cars, in particular to a method for preventing condensate water from overflowing from an air outlet and related equipment thereof. The method is applied to the air conditioning system of a refrigerator car. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a humidity value detected by a humidity detector; judging a humidity interval where the humidity value is located; if the humidity value is in the high-humidity interval and the duration time reaches the first preset time, controlling a baffle to move upwards through a baffle control mechanism; if the humidity value is in the low-degree interval and the duration time reaches second preset time, controlling a baffle to move downwards through the baffle control mechanism; and adjusting the operation frequency of the fan according to the moving distance of the baffle. The height of the automatic baffle can be adjusted according to the condensate water amount, condensate water is prevented from overflowing from the air outlet of the refrigerator car, the operation frequency of the refrigerating unit is adjusted according to the moving distance of the baffle so that the refrigerating capacity can reach the standard, the refrigerating unit can maintain the normal size, the transportation space of the refrigerator car cannot be compressed, and the transportation efficiency is guaranteed.

content_cn: 本实用新型提供了一种电机支架自动锁螺钉装置，包括取放机构、锁附机构和动力机构；所述取放机构取放电机支架的组件到所述锁附机构，并将螺钉送入所述锁附机构；所述锁附机构将螺钉锁附在所述电机支架的组件中；所述取放机构将完成螺钉锁附后的电机支架的组件推送出去；所述动力机构与所述取放机构和所述锁附机构相连接，用于为所述取放机构和所述锁附机构提供动力。其代替了人工对电机支架组件进行组装及螺钉锁附，提高了自动化程度和生产效率，降低了劳动强度，同时消除了人工漏打螺钉的质量事故隐患，提高了产品的质量。
content_en: The utility model provides an automatic screw locking device for motor supports. The automatic screw locking device for the motor supports comprises a taking and placing mechanism, a locking mechanism and a power mechanism. The taking and placing mechanism is used for taking and placing assemblies of the motor supports to the locking mechanism and sending screws into the locking mechanism. The locking mechanism locks the screws into the assemblies of the motor supports. The taking and placing mechanism pushes out the assemblies of the motor supports, wherein screw locking of the assemblies of the motor supports are completed. The power mechanism is connected with the taking and placing mechanism and the locking mechanism and used for providing power for the taking and placing mechanism and the locking mechanism. The automatic screw locking device for the motor supports replaces manual assembling and screw locking of the assemblies of the motor supports, increases the degree of automation and the production efficiency, relieves the labor intensity, meanwhile, eliminates potential quality accident hazards caused due to the fact that screws are forgotten to be driven manually and improves the product quality.

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种核壳结构的MFI分子筛及其制备方法。所述的MFI分子筛以微米级Silicalite-1分子筛为核相，以纳米ZSM-5分子筛为壳相，壳层的厚度为10～50nm；分子筛的硅铝比为34～100，Silicalite-1与ZSM-5的重量比为4∶1～10∶1。本发明分子筛的制备方法为，首先通过浸渍将活性金属负载在Silicalite-1分子筛上，然后将负载活性金属的纯硅分子筛置于ZSM-5分子筛生长母液中进行水热晶化而制得。本发明复合分子筛可应用于石油化工等领域，是一种很好的催化材料，其在芳烃烷基化，芳烃异构化及甲烷芳构化和烷烃加氢异构等方面都具有很好的催化性能。
content_en: The invention relates to a core-shell structure MFI molecular sieve and its preparation method. The MFI molecular sieve takes micron-sized Silicalite<-1> molecular sieve as a core phase, a nano ZSM<-5> molecular sieve as a shell phase, the thickness of a shell layer is 10-50nm; the silica-alumina ratio of the molecular sieve is 34-100, the weight ratio of Silicalite<-1> to ZSM<-5> is 4:1-10:1. The method for preparing the molecular sieve comprises the following steps: dipping and loading the active metal on the Silicalite<-1> molecular sieve, placing the pure silicon molecular sieve loaded with active metal in ZSM<-5> molecular sieve growth mother liquor for hydrothermal crystallization. The composite molecular sieve is applied to petroleum chemical industry filed, is a good catalytic material, and has good catalysis performance on the aspects of aromatic hydrocarbon isomerization, methane aromatization and alkane hydrogenation isomerization.

content_cn: 本发明公开一种脱金属催化剂载体的制备方法，包括如下步骤：（1）对失活加氢脱金属催化剂进行抽提、焙烧、筛分，所述焙烧温度为500~600℃，焙烧时间为5~10h；（2）采用有机酸溶液对步骤（1）筛分后的催化剂进行饱和浸渍处理，浸渍后进行过滤，干燥；（3）将步骤（3）干燥后的催化剂进行水蒸气处理；（4）将步骤（4）水蒸气处理后催化剂进行干燥、高温焙烧吹扫，气体采用快速冷凝回收金属，剩余固体作为脱金属催化剂的氧化铝载体。该方法可将失活脱金属催化剂的载体及活性金属高效的重复利用。
content_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a demetalation catalyst carrier. The method comprises the following steps: 1) extracting deactivated hydrodemetalation catalyst, roasting the deactivated hydrodemetalation catalyst, and screening the deactivated hydrodemetalation catalyst, wherein the roasting temperature is 500-600 DEG C, and the roasting time is 5-10 h; 2) employing an organic acid solution for performing saturated impregnation on the catalyst, filtering the dipped catalyst, and drying the catalyst; 3) performing water vapor processing on the dried catalyst; and 4) drying the catalyst after water vapor processing, performing high temperature roasting and purging, employing rapid condensation on the gas to recover the metal, and taking the residual solid as an alumina carrier of the demetalation catalyst. The method can reuse the carrier of the deactivated hydrodemetalation catalyst and active metal.

content_cn: 本发明属于外包装套箱技术领域，涉及一种纸箱拆垛装置，纸箱拆垛装置包括框架以及与框架连接的提升组件、拆分组件和定位组件；若干个成垛纸箱位于提升组件上，并且在提升组件的作用下上升，之后拆分组件抓取成垛纸箱中最上层的纸箱并将其转移至定位组件上，定位组件对纸箱进行定位。本发明通过提升组件、拆分组件以及定位组件之间的相互配合，实现了将成垛纸箱进行拆分后，将单个纸箱移动到固定位置的目的，且整个过程均是通过自动化实现的，相较于传统通过人为拆分和移动的方式，本发明降低了人工的劳动强度，实现了整个过程的自动化。
content_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of outer packing box sleeving, and relates to a carton unstacking device which comprises a frame, a lifting assembly, an unstacking assembly and a positioning assembly, and the lifting assembly, the unstacking assembly and the positioning assembly are connected with the frame. A plurality of stacked cartons are located on the lifting assembly and ascend under the action of the lifting assembly, then the carton on the uppermost layer in the stacked cartons is grabbed by the disassembling assembly and transferred to the positioning assembly, and the carton is positioned by the positioning assembly. Through mutual cooperation of the lifting assembly, the disassembling assembly and the positioning assembly, the purpose of moving a single carton to a fixed position after the stacks of cartons are disassembled is achieved, the whole process is automatically achieved, compared with a traditional manual disassembling and moving mode, the labor intensity of workers is reduced, and the working efficiency is improved. And automation of the whole process is realized.

content_cn: 本申请公开了一种取料控制方法和装置。该方法包括：在控制机械手从目标料垛的上方下移的过程中，检测机械手是否接触到目标料垛顶部的物料，其中，目标料垛由多个型号相同的物料从上至下码砌而成；在机械手接触到目标料垛顶部的物料的情况下，记录机械手的当前位置；根据机械手的当前位置和目标料垛中的物料的厚度控制机械手依次取走目标料垛中的物料。通过本申请，解决了相关技术中采用机械手取料时，需要人工获知料垛中的物料的位置，取料效率低的问题。
content_en: The invention discloses a fetching control method and device. The fetching control method comprises the steps that when a manipulator is controlled to move downwards from a position above a target material stack, whether or not the manipulator touches a material at the top of the target material stack is detected, wherein the target material stack is formed by stacking a plurality of materials ofthe same type from top to bottom; under the condition that the manipulator touches the material at the top of the target material stack, the current position of the manipulator is recorded; and the manipulator is controlled to sequentially take the materials from the target material stack according to the current position of the manipulator and the thickness of the materials in the target materialstack. By adoption of the fetching control method and device, the problem that in the prior art, when a manipulator is used for fetching materials, the positions of the materials in a material stackneed to be obtained manually, and consequentially, the fetching efficiency is low is solved.

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种催化剂原位再生装置，主要解决现有技术中需要器外烧焦再生的问题。本发明通过采用一种催化剂原位再生装置，所述装置包括配气系统、原位再生器、加热炉、冷却器、气液分离器、分析系统、控制系统，配气系统入口接有气体入口管线，出口与原位再生器相连，原位再生器外设有加热炉，内部插有热电偶，原位再生器出口与依次与冷却器、气液分离器相连，气液分离器的气相出口与分析系统相连，所述控制系统采用PLC的技术方案较好地解决了上述问题，可用于催化剂失活的原位再生中。
content_en: The invention relates to an in-situ regeneration device for a catalyst. The in-situ regeneration device is mainly used for solving the problem in the prior art that device-outside scorching regeneration is required. According to the in-situ regeneration device for the catalyst, through adopting the technical scheme that the in-situ regeneration device for the catalyst comprises a gas distributingsystem, an in-situ regenerator, a heating furnace, a cooler, a gas-liquid separator, an analysis system and a control system, an inlet of the gas distributing system is connected with a gas inlet pipeline, an outlet of the gas distributing system is connected with the in-situ regenerator, the heating furnace is arranged outside the in-situ regenerator, a thermocouple is inserted inside the in-situregenerator, an outlet of the in-situ regenerator is connected with the cooler and the gas-liquid separator sequentially, a gas-phase outlet of the gas-liquid separator is connected with the analysissystem, and the control system employs a PLC (Programmable Logic Controller), the above problem is better solved, and thus, the in-situ regeneration device can be applied to deactivated in-situ regeneration of the catalyst.

content_cn: 本发明涉及高分子合成领域，公开了一种聚合物连续反应方法和聚合物连续反应装置，该聚合物连续反应方法包括：将聚合物单体溶液雾化形成液滴，所述液滴在流动的状态下与连续加入的引发剂混合并发生反应。本发明所述聚合物连续反应方法和聚合物连续反应装置强化了反应器中的液液相混合，对于提高反应转化率、产品产率并降低能耗极为关键。
content_en: The invention relates to the field of polymer synthesis, and discloses a polymer continuous reaction method and a polymer continuous reaction device. The polymer continuous reaction method comprises atomizing a polymer monomer solution to form droplets, and mixing the droplets in a flowing state with a continuously-added initiator for reaction. The continuous polymer reaction method and the continuous polymer reaction device strengthen liquid-liquid mixing in a reactor, and are critical to increase of the reaction conversion rate and the product yield and the reduction of energy consumption.

content_cn: 本发明公开一种用于劣质渣油悬浮床加氢裂化的油溶性催化剂。其特征在于本发明的催化剂是Mo、W金属与苯胲及其衍生物反应所得的化合物。催化剂能均匀溶解在重、渣油中，并且在氢气存在下，使含有催化剂的劣质重、渣油通过悬浮床加氢裂化为轻质产品。其目的在于降低催化剂成本的前提下，提高重、渣油悬浮床加氢裂化轻质产品的收率。
content_en: The oil-soluble catalyst is a compound obtained by using metals of Mo and W and making them react with phenylhydroxylamine and its derivative. Said catalyst can be uniformly dissolved in heavy and residual oil, and in the presence of hydrogen gas the poor heavy and residual oil containing said catalyst can be passed through the suspended bed, and hydrogenated and cracked to obtain high product. Said invention is aimed at reducing catalyst cost and raising yield rate of light product.

content_cn: 本发明涉及接枝有机硅改性丙烯酸酯共聚乳液,主要解决以往乳液存在稳定性差的问题。本发明通过采用以重量百分比计包括:(a)含不饱和双键的活性有机硅大分子1～30%,(b)亲水性不饱和酸单体1～20%,(c)疏水性不饱和单体50～97%的技术方案,较好地解决了以往技术中存在的缺点,使共聚乳液的机械稳定性比以往技术提高了近60%,可用于涂料工业生产中。
content_en: The present ivnention adopts (wt%) 1-30% of active organosilicon macromolecular containing unsaturated double bond, 1-20 % of hydrophilic unsaturated acid monomer and 50-97% of hydrophobic unsaturated monomer to prepare the invented graft organosilicon modified polyacrylate copolymer emulsion. As compared with existent technique its mechanical stability can be raised by aobut 60%. It can be used in production of coating industry.

content_cn: 本发明提供一种泥质烃源岩黏粒级中不同赋存态饱和烃和芳香烃分离方法，该方法包括：步骤1，将泥质烃源岩岩心新鲜部分粉碎，并将粉碎后的该岩心新鲜部分进行浸泡提取黏粒级组分；步骤2，用正己烷、二氯甲烷对黏粒级组分分别进行索氏抽提；步骤3，用皂化液对抽提残渣进行皂化处理并对皂化残渣用正戊烷、二氯甲烷分别抽提；步骤4，用酸解液对皂化残渣进行酸处理并对酸处理残渣分别用正戊烷、二氯甲烷抽提；步骤5，用HF、HCl混合液对酸解残渣进行处理并分别用正戊烷、二氯甲烷对酸解残渣抽提；以及步骤6，分别合并步骤2、步骤3、步骤4和步骤5中的各处理液以及抽提液并用柱层析分离得到饱和烃和芳香烃。
content_en: The invention provides a separation method for light/heavy hydrocarbons in different occurrent states in a clay level of an argillaceous source rock. The separation method comprises the following steps: crushing a fresh part of a core of the argillaceous source rock and soaking and extracting a clay level component; carrying out Soxhlet extraction; saponifying the extraction residues by using a saponifying liquid and respectively extracting the saponified residues by using n-pentane and dichloromethane; pickling the saponified residues by using an acidolysis solution and respectively extracting the pickled residues by using n-pentane and dichloromethane; treating the pickled residues by a HF and HCl mixed liquid and respectively extracting the pickled residues by using n-pentane and dichloromethane; and respectively combining the treatment liquids and the extraction liquids and separating by column chromatography to obtain light/heavy hydrocarbons. The separation method for light/heavy hydrocarbons in different occurrent states in the clay level of the argillaceous source rock provided by the invention extremely improves the problem that light hydrocarbons are lost in other methods and can calibrate an occurrent space of hydrocarbons by combining mineral analysis.

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种新型碳基吸附材料及其制备方法，主要解决现有吸附回收材料在高湿度环境下疏水性差、吸附目标有机物分子容量低、真空脱附难度高、吸脱附速率慢的问题。本发明通过采用一种新型碳基吸附材料及其制备方法，以间苯二酚或间苯三酚、冰醋酸为反应原料，甲醛水溶液为反应溶剂，经过溶胶凝胶‑冷冻干燥和碳化活化过程制得疏水型高比表面积碳基吸附材料的技术方案较好地解决了上述问题，可用于工程材料技术中。
content_en: The invention relates to a new carbon-based adsorption material and a preparation method thereof, mainly solving the problem that an adsorption recovery material is poor in hydrophobicity, low in capacity of adsorbing target organic matter molecules, severe in difficulty of vacuum desorption, and low in adsorption/desorption rate in a high-humidity environment. According to the preparation method, resorcinol or m-trihydroxybenzene and gracial acetate acid are taken as reaction raw materials, a formaldehyde aqueous solution is taken as a reaction solvent, and the high-specific-surface-area carbon-based adsorption material is prepared through a process of sol gel freeze drying and carbonization activation, so that the problem is well solved. The new carbon-based adsorption material can be used in engineering material technology.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种制备环己醇和环己酮的方法，该方法是首先用含氧气体氧化环己烷生成含环己基过氧化氢的氧化液，然后用强碱溶液萃取氧化液得到含环己基过氧化氢的碱性水相和环己烷有机相，含环己基过氧化氢的碱性水相在高沸点溶剂存在下进行分解反应，分解液沉降分离后，蒸馏有机相得到环己醇和环己酮的混合物，萃取后的环己烷溶液返回至环己烷氧化反应过程；该方法能大大提高环己烷氧化选择性，降低环己烷蒸馏能耗。
content_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing hexamethylene and cyclohexanone. The method comprises the following steps: oxidizing cyclohexane with oxygen-containing gas to generate oxidized liquid containing cyclohexyl hydroperoxide, extracting the oxidized liquid with strong alkaline solution to obtain an alkaline water phase containing cyclohexyl hydroperoxide and a cyclohexane organic phase,performing a decomposition reaction on the alkaline water phase containing cyclohexyl hydroperoxide in the presence of a high boiling point solvent, performing settling separation on decomposition liquid and distilling the organic phase to obtain a mixture of hexamethylene and cyclohexanone, and returning cyclohexane solution after extraction to a cyclohexane oxidation reaction process. Accordingto the method, the cyclohexane oxidation selectivity can be greatly improved, and the energy consumption for distillation of cyclohexane is reduced.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种用于降低氧化物制备过程中引入的杂质离子含量的方法。杂质离子包括K+、Na+、SO42-、X-（X=F,Cl,Br,I）等其中一种或一种以上，无法利用水洗或在后续焙烧阶段完全除去。本发明采用极性、低沸点且与水互溶的有机物，包括甲醇、乙醇、丙醇和丙酮等一种或一种以上混合物为洗涤溶剂。氧化物前躯体滤饼经过至少一次有限次水洗后，滤饼再使用上述溶剂进一步洗涤，最终得到的氧化物的杂质含量能够得到大大降低。
content_en: The invention discloses a method for reducing the content of impurity ions introduced during preparation of oxides. The impurity ions comprise one or more of K<+>, Na<+>, SO4<2-> , X<-> (X=F, Cl, Br and I) and the like, and cannot be completely removed by water washing or in a subsequent roasting stage. The washing solvent in the method is an organic substance which has chemical polarity, and is low in boiling point and miscible with water, and is one or a mixture of methanol, ethanol, propanol, acetone and the like. The filter cake of an oxide precursor is subjected to at least one time or finite repeated times of water washing and then is further washed by the above solvent, so that finally the obtained oxides have substantially reduced impurity content.

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种制备高官能度高度支化的聚脲的方法。一种或多种脲被一种或多种具有至少两个伯和/或仲氨基的胺转化。至少一种胺包含至少三个伯和/或仲氨基。
content_en: The invention relates to a method for the production of highly functional, highly branched polyureas. One or several ureas are transformed by means of one or several amines having at least two primary and/or secondary amino groups. At least one amine comprises at least three primary and/or secondary amino groups.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种苯乙烯氧化的方法，在氧化反应条件下，将苯乙烯与氧化剂接触，其特征在于，所述氧化剂为含有臭氧的气体。该方法苯乙醛选择性高，在含钛催化剂存在下，环氧苯乙烷的选择性有大幅度提高。
content_en: The invention discloses a method for oxidizing styrene. According to the method, the styrene comes into contact with an oxidant under the condition of oxidation reaction. The method is characterized in that the oxidant is an ozone-containing gas. According to the method, the phenylacetaldehyde selectivity is high, and the selectivity of styrene oxide is greatly improved in the presence of a titanium-containing catalyst.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种用于烯烃聚合的催化剂组分及其制备方法和用途，它包含至少一种有机镁化合物，至少一种液态含钛化合物，至少一种含羟基类化合物和至少一种含氯有机硼化合物以及至少一种改性添加剂的反应产物，该改性添加剂为聚苯乙烯嵌段聚丁二烯类聚合物。制备的催化剂除具有良好的氢调性能，同时还具有良好的颗粒形态及分布，从而更有利于催化剂在气相、淤浆等聚合工艺装置上的使用。
content_en: The invention provides a catalyst ingredient for olefin polymerization, a preparation method and purpose thereof. The catalyst includes reaction products of at least one organo-magnesium compound, at least one liquid titanium-containing compound, at least one hydroxy-containing compound, at least one chlorine-containing organo aluminium compound and at least one property-modifying additive; the property-modifying additive is polystyrene block polybutadiene polymer. The prepared catalyst has good hydrogen regulation performance as well as good particle form and distribution and higher bulk density, so as to facilitate usage of the catalyst in apparatuses for gas phase and slurry polymerization technologies.

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种重整生成油非临氢脱烯烃方法，主要解决现有技术稳定性差，需频繁更换白土，造成劳动强度大，环境污染严重，芳烃损失大的问题。本发明通过采用一种以重量份数计含有10～90份的分子筛，以元素计，0.01～2.00份至少一种选自Cl、Br、S中的元素或其氧化物，0.05～5份选自F、P元素中的至少一种或其氧化物，10～90份氧化铝或氧化硅粘结剂的催化剂，在120～240℃，0.5～3.0MPa以及0.3～20h-1条件下，使重整生成油中的烯烃在催化剂上发生聚合或烷基化反应而除去的技术方案，较好地解决了该问题，可用于重整生成油非临氢脱烯烃工业生产中。
content_en: The invention relates to a method for removing olefin of reformate in a non-hydrogenation manner, which mainly solves the problems of large labor intensity, serious environment pollution and large aromatic hydrocarbon loss caused by frequently changing carclazyte because of poor stability in the prior art. The olefin in the reformate is removed by the polymerization or alkylation reaction on a catalyst containing the following components in parts by weight of 10-90 parts of molecular sieve, 0.01-2.00 parts of at least one element selected from Cl, Br and S or oxides thereof, 0.05-5 parts of F and/or P or oxides thereof, 10-90 parts of alumina or silicon oxide adhering agent under the conditions of 120-240 DEG C, 0.5-3.0MPa and 0.3-20h<-1>. The invention can be used in the industrialized production concerning the removal of the olefin in the reformate in non-hydrogenation manner.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种低等规聚丙烯催化剂，包括活性组分、助催化剂、和结构如式I所示的外给电子体化合物；其中，R1选自氢或C1～C4直链或支化的脂族基团；R2-R11各自独立地选自氢、直链脂族基团、支化或环状的脂族基团。本发明还提供了一种低等规聚丙烯的制备方法以及由该方法制备得到的低等规聚丙烯。
content_en: The invention discloses a low isotatic polypropylene catalyst which comprises an active component, a catalyst promoter and an external donor compound represented as the formula I, wherein R1 is selected from hydrogen or C1-C4 linear chain or branching aliphatic groups; R2-R11 are independently selected from hydrogen, linear chain aliphatic groups, and branching or annular aliphatic groups. The invention further provides a preparation method of low isotatic polypropylene and low isotatic polypropylene prepared with the method.

content_cn: 本发明属于清洗设备技术领域，具体公开了一种喷淋洗衣机，该喷淋洗衣机包括护型装置和衣物处理筒，护型装置包括一中空壳状的笼体，笼体从上至下设置有安装部和镂空的衣物护型部，在衣物护型部上设置有衣托部；衣物处理筒包括底壁和侧壁，底壁的中部设有一笼体形状适配且固定支撑笼体的凸台。本发明的喷淋洗衣机具有对衣物清洗的变形损伤低、洗净率高、洗净均匀的优点。
content_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cleaning equipment, and particularly discloses a spraying washing machine. The spraying washing machine comprises a shape protecting device and a clothes processing barrel; the shape protecting device comprises a hollow shell-shaped cage body; the cage body is provided with a mounting part and a hollowed-out clothes shape protecting part from top to bottom, and a clothes supporting part is arranged on the clothes shape protecting part; the clothes processing barrel comprises a bottom wall and a side wall; and a boss which is matched with the cage body in shape and fixedly supports the cage body is arranged in the middle of the bottom wall. The spraying washing machine has the advantages of being low in deformation damage to clothes cleaning, high in cleaning rate and uniform in cleaning.

content_cn: 本申请提供一种加热控制方法及干衣机，涉及智能家居领域。其中，该方法应用于干衣机，且该方法包括：控制第一继电器或第二继电器处于闭合状态；获取温度传感器检测到的第一温度信息，第一温度信息用于指示滚筒进风口的温度是否发生变化；根据第一继电器或第二继电器的闭合状态，以及第一温度信息，确定干衣机的加热类型是否为电加热类型；若加热类型为电加热类型，则根据电加热控制逻辑，控制干衣机工作。本申请的方法，使得电加热干衣机与燃气加热干衣机共用一套加热控制方法，为干衣机的管控、售后、检测等环节提供便利，同时有利于实现干衣机的精准控制。
content_en: The invention provides a heating control method and a clothes dryer, and relates to the field of smart home. The method is applied to the clothes dryer and comprises the steps that a first relay or a second relay is controlled to be in a closed state; acquiring first temperature information detected by a temperature sensor, wherein the first temperature information is used for indicating whether the temperature of the air inlet of the roller is changed or not; according to the closed state of the first relay or the second relay and the first temperature information, whether the heating type of the clothes dryer is an electric heating type or not is determined; if the heating type is an electric heating type, the clothes dryer is controlled to work according to electric heating control logic. According to the method, the electric heating clothes dryer and the fuel gas heating clothes dryer share one heating control method, convenience is provided for links such as management and control, after-sale and detection of the clothes dryer, and meanwhile accurate control over the clothes dryer can be achieved easily.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种洗涤装置，包括盛水单元，用于盛放洗涤水；第一通道，两端分别与盛水单元连通；第二通道，一端为进风口，另一端为出风口；湿气转运件，分别与第一通道、第二通道连通，用于将第一通道内的湿气转运至第二通道中；湿气转运件具有吸附区，与第一通道连通，用于吸附盛水单元排出到第一通道内的湿气；脱附区，与第二通道连通，用于接收吸附区内吸附的湿气，通过第二通道的出风口排出。本发明在吸附区吸附第一通道内的湿气，转移至脱附区脱离并通过第二通道的出风口排出，避免盛水单元发霉异味，能够将大风量、低浓度水汽的气体浓缩为小风量、高浓度的水汽，从而降低投入和运行成本，提高盛水单元干燥效率。
content_en: The invention discloses a washing device which comprises a water containing unit used for containing washing water; two ends of the first channel are respectively communicated with the water containing unit; one end of the second channel is an air inlet, and the other end is an air outlet; the moisture transfer part communicates with the first channel and the second channel and is used for transferring moisture in the first channel into the second channel; the moisture transfer part is provided with an adsorption area, is communicated with the first channel and is used for adsorbing moisture discharged into the first channel by the water containing unit; and the desorption area is communicated with the second channel and is used for receiving the moisture adsorbed in the adsorption area and discharging the moisture through an air outlet of the second channel. Moisture in the first channel is adsorbed in the adsorption area, is transferred to the desorption area to be separated and is discharged through the air outlet of the second channel, so that mildew and peculiar smell of the water containing unit are avoided, gas with large air volume and low-concentration water vapor can be concentrated into small air volume and high-concentration water vapor, the investment and operation cost is reduced, and the drying efficiency of the water containing unit is improved.

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种干衣机，属于干衣机技术领域，该干衣机包括箱体及连接于所述箱体的后盖板，所述箱体与所述后盖板之间设置有密封室，所述密封室用于对所述箱体上的轴承进行密封。本发明通过在箱体与盖板之间设置密封室，对设置于箱体上的轴承进行隔离，避免了轴承直接暴露于箱体与后盖板之间的风路中，可以有效防止了轴承温度过高，以及有效防止了油脂长期处于高温环境下容易损耗，最终导致轴承转动不畅，使机器产生异音的情况。
content_en: The invention relates to a clothes dryer, and belongs to the technical field of clothes dryers. The clothes dryer comprises a box body and a rear cover plate connected to the box body. A sealing chamber is arranged between the box body and the rear cover plate, and the sealing chamber is used for sealing a bearing on the box body. The sealing chamber is arranged between the box body and the coverplate, the bearing arranged on the box body is isolated, it is avoided that the bearing is directly exposed in an air way between the box body and the rear cover plate, the situation that the temperature of the bearing is too high can be effectively avoided, and the situation that grease is easily lost when located in the high-temperature environment for a long time, finally, rotation of the bearing is not smooth, and abnormal noise of a machine is generated is effectively avoided.

content_cn: 本公开提供了一种洗衣机的故障处理方法、装置及洗衣机，所述方法包括在检测到所述洗衣机发生故障的情况下，获取所述故障导致所述洗衣机不可使用的功能；若所述故障导致所述洗衣机的部分功能不可使用，则发送第一提示信息，所述第一提示信息用于提示用户正常使用的功能；若所述故障导致所述洗衣机的全部功能不可使用，则发送第二提示信息，所述第二提示信息用于提示用户所述洗衣机故障，通过向用户发送不同的提示信息，使用户了解故障影响到的洗衣机功能，在故障导致部分功能不可使用的情况下，用户可以根据第一提示信息使用能够正常使用的功能。
content_en: The invention provides a fault processing method and device for a washing machine and the washing machine, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the unusable function of the washing machine caused by a fault under the condition that the fault of the washing machine is detected; if part of functions of the washing machine cannot be used due to the fault, first prompt information is sent, and the first prompt information is used for prompting a user of the normally used function; if all functions of the washing machine cannot be used due to the fault, second prompt information is sent, the second prompt information is used for prompting a user of the fault of the washing machine, different prompt information is sent to the user, so that the user knows the functions of the washing machine influenced by the fault, and under the condition that part of the functions cannot be used due to the fault, the user can know the functions of the washing machine influenced by the fault. And the user can use the function which can be normally used according to the first prompt information.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开了一种过滤器安装架及干衣机，属于电器设备技术领域。过滤器安装架包括安装架本体和传感器支架，安装架本体具有容置腔，容置腔用于容置线屑过滤器，安装架本体的前端面上具有通风区和与容置腔隔断的安装区，传感器支架连接在安装区上，湿度传感器安装于传感器支架背离安装架本体的一侧，且其插接端子置于传感器支架内部。该过滤器安装架通过专门设置传感器支架，并将传感器支架设置在安装区上，从而使湿度传感器和传感器支架独立出来，湿度传感器的插接端子插入传感器支架内部，避免了插接端子发生线屑积累现象以及长时间与潮湿空气接触，降低了湿度传感器误判甚至失效现象的发生，提高了湿度传感器的工作精度。
content_en: The utility model discloses a filter mounting rack and a clothes dryer, and belongs to the technical field of electrical equipment. The filter mounting rack comprises a mounting rack body and a sensor support, the mounting rack body is provided with a containing cavity, the containing cavity is used for containing a thread scrap filter, the front end face of the mounting rack body is provided with a ventilation area and a mounting area separated from the containing cavity, and the sensor support is connected to the mounting area. The humidity sensor is installed on the side, away from the installation frame body, of the sensor support, and a plug-in terminal of the humidity sensor is arranged in the sensor support. According to the filter mounting frame, the sensor bracket is specially arranged and is arranged on the mounting area, so that the humidity sensor and the sensor bracket are independent, and a plug terminal of the humidity sensor is inserted into the sensor bracket, so that the phenomenon that wire scraps are accumulated on the plug terminal and the plug terminal is in contact with humid air for a long time is avoided; the occurrence of the phenomena of erroneous judgment and even failure of the humidity sensor is reduced, and the working precision of the humidity sensor is improved.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种投放装置及洗衣机、洗衣机液体静电除菌方法，涉及家电技术领域，解决了需要使用大量洗涤剂清洗衣物和冗杂反复的清洗流程的问题。当所述压力腔压强大于喷雾装置压强时，混合液穿过所述电离雾化组件呈细长柱状液高速进入喷雾装置内撞击形成带电雾滴，带电雾滴喷入洗衣机洗涤桶中与湿润衣物接触开始放电，完成对衣物吸附杂质和杀菌工序。快速清除大量污渍并使其分离，有效地减少洗涤流程，能够一定量的杀死部分高温下不易杀死的细菌、病毒等。
content_en: The invention discloses a putting device, a washing machine and a washing machine liquid electrostatic sterilization method, relates to the technical field of household appliances, and solves the problems that a large amount of detergent needs to be used for cleaning clothes and the cleaning process is tedious and repeated. When the pressure intensity of the pressure cavity is larger than that of the spraying device, the mixed liquid penetrates through the ionization and atomization assembly to form thin and long columnar liquid and enters the spraying device at a high speed to be impacted to form electrified fog drops, the electrified fog drops are sprayed into a washing barrel of the washing machine and make contact with wet clothes to start discharging, and the procedures of adsorbing impurities and sterilizing the clothes are completed. A large amount of stains are rapidly removed and separated, the washing process is effectively reduced, and a certain amount of bacteria, viruses and the like which are not easy to kill at high temperature can be killed.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开了一种干衣机水盒装置及干衣机，水盒装置的盒体内形成用于存储冷凝水的储水腔，盒体的顶部设有进水口、底部设有排水口，排水口处设有用于封闭和打开排水口的密封塞，盒体上设有操作部，储水腔内设有驱动部，操作部动作以驱动驱动部运动，驱动部带动密封塞运动以将排水口封闭或打开。该水盒装置采用从水盒底部排出冷凝水的方式，便于操作排水，并且排水后不会有残留水。
content_en: A water storage cavity used for storing condensate water is formed in a box body of the water box device, a water inlet is formed in the top of the box body, a water outlet is formed in the bottom of the box body, a sealing plug used for closing and opening the water outlet is arranged at the water outlet, an operation portion is arranged on the box body, and a driving portion is arranged in the water storage cavity. The operation part acts to drive the driving part to move, and the driving part drives the sealing plug to move to close or open the water outlet. The water box device adopts a mode of discharging condensed water from the bottom of the water box, so that the operation and the drainage are convenient, and no residual water exists after the drainage.

content_cn: 本实用新型提供了一种投放装置及具有其的洗衣机，投放装置包括：本体部，本体部具有用于储存洗涤剂的存储腔，存储腔为至少两个；第一管路，第一管路与至少两个存储腔均可通断地设置，第一管路具有出液口，出液口用于与洗衣桶相连通。本实用新型的投放装置解决了现有技术中的投放装置的输送管路较多的问题。
content_en: The utility model provides a putting device and a washing machine with the putting device, the putting device comprises a body part, the body part is provided with at least two storage cavities used for storing detergent; the first pipeline and the at least two storage cavities are arranged in an on-off mode, the first pipeline is provided with a liquid outlet, and the liquid outlet is used for being communicated with a washing barrel. The feeding device solves the problem that in the prior art, the number of conveying pipelines of a feeding device is large.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种洗衣机控制方法及洗衣机，在初始水低于低温限值时，先进水达到第一设定水位时停止，开启加热装置对水加热来提高洗涤剂的活性；当加热至第一设定水温后关闭加热装置，进水直至指定水位后按照指定转停比执行洗涤程序，该指定转停比根据低温限值与初始水温的差值来确定，并与该差值呈正比例关系，实现低温时增加洗涤时长的效果，以增加洗涤时长的措施来弥补水温偏低对洗涤效果造成的影响；本发明以进少量水加热来提高洗涤剂的活性，在补水至指定水位后基于低温限值与初始水温的差值来适当提高转停比从而增加洗涤时长的控制来弥补水温偏低对洗涤效果造成的影响，在保证洗涤效果同时没有过分延长洗涤时长。
content_en: The invention discloses a washing machine control method and a washing machine. When initial water is lower than a low-temperature limit value and advanced water reaches a first set water level, the method is stopped, and a heating device is started to heat water to improve the activity of a detergent; the heating device is closed after the water is heated to the first set water temperature, the washing procedure is executed according to the specified rotation-stop ratio after the water is fed to the specified water level, and the specified rotation-stop ratio is determined according to the difference value between the low-temperature limit value and the initial water temperature and is in direct proportion to the difference value, so that the effect of increasing the washing duration at the low temperature is achieved; the measure of increasing the washing time is used for making up the influence of low water temperature on the washing effect; the activity of the detergent is improved by feeding a small amount of water for heating, the rotation-stop ratio is properly increased based on the difference value between the low-temperature limit value and the initial water temperature after the water is supplemented to the designated water level, so that the influence of the low water temperature on the washing effect is made up through control over the washing duration, and the washing duration is not excessively prolonged while the washing effect is guaranteed.

content_cn: 本实用新型提供了一种衣物护理机，所述衣物护理机设置有微处理器，所述衣物护理机包括：主机，设置有蒸汽通道、蒸汽手柄、蒸汽发生器和工频输入端，所述蒸汽通道连接于所述蒸汽手柄和所述蒸汽发生器之间，所述蒸汽发生器与所述微处理器连接；支架结构，设置有蒸汽手柄容纳部、支架杆和底座，所述蒸汽手柄容纳部用于放置所述蒸汽手柄，所述支架杆和所述底座可通过旋转结构组装在一起；衣物感应装置，连接至所述微处理器，所述微处理器根据所述衣物感应装置的感测结果对所述蒸汽发生器的工作状态进行控制。通过本实用新型技术方案，实现了衣物护理机的智能控制，节约功耗，提高了产品安全性，并让衣物护理机的支架可以旋转，提升了用户的使用体验。
content_en: The utility model provides a clothes caring machine. The clothes caring machine is provided with a microprocessor and comprises a main machine, a support structure and a clothes sensing device, wherein the main machine is provided with a steam passage, a steam handle, a steam generator and a power frequency input end, the steam passage is connected between the steam handle and the steam generator, and the steam generator is connected with the microprocessor; the support structure is provided with a steam handle accommodating part, a support rod and a base, the steam handle accommodating part is used for placing the steam handle, and the support rod and the base are assembled together through a rotary structure; the clothes sensing device is connected to the microprocessor, and the microprocessor controls the working states of the steam generator according to the sensing result of the clothes sensing device. By the arrangement, the clothes caring machine has the advantages that intelligent control of the clothes caring machine is achieved, power consumption is reduced, product safety is increased, the support of the clothes caring machine is rotatable, and user experience is increased.

content_cn: 本发明公开的示警控制方法、装置及干衣机，基于不同材质的衣物对过滤网趋污的影响程度不同，预先制定了衣物材质与校正系数间的对应关系，例如，具体可采用对单位重量的棉织物干衣单位时长所产生的毛屑量为参考基准，获取各种衣物材质所对应的校正系数。在此基础上，每次干衣后，在对干衣时长进行累计前，首先利用相应的校正系数对获取的实际干衣时长进行折合、校正，即累计所得的总时长实质为总校正时长，并在总校正时长达到预设阈值时，控制报警。可见，本发明通过依据不同材质的衣物对过滤网趋污的不同影响对干衣时长进行相应校正，提高了过滤网清洗提醒的参考价值及准确率。
content_en: The invention discloses a warning control method, a warning control device and a clothes drying machine. On the basis that clothes made of different materials have different influence degrees on filter net contamination, a corresponding relationship between the clothes materials and a correcting coefficient is made in advance, for example, the flock quantity generated in the unit duration of cotton fabric clothes drying in unit weight can be concretely adopted as the reference standard, and correcting coefficients corresponding to various clothes materials can be obtained. On the basis, after the clothes drying in each time and before the accumulation on the clothes drying duration, firstly, the corresponding correcting coefficient is used for calculating and correcting the obtained actual clothes drying duration, the accumulated and obtained total duration is actually the total correction duration, and when the total correction duration reaches a preset threshold, the warning is controlled. Therefore the method, the device and the clothes drying machine have the advantages that the clothes drying duration can be correspondingly corrected according to different influence of the clothes made of different materials on the filter net contamination, and the accuracy and the reference value of the filter net cleaning prompt are improved.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开了主动轮式高原抽油机移机装置，包括传动轴、滚轮、轴套、从动轮，所述传动轴为阶梯轴，传动轴两端设置有扳手，所述扳手为棘轮扳手，扳手上设置有换向开关，所述滚轮为防滑处理的圆轮，当给传动轴施加扭力时传动轴转动，带动滚轮与抽油机一起移动，从动轮起辅助减少摩擦的作用，防滑处理的滚轮增加附着力，解决轮子空转。高强度快速板手可保证施力时角度，减少多次调整板手费时费力问题。本实用新型比传统移机装置成本低。安装应用方便。
content_en: The utility model discloses a driving wheel type highland oil pumping unit moving device. The driving wheel type highland oil pumping unit moving device comprises a transmission shaft, rollers, a shaft sleeve and a driven wheel, wherein the transmission shaft is a stepped shaft; levers are arranged at two ends of the transmission shaft and are ratchet levers; each lever is provided with a reversing switch; and the rollers are anti-sliding round wheels. When a twisting force is applied to the transmission shaft, the transmission shaft rotates, the rollers and an oil pumping unit are driven to move together, the driven wheel has an effect of reducing friction, an adhesive force is improved by the anti-sliding roller, and idling of the rollers is avoided. The angle can be guaranteed during force application by the high-strength quick levers, and the problem that the time and the labor are wasted due to the fact that the levers are adjusted repeatedly is solved. Compared with the traditional oil pumping unit moving device, the driving wheel type highland oil pumping unit moving device is low in cost and convenient to mount and use.

content_cn: 本发明涉及烹饪设备及其面板开合控制装置及打开控制方法，打开控制方法包括：接收面板开启信号；控制驱动机构以逐级增大的占空比渐进式推动面板打开；控制驱动机构以逐级增大的占空比渐进式推动面板打开包括：驱动机构以设定占空比推动面板，并且判断驱动机构当前的实际堵转电流是否小于堵转电流阈值：若是，则控制驱动机构继续以当前占空比推动面板，直至判断到面板已打开到位，停止驱动；若否，则控制驱动机构重新启动并以大于当前占空比的下一级别的占空比推动面板。本发明在面板开启过程中控制驱动机构以逐渐增大的占空比逐级推动面板，可以有效地避免驱动机构以最大占空比推动面板容易产生机械卡滞，误判率高，打开成功率低的问题。
content_en: The invention relates to cooking equipment and a panel opening and closing control device and an opening control method thereof. The opening control method comprises the following steps: receiving a panel opening signal; the driving mechanism is controlled to gradually push the panel to be opened at the duty ratio which is increased step by step; the step of controlling the driving mechanism to gradually push the panel to be opened with the duty ratio increasing step by step comprises the steps that the driving mechanism pushes the panel with the set duty ratio, and whether the current actual locked-rotor current of the driving mechanism is smaller than a locked-rotor current threshold value or not is judged, if yes, the driving mechanism is controlled to continue to push the panel with the current duty ratio, and if not, the panel is opened. Driving is stopped until it is judged that the panel is opened in place; if not, the driving mechanism is controlled to be restarted, and the panel is pushed with the next-level duty ratio larger than the current duty ratio. In the panel opening process, the driving mechanism is controlled to push the panel step by step at the gradually-increased duty ratio, and the problems that mechanical clamping stagnation is easily generated, the misjudgment rate is high and the opening success rate is low due to the fact that the driving mechanism pushes the panel at the maximum duty ratio can be effectively solved.

content_cn: 本实用新型提供了一种油气井用套管组件。所述套管组件包括第一、二套管，第一套管包括第一套管管体和第一接头，第一接头具有超出第一套管管体的外圆周面的第一加厚部以及形成在该第一加厚部上的外螺纹；第二套管包括第二套管管体和第二接头，第二接头具有超出第二套管管体的外圆周面的第二加厚部及形成在该第二加厚部上的内螺纹；内、外螺纹的锥度均为1∶(13～19)，内、外螺纹彼此过盈配合且均为具有承载面为负角的偏梯形螺纹，内、外螺纹连接部分的两端分别设置一处锥面对锥面的金属弹性密封。本实用新型与现有技术中带接箍的接箍相比，外径减小了约8～12mm。
content_en: The utility model provides a casing pipe assembly for an oil-gas well. The casing pipe assembly comprises a first casing pipe and a second casing pipe, wherein the first casing pipe comprises a first casing pipe body and a first connector, the first connector is provided with a first thickened portion exceeding out of the outer peripheral face of the first casing pipe body and outer threads formed on the first thickened portion. The second casing pipe comprises a second casing pipe body and a second connector, the second connector is provided with a second thickened portion exceeding out of the outer peripheral face of the second casing pipe body and inner threads formed on the second thickened portion. Tapers of the inner threads and the outer threads are 1: (13-19), the inner threads are mutually interference fit with the outer threads, the inner threads and the outer threads are buttress threads with bearing faces at negative angles, and metal elastic seals with opposite conical surfaces are arranged at two ends of the connecting portion for the outer threads and the inner threads respectively. Compared with couplings in the prior art, outer diameter is decreased by about 8-12 mm.

content_cn: 本实用新型提出了一种射孔工具，其包括射孔管柱；设置在射孔管柱的下端的射孔枪；位于射孔枪上端的标定装置；设置在射孔管柱上并位于射孔枪上端的定位装置，定位装置能与标定装置配合以获得相应的射孔枪的位置，其中，标定装置构造为在第一状态下固定在射孔管柱上而在第二状态下固定在射孔工具下入的套管上，该射孔工具可以调整射孔管柱的位置和方位以调整射孔的位置，以最大范围沟通储层。
content_en: The utility model provides a perforation instrument, it includes perforated string, the setting is at the perforation rifle of perforated string's lower extreme, be located the calibration device of perforation rifle upper end, the setting is on perforated string and lie in the positioner of perforation rifle upper end, positioner can with the position of calibration device cooperation in order toobtain corresponding perforation rifle, wherein, the calibration device structure is fixed on the sleeve pipe that perforation instrument goes into down under the second state for fixing under firststate on perforated string, this perforation instrument can adjust perforated string's position and the position position in order to adjust the perforation to link up the reservoir the most on a large scale.

content_cn: 一种陆相细粒沉积岩岩石相分析方法，包括：根据岩性或岩性组合方式、有机碳含量、硅质含量和钙质含量对岩石相进行分类，建立岩石相分类规则；提取待分析细粒沉积岩的岩心，识别岩心中的岩性或岩性组合界面，并基于岩性或岩性组合和岩石相分类命名规则，确定待分析细粒沉积岩的岩石相类型；分别确定每种类型的岩石相的特征参数，从而确定其中的有利岩石相，建立有利岩石相测井评价标准。该岩石相分析方法通过岩性组合方式、有机碳丰度、硅质丰度和钙质丰度对岩石相进行分类，建立岩石相分类规则，使其能够适用于陆相细粒沉积岩。
content_en: A lithofacies analysis method for continental facies fine-grained sedimentary rocks includes classifying lithofacies according to the lithology or lithological association mode, the content of organiccarbon, the content of silicon and the content of calcium, and establishing lithofacies classification rules; extracting a core of a to-be-analyzed fine-grained sedimentary rock, identifying a lithology or lithological association interface in the core, and determining the lithofacies type of the to-be-analyzed fine-grained sedimentary rock according to the lithology or lithological association and the lithofacies classification and naming rules; determining the characteristic parameters of each type of lithofacies, determining the favorable lithofacies, and establishing logging evaluation criteria of the favorable lithofacies. The lithofacies analysis method has the advantages that the lithofacies is classified according to the lithological association mode, the abundance of the organiccarbon, the abundance of the silicon and the abundance of the calcium, the lithofacies classification rules are established, and accordingly, the lithofacies analysis method can be applied to the continental facies fine-grained sedimentary rocks.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种全通径无限级压裂完井组件及其工艺方法，包括压裂完井滑套和用于开启压裂完井滑套的打开工具，二者通过特定的滑块与凹槽的配合结构，具有多种序列组合，保证分段压裂级数不受限制；开启方式既可实现任意定点压裂完井滑套的一匙一开，也可实现一级多簇压裂完井滑套的一匙多开；压后，打开工具可全部溶解，实现完井管柱全通径；满足连续快速、大规模、多级多簇的压裂完井施工需求，提高压裂效率。
content_en: The full-bore infinite-order fracturing well completion assembly comprises a fracturing well completion sliding sleeve and an opening tool used for opening the fracturing well completion sliding sleeve, the fracturing well completion sliding sleeve and the opening tool have multiple sequence combinations through a matching structure of a specific sliding block and a groove, and it is guaranteed that staged fracturing stages are not limited; according to the opening mode, one-key one-opening of the fracturing well completion sliding sleeve at any fixed point can be achieved, and one-key multi-opening of the first-stage multi-cluster fracturing well completion sliding sleeve can also be achieved. After pressing, the tool is opened and can be completely dissolved, so that the full bore of a well completion pipe string is realized; the continuous, rapid, large-scale, multi-stage and multi-cluster fracturing well completion construction requirements are met, and the fracturing efficiency is improved.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种异常井井温预警方法，属于油田开发技术领域。其包括以下步骤：(1)根据Remay理论井筒散热模型，以水当量为决定出液温度的关键参数，对井温影响较小的次要参数视为常量，建立出液温度预测模型：其中，T为井口出液温度；Q为单井产液量；fw为含水率；a、b、c、为常数；(2)对实测油井数据进行拟合，确定a、b、c的值；(3)针对不同环境温度下的井口出液温度形成合理井温范围，建立井温图版，通过远传系统导出每一口井的井温实时数据，对异常井温进行排查。该方法适用性强，能够及时发现油井出液异常，提高处理时效，极大节省成本。
content_en: The invention discloses an abnormal well temperature early warning method, and belongs to the technical field of oilfield development. The method comprises the following steps: (1) according to a Remay theory wellbore heat dissipation model, establishing an outlet liquid temperature prediction model by taking water equivalent as a key parameter for determining the outlet liquid temperature and taking a secondary parameter with small influence on the well temperature as a constant, q is the liquid production capacity of a single well; fw is the water content; a, b and c are constants; (2) fitting actually measured oil well data, and determining values of a, b and c; and (3) forming a reasonable well temperature range according to the well mouth liquid outlet temperatures under different environment temperatures, establishing a well temperature chart, exporting well temperature real-time data of each well through a remote transmission system, and checking abnormal well temperatures. The method is high in applicability, oil well liquid outlet abnormity can be found in time, the treatment time efficiency is improved, and the cost is greatly saved.

content_cn: 本发明提供一种表征油水两相流体的流动型态的方法，其包括以下步骤：步骤1、对油水两相流体的特定温度和压力条件进行划分，以得到不同的子温度和压力条件；步骤2、在同一子温度和压力条件下，同时以油水两相流体的流速和持水率作为自变量对油水两相流体的流动型态进行测量，以得到油水两相流体在不同流速和不同持水率条件下对应的流动型态；步骤3、在同一子温度和压力条件下，绘制用于表征油水两相流体的流动型态的流速‑持水率的图版，以确定油水两相流体的流动型态边界。通过上述方法能够直观而准确地表征出不同条件下油水两相流动型态，为研究油水两相流体的两相流动规律奠定基础，以改善油液在垂直井筒中发生举升困难或停产的情况。
content_en: The invention provides a method for representing the flow pattern of an oil-water two-phase fluid. The method comprises the following steps that 1, the specific temperature and pressure conditions ofthe oil-water two-phase fluid are divided to obtain different sub-temperature and pressure conditions; 2, under the same sub-temperature and pressure condition, the flow velocity and specific retention of the oil-water two-phase fluid simultaneously serve as independent variables to measure the flow pattern of the oil-water two-phase fluid so as to obtain the corresponding flow patterns of the oil-water two-phase fluid under different flow velocities and different specific retention conditions; and 3, under the same sub-temperature and pressure condition, a flow velocity-specific retention chart used for representing the flow pattern of the oil-water two-phase fluid is drawn to determine a flow pattern boundary of the oil-water two-phase fluid. Through the method, the oil-water two-phase flow patterns under the different conditions can be intuitively and accurately represented, and the foundation is laid for the study of the two-phase flow rule of the oil-water two-phase fluid so as torelieve the situations of difficult lifting and halt production of oil liquid in a vertical wellbore.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开了一种双型抽油机固定基础，可用于安装横向孔距相同的第一抽油机和第二抽油机，双型固定基础(1)上设置有用于安装第一抽油机的第一预埋组件(2)和用于安装第二抽油机的第二预埋组件(3)，第一预埋组件(2)和第二预埋组件(3)相互间隔设置，第一预埋组件与抽油机底部的安装件相匹配，第二预埋组件与第二抽油机底部的安装件相匹配，第一抽油机或第二抽油机可通过第一预埋组件、第二预埋组件固定连接在双型固定基础(1)上。本实用新型的一种双型抽油机固定基础，可在同一固定基础上安装不同型号的抽油机，调整机型时，无需重新补打抽油机固定基础，提高了生产时效。
content_en: The utility model discloses a fixed basis of dimorphism beam -pumping unit, can be used to install the same first beam -pumping unit of horizontal pitch -row and second beam -pumping unit, be provided with the pre -buried subassembly of second (3) that is used for installing first pre -buried subassembly (2) of first beam -pumping unit and is used for installing the second beam -pumping unit on the fixed basis of dimorphism (1), first pre -buried subassembly (2) and the pre -buried subassembly of second (3) separate the setting each other, the installed part phase -match of first pre -buried subassembly bottom the beam -pumping unit, the installed part phase -match of the pre -buried subassembly of second bottom the second beam -pumping unit, first beam -pumping unit or the first pre -buried subassembly of second beam -pumping unit accessible, the pre -buried subassembly fixed connection of second is on the fixed basis of dimorphism (1). The utility model discloses a fixed basis of dimorphism beam -pumping unit can install the beam -pumping unit of different models on same fixed basis, during the adjustment model, need not to mend again and beat the fixed basis of beam -pumping unit, has improved the production prescription.

content_cn: 本实用新型涉及一种投球打开式滑套和压裂管柱。该投球打开式滑套包括：滑套本体，贯穿其侧壁设置有压裂孔，能贴合滑套本体的内壁而滑动的球座，在球座上轴向地设置有通孔，球座在第一位置处通过剪钉与滑套本体固定相连并封堵住压裂孔。这种投球打开式滑套能实现了现有技术中的滑套的功能，而且结构简单。
content_en: The utility model relates to a ball-throwing opening type sliding sleeve and a pressing tubular column. The ball-throwing opening type sliding sleeve comprises a sliding sleeve body, a pressing-cracking hole which is formed by penetrating through the side wall of the sliding sleeve body and a ball base which can slide by being attached to the inner wall of the sliding sleeve body. A through hole is formed in the ball base in the axial direction. A first position of the ball base is fixedly connected with the sliding sleeve body through a shearing screw and seals the pressing-cracking hole. The ball-throwing opening type sliding sleeve can achieve the function of the sliding sleeve in the prior art, and the structure is simple.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开了一种射孔压裂连续作业中的单球自动投球器，解决了现有射孔压裂连续作业中需要人工投球操作的问题。技术方案包括中空的投球管，所述投球管的上段开有放球口，底面为投球口，所述投球管中段开有活塞口，所述活塞口与液压油缸液动组件的活塞腔对应，所述活塞腔内设有活塞，所述活塞的后端和活塞腔后端之间设有复位弹簧，所述液压开关组件固定在所述投球管中段外壁。本实用新型结构极为简单、可有效地提高工作时效，通过完全替代人工操作，大大提高安全性，并允许现场带压作业。
content_en: The utility model discloses a single-ball automatic ball injector in perforation and fracturing continuous operation, which solves the problem that manual ball injection operation is needed in the existing perforation and fracturing continuous operation. According to the technical scheme, the ball throwing device comprises a hollow ball throwing pipe, a ball placing opening is formed in the upper section of the ball throwing pipe, a ball throwing opening is formed in the bottom face of the ball throwing pipe, a piston opening is formed in the middle section of the ball throwing pipe and corresponds to a piston cavity of a hydraulic oil cylinder hydraulic assembly, a piston is arranged in the piston cavity, and a reset spring is arranged between the rear end of the piston and the rear end of the piston cavity. The hydraulic switch assembly is fixed to the outer wall of the middle section of the ball throwing pipe. According to the utility model, the structure is extremely simple, the working efficiency can be effectively improved, the safety is greatly improved by completely replacing the manual operation, and the field operation under pressure is allowed.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开了一种连续钢杆输送水力径向钻孔工艺管柱，包括第一硬质油管、第二硬质油管、定位装置、喷射喷头，所述第一硬质油管包括竖直段管、水平段管，其中竖直段管设置在第二硬质油管内，水平段管处于第二硬质油管下方的井底位置，所述定位装置连接在第二硬质油管的下端，所述水平段管固定在定位装置上，水平段管的末端安装喷射喷头。所述定位装置为一油管短节，所述定位装置开设有用于水平段管穿过并定位的定位孔。所述第一硬质油管的竖直段管与第二硬质油管之间构成环空，竖直段管外壁安装活动密封器。本实用新型彻底解决了径向钻孔的方向及孔径问题，保证油井正常连续生产，延长了油井生产的寿命。通过现场使用，效果非常明显。
content_en: The utility model discloses a continuous steel rod conveying hydraulic radial drilling process pipe column. The device comprises a first hard oil pipe, a second hard oil pipe, a positioning device andan injection nozzle, the first hard oil pipe comprises a vertical section pipe and a horizontal section pipe, the vertical section pipe is arranged in the second hard oil pipe, the horizontal sectionpipe is located at the bottom of the well below the second hard oil pipe, the positioning device is connected to the lower end of the second hard oil pipe, the horizontal section pipe is fixed to thepositioning device, and the tail end of the horizontal section pipe is provided with the spraying nozzle. The positioning device is an oil pipe nipple and is provided with a positioning hole for thehorizontal section pipe to penetrate through and be positioned. An annular space is formed between the vertical section pipe of the first hard oil pipe and the second hard oil pipe, and a movable sealer is installed on the outer wall of the vertical section pipe. According to the utility model, the problems of radial drilling direction and aperture are thoroughly solved, normal continuous production of an oil well is ensured, and the service life of oil well production is prolonged. Through on-site use, the effect is very obvious.

content_cn: 一种出风方式可调的空调室外机，包括由压缩机，换热器，铜管组成的系统部分，和由风机风口、风机风道、风机电机、电机支架、连接板与外机的钣金外壳组成的风机电机部分；风机风口可设置于所述室外机的前面、或者左侧面、或者右侧面。外壳上端面固定有上钣金，上部固定有电机支架，风机电机通过连接板与电机支架固定连接；外壳对应风机电机的风机风道设置有风机风口，并通过连接件将两者紧固在一起。本实用新型的出风口可根据用户的需求，可设置于室外机的前面、或者左侧面、或者右侧面，在确保换热效率的前提下，不增加机器的体积，又可以实现侧出风的目的，避免了增加换热器所带来的成本。其具有结构简单合理，安全可靠，制造成本低，且换热效率高等特点。
content_en: The utility model discloses an air conditioner outdoor machine capable of adjusting an air outlet mode. The air conditioner outdoor machine comprises a system part consisting of a compressor, a heat exchanger and a copper tube and a fan motor part consisting of a fan tuyere, a fan air duct, a fan motor, a motor bracket, a connection plate and an outdoor machine sheet metal shell, wherein the fan tuyere can be formed on the front or left side face or right side face of the outdoor machine; an upper sheet metal is fixed on the upper end face of the shell; the motor bracket is fixed on the upper part of the shell; the fan motor is fixedly connected with the motor bracket through the connection plate; and the fan tuyere is formed on the fan air duct on the shell, which corresponds to the fan motor, and fastened with the fan air duct. The air outlet of the air conditioner outdoor machine can be formed on the front or the left side face or the right side face of the outdoor machine according to a demand of a user; on the premise of guaranteeing the heat exchange efficiency, the size of the machine is not increased, and an aim of realizing a side air outlet mode is fulfilled; and therefore, a phenomenon of increase of the cost, which is caused by a heat exchanger, is avoided. The air conditioner outdoor machine has the characteristics of simple and rational structure, safety, reliability, low manufacturing cost, high heat exchange efficiency and the like.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种风叶组件及具有其的暖风机，其中，风叶组件包括壳体、风叶和弹性顶压机构，风叶可转动地设置于壳体内；弹性顶压机构包括连接部和锁止部，连接部与壳体相连接，锁止部可活动地设置于连接部的安装腔内，风叶通过锁止部与壳体可拆卸地连接；锁止部具有伸出安装腔，以使风叶与壳体连接的锁止位置，以及锁止部具有退回安装腔，以使风叶与壳体分离的拆卸位置。本发明解决了现有技术中的风叶组件的风叶的设置方式不合理，无法保证风叶的安装或拆卸便捷性，导致风叶的清洗作业繁琐复杂，降低了用户对暖风机的使用体验好感的问题。
content_en: The invention provides a fan blade assembly and a fan heater with the same. The fan blade assembly comprises a casing, fan blades and an elastic jacking and pressing mechanism; the fan blades are rotatably arranged in the casing; the elastic jacking and pressing mechanism comprises a connecting part and a locking part; the connecting part is connected with the casing; the locking part is movably arranged in an assembly cavity of the connecting part; the fan blades are detachably connected with the casing through the locking part; and the locking part is provided with a locking position extending out of the assembly cavity to connect the fan blades with the casing and a disassembly position withdrawn to the assembly cavity to separate the fan blades from the casing. The problems that the arranging mode of the fan blades of the fan blade assembly in the prior art is unreasonable, so that the assembly and disassembly convenience of the fan blades cannot be ensured, resulting in causing the problems that the cleaning operation of the fan blades is complicated and cumbersome, and good user's experience feeling of the fan heater is reduced are solved.

content_cn: 本实用新型涉及换热设备领域，提供了一种折流板换热器及石油加工系统，包括壳体和设置于壳体内的含有多个折流板的折流板组以及换热管束；换热管束穿过折流板组，多个折流板呈离散型错缝分布。石油加工系统，包括如本申请提供的折流板换热器。该换热器成本低，不易结垢，维护清洗保养成本低。
content_en: The utility model relates to the field of heat exchange equipment, and provides a baffle plate heat exchanger and a petroleum processing system, which comprise a shell, a baffle plate group and a heat exchange tube bundle, the heat exchange tube bundle penetrates through the baffle plate set, and the multiple baffle plates are distributed in a discrete staggered joint mode. The petroleum processing system comprises the baffle plate heat exchanger provided by the utility model. The heat exchanger is low in cost, not prone to scaling and low in maintenance cost.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开了一种空调加湿器和空调器，空调加湿器包括：加热水箱，所述加热水箱包括水箱本体和加热元件，所述加热元件用于对所述水箱本体内的水进行加热，所述水箱本体具有入水口和蒸汽出口；单向阀，所述单向阀的第一接口与所述入水口相连，所述单向阀在从所述单向阀到所述入水口的方向上单向导通。根据本实用新型的空调加湿器，通过在入水口处设置单向阀并使单向阀在从单向阀到入水口的方向上单向导通，从而加热水箱内的水或蒸汽不会流过单向阀，加热水箱内不断地产生蒸汽，压力不断地增大，从而将风管中的冷凝水压出，继而有利于提高加湿效果。
content_en: The utility model discloses an air conditioner humidifier and an air conditioner, the air conditioner humidifier comprises a heating water tank, the heating water tank comprises a water tank body anda heating element, the heating element is used for heating water in the water tank body, and the water tank body is provided with a water inlet and a steam outlet; and a first interface of the one-wayvalve is connected with the water inlet, and the one-way valve is unidirectionally conducted in the direction from the one-way valve to the water inlet. The utility model discloses an air conditionerhumidifier. The one-way valve is arranged at the water inlet, and the one-way valve is unidirectionally conducted in the direction from the one-way valve to the water inlet, so that water or steam inthe heating water tank cannot flow through the one-way valve, the steam is continuously generated in the heating water tank, the pressure is continuously increased, condensed water in the air pipe ispressed out, and the humidification effect is improved.

content_cn: 本发明公开一种空调室内机和空调器，其中，该空调室内机包括：包括底盘和侧固定部；底盘包括朝前下侧延伸的倾斜板，倾斜板的下部两侧分设有一朝上敞口的接水槽；两侧固定部分别设有滑槽结构；换热器；蜗壳，蜗壳的左右两端分别设有与滑槽结构可滑动配合的滑凸结构；上接水盘、下接水盘，下接水盘设于蜗壳上部的前侧，上接水盘设于蜗壳上部的后侧；引流槽，引流槽连通上接水盘和下接水盘，引流槽的底部邻近蜗壳的后部且于每一接水槽的槽口正上方开设有引流口；排水管，连接于排水口，用以将接水槽内的水排出空调室内机外。本发明技术方案使蜗壳和空调室内机排水结构无需装拆，仍能实现排水功能，从而提高蜗壳拆出清洗或维修的便捷性。
content_en: An indoor unit of an air conditioner, and the air conditioner. The indoor unit of the air conditioner comprises a base plate (11), side fixed portions (12), a heat exchanger (2), a volute (3), an upper water receiving plate (4), a lower water receiving plate (5), a flow guide groove (6), and a water discharge pipe. The base plate (11) comprises an oblique plate (112) extending to a forward lower side, and a water receiving tank (112a) provided with an upward opening is disposed on each of the two sides of the lower portion of the oblique plate (112). A sliding groove (121) is formed in each of the two side fixed portions (12). A slidable raised structure capable of slidably fitted to the sliding groove (121) is disposed at each of the left end and the right end of the volute (3). The lower water receiving plate (5) is disposed on the front side of the volute (3), and the upper water receiving plate (5) is disposed on the rear side of the volute (3). The flow guide groove (6) communicates with the upper water receiving plate (4) and the lower water receiving plate (5). The bottom of the flow guide groove (6) is adjacent to the rear part of the volute (3), and a flow guide opening (621) is formed on the right-above position of the tank opening of each water receiving tank (112a). The water discharge pipe is connected to the water outlet (112b) and is used for discharging the water in the water receiving tank (112a) outside the indoor unit of the air conditioner. The water discharge function can be implemented without the assembly and disassembly of the volute (3) and a water discharge structure, thereby improving the convenience of cleaning or repair of the volute (3) after disassembly.

content_cn: 本发明提供一种变频空调及其控制方法、计算机可读存储介质，该方法包括获取设定的目标温度以及环境温度，根据目标温度以及环境温度确定压缩机的目标运行频率，压缩机的运行频率逐渐调节至目标运行频率，其中，压缩机的运行频率调节至目标运行频率时，每达到预设的频率停留点，在预设停留时间内保持压缩机的运行频率；压缩机的运行频率调节过程中，获取压缩机的排气温度，根据排气温度调节电子膨胀阀的开度：根据排气温度所在的温度范围段，以预设的速率增加或者减小电子膨胀阀的开度。该变频空调应用上述控制方法。该计算机可读存储介质的程序被处理器执行时能够实现上述的方法。本发明可以减少变频空调产生的气流噪声。
content_en: The invention provides a variable frequency air conditioner, a control method thereof and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the steps that the set target temperature and the environment temperature are obtained, the target running frequency of a compressor is determined according to the target temperature and the environment temperature, and the running frequency of the compressor is gradually adjusted to the target running frequency, wherein when the running frequency of the compressor is adjusted to the target running frequency, the running frequency of the compressoris kept within the preset staying time every time the preset frequency staying point is reached; in the running frequency adjusting process of the compressor, the exhaust temperature of the compressoris obtained, and the opening degree of an electronic expansion valve is adjusted according to the exhaust temperature; and according to the temperature range segment where the exhaust temperature islocated, the opening degree of the electronic expansion valve is increased or decreased at the preset speed. The variable frequency air conditioner applies the above control method. When a program ofthe computer readable storage medium is executed by a processor, the above method can be achieved. By means of the variable frequency air conditioner, the control method thereof and the computer readable storage medium, airflow noise generated by the variable frequency air conditioner can be reduced.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种泵体及压缩机。泵体包括曲轴和滚子，曲轴上设置有偏心圆，滚子套设在偏心圆的外周，滚子沿曲轴上的径向的厚度和偏心圆沿曲轴的径向上的最大宽度的比值为0.41至0.51。本发明提供了滚子沿曲轴上的径向的厚度和偏心圆沿曲轴的径向上的最大宽度的比值对压缩机摩擦功耗、损耗影响的评价指标及参考范围，解决了滚子与曲轴偏心圆大小、高度及排量设计关系的难点问题。
content_en: The invention provides a pump body and a compressor. The pump body comprises a crankshaft and a roller, an eccentric circle is arranged on the crankshaft, and the periphery of the eccentric circle issleeved with the roller. The specific value of the thickness of the roller in the radial direction of the crankshaft to the largest width of the eccentric circle in the radial direction of the crankshaft is 0.41-0.51.
