According to the pump body and the compressor, the evaluation index and reference range of the specific value of the thickness of the roller in the radial direction of the crankshaftto the largest width of the eccentric circle in the radial direction of the crankshaft on the friction power consumption and loss influence of the compressor are provided, and the difficult problem of the design relations of the sizes, the heights and displacements of the roller and the eccentric circle of the crankshaft is solved.

content_cn: 本发明是关于一种室内机及应用其的空调器，涉及空调领域，主要目的在于解决现有室内机的导风板与出风口处的配合间隙大的技术问题。主要采用的技术方案为：室内机，包括出风口和可在所述出风口处转动的导风板；所述导风板与所述出风口的侧壁之间具有运转间隙；所述室内机还包括活动挡板，活动挡板用于运动至第一位置时封闭所述运转间隙；和运动至第二位置时让开所述运转间隙。根据本发明提供的技术方案，因为活动挡板运动至第一位置时可以封闭导风板与出风口之间的运转间隙，从而可以实现导风板与出风口之间的无缝配合状态，使出风口在闭合状态时的外观更加简洁、美观和大方。
content_en: The invention relates to an indoor unit and an air conditioner using the same, and relates to the field of air conditioners. The indoor unit and the air conditioner mainly aim to solve the technical problem that fit clearance between an air guide plate and an air outlet of an existing indoor unit is large. According to the main technical scheme, the indoor unit comprises an air outlet and an air guide plate capable of rotating at the air outlet; a transfer gap is formed between the air guide plate and the side wall of the air outlet. The indoor unit further comprises a movable baffle used forsealing the transfer gap when moving to a first position and opening the transfer gap when moving to a second position. According to the technical scheme, the movable baffle can seal the transfer gapbetween the air guide plate and the air outlet when moving to the first position so that the seamless fit state between the air guide plate and the air outlet can be achieved, and accordingly the appearance is more concise, attractive and elegant when the air outlet is in a closed state.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种出风风道结构、出风面板及天井式空调内机，出风风道结构包括相对设置的第一风道壁和第二风道壁，在所述第一风道壁和所述第二风道壁之间形成出风通道，所述第一风道壁沿气流方向包括相连的多个凹曲面，所述多个凹曲面的曲率半径沿气流方向依次减小。本发明提供的出风风道结构，通过在第一风道壁沿气流方向设计出相连的多个凹曲面，且多个凹曲面的曲率半径沿气流方向依次减小，这样增强了引风能力，进而实现增大风量的目的，同时也使得出风风道结构可以得到灵活处理。
content_en: The invention discloses an air outlet duct structure, an air outlet panel and a ceiling type air conditioner indoor unit. The air outlet duct structure comprises a first air duct wall and a second airduct wall which are oppositely arranged, an air outlet channel is formed between the first air duct wall and the second air duct wall, the first air duct wall comprises a plurality of connected concave curved surfaces in the airflow direction, and the curvature radiuses of the concave curved surfaces are sequentially reduced in the airflow direction. According to the air outlet duct structure provided by the invention, the multiple connected concave curved surfaces are designed on the first air duct wall in the airflow direction, the curvature radiuses of the multiple concave curved surfacesare sequentially reduced in the airflow direction such that the air inducing capacity is enhanced, the purpose of increasing the air volume is achieved, and meanwhile, the air outlet duct structure can be flexibly processed.

content_cn: 一种布线机构，包括:连杆组件，包括分体设置的第一杆和第二杆，所述第一杆可相对第二杆运动从而使得连杆组件展开或压缩；电源信号线，所述电源信号线具有固定于所述第一杆上远离所述第二杆的一端的第一固定点、固定于所述第二杆上远离所述第一杆的一端的第二固定点，所述电源信号线呈柔性且总长度不小于连杆组件展开时的长度；所述连杆组件处于压缩状态时，所述第一杆和第二杆至少部分相互重叠，所述电源信号线折叠压缩；所述连杆组件处于展开状态时，所述第一杆和第二杆相互远离且不相重叠，所述电源信号线拉伸延长。
content_en: The invention discloses a wiring mechanism. The wiring mechanism comprises a connecting rod component and a power supply signal wire, wherein the connecting rod component comprises a first rod and a second rod which are separately arranged; the first rod can move relative to the second rod, so that the connecting rod component is unfolded or compressed; the power supply signal wire is provided with a first fixing point which is fixed at one end, away from the second rod, on the first rod, and a second fixing point which is fixed at one end, away from the first rod, on the second rod; the power supply signal wire is flexible and total length of the power supply signal wire is not smaller than that of the connecting rod component when being unfolded; when the connecting rod component is located in a compressing state, at least part of the first rod and the second rod are mutually superposed, and the power supply signal wire is folded and compressed; and when the connecting rod component is located in an unfolding state, the first rod and the second rod are mutually kept away from each other and are not mutually superposed, and the power supply signal wire is extended and elongated.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种泵体组件、流体机械及换热设备。其中，泵体组件包括：上法兰；下法兰；气缸，夹持在上法兰和下法兰之间，气缸与下法兰同心，与上法兰的偏心距离为e，气缸的侧壁具有排气孔；气缸套，套设在气缸外并夹持在上法兰与下法兰之间，气缸的外周面与气缸套的内壁间形成排气间隙；活塞，可滑动地设置在气缸的第一滑移孔内，活塞与气缸的内壁之间形成变容积腔，活塞具有第二滑移孔，变容积腔通过排气孔与排气间隙连通；转轴，其底端滑动设置在第二滑移孔内，活塞相对于第一滑移孔滑动的第一滑移方向与转轴相对于第二滑移孔滑动的第二滑移方向之间具有滑移夹角。本发明的泵体组件具有运转良好、能耗小的特点。
content_en: The invention provides a pump body assembly, a fluid machine and heat exchange equipment. The pump body assembly comprises an upper flange, a lower flange, an air cylinder, an air cylinder sleeve, a piston and a rotating shaft, wherein the air cylinder is clamped between the upper flange and the lower flange and is concentric with the lower flange; the eccentric distance between the air cylinder and the upper flange is e; the side wall of the air cylinder is provided with exhaust holes; the air cylinder sleeve is arranged outside the air cylinder in a sleeving mode and clamped between the upper flange and the lower flange; an exhaust clearance is formed between the peripheral surface of the air cylinder and the inner wall of the air cylinder sleeve; the piston is slidably arranged in a first sliding hole of the air cylinder; a variable volume cavity is formed between the piston and the inner wall of the air cylinder; the piston is provided with a second sliding hole; the variable volume cavity communicates with the exhaust clearance through the exhaust holes; the bottom end of the rotating shaft is slidably arranged in the second sliding hole; and a sliding included angle is formed between the first sliding direction where the piston slides relative to the first sliding hole and the second sliding direction where the rotating shaft slides relative to the second sliding hole. The pump body assembly has the characteristics of being good in operation and low in energy consumption.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种具有感温包插片功能的线扎及使用该线扎的空调器，包括将感温包固定在感温包套管内的连接件，设于连接件一端与所述感温套管一端固定的倒扣，设于连接件另一端与感温套管另一端固定用于固定感温包线的线扎结构。本发明可与感温套管固定，其中线扎结构可以捆住感温包线，使感温包线被拉动时不会导致感温包松动，解决了感温套管线扎难扎的问题，同时避免了管路感温包脱落的风险。
content_en: The invention discloses a wire binding piece with a temperature sensing package inserting piece function and an air conditioner using the wire binding piece. The wire binding piece comprises a connecting piece, an inverted buckle and a wire binding structure, wherein the connecting piece is used for fixing a temperature sensing package into a temperature sensing package sleeving, the inverted buckle is arranged at one end of the connecting piece and fixed to one end of a temperature sensing sleeving, and the wire binding structure is arranged at the other end of the connecting piece, fixed tothe other end of the temperature sensing sleeving and used for fixing the temperature sensing package. The wire binding piece can be fixed together with the temperature sensing sleeving. A temperaturesensing package wire can be bound by the wire binding structure, so that the temperature sensing package is not loosened when the temperature sensing package wire is pulled, the binding difficulty ofthe temperature sensing sleeving and the wire binding piece is solved, and the risk that the pipeline temperature sensing package falls off is avoided.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种滑片式压缩机及制冷装置，其中滑片式压缩机包括上气缸和下气缸，上气缸设有上工作腔，上工作腔内设有多个上滑片；下气缸设有下工作腔，下工作腔内设有多个下滑片；下工作腔和上工作腔之间有过气通道，过气通道一端和下工作腔的高压端连通，另一端和上工作腔的低压端连通。本发明所述的滑片式压缩机，提高了滑片式压缩机的可靠性，通过采用双级压缩机结构，降低滑片背压，同时为适应不同空间需求，采用变容技术，达到节能的目的。
content_en: The invention discloses a sliding vane compressor and a refrigerating device. The sliding vane compressor comprises an upper air cylinder and a lower air cylinder, wherein the upper air cylinder is provided with an upper working cavity; a plurality of upper slip sheets are arranged in the upper working cavity; the lower air cylinder is provided with a lower working cavity; a plurality of lower slip sheets are arranged in the lower working cavity; an air passing channel is arranged between the lower working cavity and the upper working cavity; one end of the air passing channel communicates with the high pressure end of the lower working cavity; and the other end of the air passing channel communicates with the low pressure end of the upper working cavity. The sliding vane compressor, disclosed by the invention, improves the reliability of the sliding vane compressor, reduces the backpressure of a sliding sheet through adopting a twin-stage compressor structure, and adopts the volume changing technology for being suitable for different space demands to realize the purpose of saving energy.

content_cn: 本公开涉及一种波长选择开关及其相关的光学设备。该波长选择开关包括：2D光纤阵列，包括第一列光纤和第二列光纤，其中第二列光纤中的光纤与第一列光纤中的光纤被布置为沿切换方向交替排布，并且第二列光纤沿色散方向相对于第一列光纤偏移预定间距；色散单元，被配置为对来自第一光路调整部件的第一光束进行色散，以产生对应于不同波长的多个第一子光束；以及光交换引擎，被配置为接收多个第一子光束，并且可操作地对所述多个第一子光束的方向进行调整，以入射回色散单元；其中色散单元还被配置为将入射回的至少部分所述多个第一子光束进行合波，以产生经合波的第二光束，并将第二光束经由第一光路调整部件引导至输出端口。
content_en: The invention relates to a wavelength selective switch and related optical equipment. The wavelength selective switch comprises a 2D optical fiber array comprising a first column of optical fibers and a second column of optical fibers, the optical fibers in the second column of optical fibers and the optical fibers in the first column of optical fibers are alternately arranged along a switching direction, and the second column of optical fibers are offset by a predetermined distance relative to the first column of optical fibers along a dispersion direction; the dispersion unit is configured to perform dispersion on the first light beam from the first light path adjusting component so as to generate a plurality of first sub-light beams corresponding to different wavelengths; and an optical switching engine configured to receive the plurality of first sub-beams and operably adjust the directions of the plurality of first sub-beams so as to be incident back to the dispersion unit, wherein the dispersion unit is further configured to combine at least part of the incident first sub-beams to generate a combined second beam, and guide the second beam to the output port through the first optical path adjusting component.

content_cn: 提供一种具有双触摸屏的移动终端和显示其用户界面的方法。第一触摸传感器和第二触摸传感器形成在显示单元的前侧和背侧。所述方法包括：在显示单元中显示包括至少一个背景屏幕和至少一个或多个内容的用户界面。所述方法还包括基于触摸事件根据检测的便携式终端的状态来改变用户界面的亮度。
content_en: Provided is a method of displaying a user interface of a portable terminal having a two-sided touch screen where a first touch sensor and a second touch sensor are formed to the front side and the backside of a display unit. The method includes displaying a user interface including at least one of a background screen and at least one or more contents in the display unit. The method also includes changing brightness of the user interface according to a detected state of the portable terminal based on a touch event.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种轴向位移检测方法、装置和轴向位移传感器。其中，该方法包括：通过一个轴向位移传感器中的多个探头采集检测面的多个轴向位移信号，其中，检测面为用于对磁悬浮系统的轴的轴向位移进行检测的检测平面；根据采集的多个轴向位移信号确定轴的轴向位移。本发明解决了由于检测面倾斜和传感器不一致，导致的轴向位移检测不真实不准确的技术问题。
content_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for detecting axial displacement and an axial displacement sensor. The method comprises the following steps: collecting multiple axial displacement signals of a detection surface through multiple probes in an axial displacement sensor, wherein the detection surface is a detection plane used for detecting the axial displacement of the shaft of a magnetic levitation system; and determining the axial displacement of the shaft according to collected multiple axial displacement signals. By the method, the technical problem that the axial displacement detection is untrue and inaccurate as the detection surface inclines inconsistently with the sensor is solved.

content_cn: 本发明涉及强度测试装置领域，公开了一种薄膜纵向撕裂强度的测试装置和一种薄膜纵向撕裂强度的测试方法。所述测试装置包括：(i)基座(1)；(ii)与所述基座垂直并固定在所述基座(1)上的试验架(2)；(iii)固定于试验架(2)上部的用于固定薄膜试样的固定夹(3)；(iv)固定于试验架(2)上的水平的平台(4)；以及(v)放置于平台(4)上的砝码(5)。采用本发明提供的技术方案，不必预计算对薄膜所施载荷的大小，只需准确测量薄膜受到瞬时撕裂力时的撕裂长度，能够表征薄膜在瞬时性外力作用下薄膜纵向撕裂的现象，并且对于软质和硬质薄膜均适用，装置结构简单，测试方法简单易行。
content_en: The invention relates to the field of strength testing devices and discloses a testing device and method for longitudinal tearing strength of a film. The testing device comprises (i) a substrate (1);(ii) a test rack (2) which is perpendicular to the substrate and fixed to the substrate (1); (iii) a fixed clamp (3) fixed to the upper part of the test rack (2) for fixing a film test sample; (iv) ahorizontal platform (4) fixed to the test rack (2); (v) a weight (5) placed on the platform (4). By adopting the technical scheme provided by the invention, the loaded applied to the film needs not tobe pre-calculated and the tearing length of the film subjected to an instantaneous tearing force is only measured accurately, so that a longitudinal tearing phenomenon of the film under the instantaneous external force action of the film can be represented. The device is suitable for soft and hard films and is simple in structure, and the testing method is simple and feasible.

content_cn: 描述了用于确定移动设备的方位的方法、系统和设备。一种方法包括：在移动设备处，捕获规定照明参考轴的至少一个照明物体的图像(1205)；确定该照明参考轴与该移动设备的设备参考轴之间的第一角度(1210)；确定该照明参考轴与公共参考轴之间的第二角度(1215)；估计设备参考轴与公共参考轴之间的第三角度(1220)；以及至少部分地基于第一角度、第二角度和第三角度，确定该移动设备的方位(1225)。
content_en: Methods, systems, and devices are described for determining an orientation of a mobile device. One method includes capturing, at the mobile device, an image of at least one illuminated object defining an illuminated reference axis (1205); determining a first angle between the illuminated reference axis and a device reference axis of the mobile device(1210); determining a second angle between the illuminated reference axis and a common reference axis (1215); estimating a third angle between the device reference axis and the common reference axis (1220); and determining an orientation of the mobile device based at least in part on the first angle, the second angle, and the third angle (1225).

content_cn: 本申请公开了一种插入同步指令的方法及装置，涉及计算机领域。该方法通过自动分析程序中指令之间的数据依赖关系来识别待同步功能指令，进而进行同步指令的插入。在获取包含一条或多条语句的第一程序块后，确定第一程序块中存在数据依赖的第一功能指令和第二功能指令，然后在第一功能指令所属的语句与第二功能指令所属的语句之间插入同步指令对，能够有效地提升功能指令间的并行性，提升了DAE或类DAE的处理器处理功能指令的处理性能。
content_en: The invention discloses a method and device for inserting a synchronization instruction, and relates to the field of computers. According to the invention, the method includes identifying the functioninstruction to be synchronized by automatically analyzing the data dependence relationship between instructions in a program, and then inserting the synchronization instruction; after the first program block containing one or more statements is obtained, determining the first function instruction and the second function instruction which have data dependence to exist in the first program block, and then inserting the synchronization instruction pair between the statement to which the first function instruction belongs and the statement to which the second function instruction belongs, so thatthe parallelism between the function instructions can be effectively improved, and the processing performance of the DAE or DAE-like processor for processing the function instruction is improved.

content_cn: 本发明提供一种移动终端，包括壳体、显示模组和若干器件，所述显示模组包括第一显示区和第二显示区，所述第一显示区和所述第二显示区均能够显示信息，所述若干器件中至少一个器件设置于所述第二显示区的所述显示模组和所述壳体之间，所述若干器件中至少一个器件能够透过所述显示模组发射和/或接收光信号。通过设置至少一个透明的显示区域，允许该区域下设置的器件透过所述显示模组发射和接收光信号。所述移动终端集非透明显示与透明显示功能，合理设置所述移动终端需透光器件的表面区域，提高移动终端显示的屏占比，实现全面屏显示效果，同时丰富了显示效果，提升了用户的体验性。本发明还提供一种所述移动终端的显示方法。
content_en: The present invention provides a mobile terminal, comprising a housing, a display module, and multiple devices. The display module comprises a first display region and a second display region; the first display region and the second display region are both able to display information; at least one device in the multiple devices is provided between the display module and the housing in the second display region; at least one device in the multiple devices can transmits and/or receives an optical signal by means of the display module. At least one transparent display region is provided, and a device provided in the region is permitted to transmit and receive an optional signal through the display module. The mobile terminal is integrated with a non-transparent display function and a transparent display function, a surface region of a device requiring light transmission of the mobile terminal is reasonably configured, the screen-to-body ratio of displaying of the mobile terminal is improved, a full-screen displaying effect is implemented, the displaying effect is enriched, and user experience is improved. The present further provides a display method of the mobile terminal.

content_cn: 遥控类似类型装置的方法，该一个或多个装置是具有与设置在多个模式之一的控制装置的模式相同的模式的受控装置，该方法包括：接收模式信息的输入以便将控制装置的模式转换为多个模式之一；根据模式信息转换控制装置的模式；接收信息的输入，控制装置通过该信息遥控受控装置的功能；根据转换后的模式产生对应于该信息的控制信号；将控制信号发送到受控装置；接收模式信息的输入以便将受控装置的模式转换为多个模式之一；根据模式信息转换受控装置的模式；接收控制信号；和如果所接收到的控制信号被确认在受控装置的转换后的模式下有效，则根据控制信号控制受控装置的功能。
content_en: A method of remotely controlling similar types of devices, one or more of which is a controlled device having the same mode as that of a control device set in one of a plurality of modes, the method including receiving an input of mode information in order to convert a mode of the control device into one of the plurality of modes, converting the mode of the control device according to the mode information, receiving an input of information by which a function of the controlled device is remotely controlled by the control device, generating control signals that correspond to the information according to the converted mode, transmitting the control signals to the controlled device, receiving an input of the mode information in order to convert a mode of the controlled device into the one of the plurality of modes, converting the mode of the controlled device according to the mode information, receiving the control signals, and controlling the function of the controlled device according to the control signals if the received control signals are recognized as being effective in the converted mode of the controlled device.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种跳转指令编码的方法和系统，均可在执行循环时，相对于操作周期，提前到内存中获取循环开始指令；当循环体最后一条指令执行完时，完成循环开始指令的获取。本发明方法和系统，通过汇编编码的预处理，从软件的层面简化了硬件逻辑，保证不需要去添加额外的逻辑来解决循环折回时流水线需要停顿的问题，省去了很多的硬件逻辑和硬件资源，节省了面积和成本，使得实现简单，也提高了实现方案的可靠性。
content_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for coding a jump instruction; and the method and system can both obtain a LOOP_BEGIN command from a memory in advance when executing a loop relative to an operation cycle, and finish acquiring the LOOP_BEGIN command when the execution of a last command of a loop body is completed. The method and system of the invention simplify hardware logic from a software level via preprocessing assembly coding, and guarantee to solve a problem that a pipeline needs to be suspended during a loop retracement without adding additional logic, thus saving much hardware logic and hardware resources, economizing the area and cost, simplifying the implementation, and enhancing the reliability of the implementation scheme.

content_cn: 为了解决现有技术中文件I/O过于频繁的问题，本发明公开了一种控制文件输入输出缓存的方法及装置，该方法包括，接收读取文件的请求消息并获取待读取文件；若当前文件缓存中不存在待读取文件，且除指定内存空间外文件缓存中没有足够的空间放入待读取文件，则将待读取文件替换当前文件缓存中的文件；若文件缓存中的文件的输入输出率大于第一阈值，则在再次接收读取文件的请求消息，需要执行文件替换步骤时，将读取频度最高的文件放入文件缓存中的指定内存空间，避免被待读取文件替换。正是将读取频度最高的文件放入文件缓存中的指定内存空间，避免被替换，使得文件输入输出缓存次数减少。
content_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for controlling a file to be input into/output from a cache, which aim to solve the problem that file I/O is too frequently in the prior art. The method comprises the following steps of: receiving a request message for reading a file and acquiring a file to be read; if the file to be read does not exist in a current file cache, and cannot be stored inan enough space except a specified memory space of a file cache, replacing the file to be read by the file in the current file cache; if the input/output power of the file in the file cache is greater than a first threshold, receiving the request message for reading the file again; and when a file replacing step needs to be executed, placing the file with highest reading frequency into the specified memory space in the file cache so as to prevent the file with the highest frequency from being replaced by the file to be read. The file with the highest reading frequency is placed in the specified memory space in the file cache so as to be prevented from being replaced; and therefore, the frequency of the file input into/output from the cache is reduced.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种致密砂岩储层建模方法，包括：基于叠后三维地震解释资料，以钻井、测井资料为约束进行岩性反演，获得多个反演数据体；将多个反演数据体与测井解释结论对比，优选出最能体现不同岩性的反演数据体；根据测井解释出的岩性数据与优选出的反演数据体中的数值的相关性，确定岩性划分标准；基于所述岩性划分标准对三维空间中每个三维网格中的反演数据体的数值进行岩性识别，得到三维岩性数据体；在沉积相的主体中心和各边界内部的位置设置虚拟井，将虚拟井所对应的三维岩性数据体中的数值确定为虚拟井的岩性数据；将实钻井和虚拟井的岩性数据作为建模基础数据，进行随机模拟建模，得到三维储层岩相模型，达到精细描述储层的目的。
content_en: The present invention discloses a tight sandstone reservoir modeling method. The tight sandstone reservoir modeling method comprises the steps of: taking drilling and logging information as constraints to perform lithology inversion based on post-stack three-dimensional seismic interpretation data to obtain a plurality of inversion data volumes; comparing the inversion data volumes with a logginginterpretation conclusion to optimize an inversion data volume which can most reflect different lithologies; determining a lithology partition criterion according to the dependency of lithology data interpreted from the logging and the values in the optimized inversion data volumes; obtaining a three-dimensional logging lithology data volumes through lithology identification of the values of the inversion data volumes in each three-dimensional grid in the three-dimensional space based on the lithology partition criterion; setting virtual wells at the main body centers of sedimentary facies andthe internal portion of each boundary, and determining the values in the three-dimensional lithology data volumes corresponding to the virtual wells as the lithology data of the virtual wells; and taking the lithology data of the actual drilling wells and the virtual wells as modeling basic data to perform random simulation modeling to obtain a three-dimensional reservoir lithology model so as toachieve the purpose of fine description of the reservoir.

content_cn: 公开了一种链路层到物理层(PHY)串行接口。在一方面，片上系统(SoC)集成电路(IC)包括链路层电路，并且远程IC包括通用串行总线(USB)PHY电路。具有四条或更少导线的总线连接这两个IC。链路桥与链路层电路通信并且将接收自该链路层电路的USB收发机宏蜂窝小区接口(UMTI)信令串行化为用于传输到远程IC的高速(HS)USB消息。该链路桥还从远程IC上的USBPHY电路接收HS消息。该链路桥将HS消息解串行化以提取UTMI信令并且将所提取的UTMI信令传递给该链路层电路。
content_en: A link layer to physical layer (PHY) serial interface is disclosed. In one aspect, a system on a chip (SoC) integrated circuit (IC) includes a link layer circuit, and a remote IC includes a Universal Serial Bus (USB) PHY circuit. A bus having four or fewer wires connects the two ICs. A link bridge communicates with the link layer circuit and serializes USB Transceiver Macrocell Interface (UTMI) signaling received from the link layer circuit as high speed (HS) USB messages for transmission to the remote IC. The link bridge also receives HS messages from the USB PHY circuit on the remote IC. The link bridge deserializes the HS messages to extract UTMI signaling and passes the extracted UTMI signaling to the link layer circuit.

content_cn: 一种信息记录介质和一种记录/再现设备以及一种用于记录介质的记录/再现方法。通过用一个或多个替换记录块替换原始记录块来顺序地更新原始数据。替换记录块包括原始地址字段或先前地址字段中的至少一个，原始地址字段指示原始记录块的位置，先前地址字段指示紧先前的记录块的位置。通过参照各替换记录块中的地址字段，在备用区或用户数据区发生逻辑重写(LOW)的替换的系统中可以有效地恢复替换系统。
content_en: An information recording medium, and a recording/reproducing apparatus and a recording/reproducing method for the recording medium. Original data is sequentially updated by replacing an original recording block with one or more replacement recording blocks. A replacement recording block includes at least one of an original address field indicating a location of the original recording block or a previous address field indicating a location of an immediately previous recording block. Replacement information is effectively recovered in a system where a replacement for logical overwriting (LOW) occurs in either a spare area and a user data area by reference to the address fields in each replacement recording block.

content_cn: 本发明实施例公开一种下行数据的ACK/NACK信息反馈方法，包括：获取用户设备的处理能力信息，并将所述处理能力信息上报给基站；获取下行数据包的数据信息；根据所述处理能力信息及数据信息，计算所述用户设备针对所述下行数据包进行数据解码及ACK/NACK信息编码所需要的基础延迟时间；接收基站针对所述下行数据包下发的额外延迟时间，所述额外延迟时间用于指示反馈所述下行数据包对应的ACK/NACK信息的子帧的位置；根据所述基础延迟时间和所述额外延迟时间之和，选择对应的子帧反馈所述下行数据包对应的ACK/NACK信息。另，本发明实施例还公开一种应用所述方法的基站及用户设备。所述方法可以有效降低数据传输延迟。
content_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an ACK/NACK information feedback method for downlink data, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring processing capacity information of user equipment, and reporting the processing capacity information to a base station; acquiring data information of the downlink data packet; according to the processing capability information and the data information, calculating basic delay time required by the user equipment for performing data decoding and ACK/NACK information coding on the downlink data packet; receiving extra delay time issued by thebase station for the downlink data packet, wherein the extra delay time is used for indicating the position of a subframe for feeding back ACK/NACK information corresponding to the downlink data packet; and selecting a corresponding subframe to feed back ACK/NACK information corresponding to the downlink data packet according to the sum of the basic delay time and the additional delay time. In addition, the embodiment of the invention also discloses a base station and user equipment using the method. The method can effectively reduce data transmission delay.

content_cn: 本申请实施例提供一种V2X通信方法，包括：第一网络设备向第二网络设备发送请求消息并从第二网络设备接收响应消息，请求消息用于请求第二网络设备为终端配置V2X资源；响应消息包括V2X资源配置信息，其中V2X资源配置信息用于指示为终端配置的V2X资源。第一网络设备将V2X资源配置信息发送给终端。如此，终端可以接收该V2X资源配置信息，从而获得除第一网络设备的小区之外更多小区的V2X的资源，利用该V2X资源，发起V2X业务，从而提高V2X的数据吞吐率。
content_en: Provided is a V2X communication method, comprising the steps: a first network device sends a request message to a second network device and receives a response message from the second network device,the request message being used for requesting the second network device to configure V2X resources for a terminal; wherein the response message comprises V2X resource configuration information, and the V2X resource configuration information is used for indicating V2X resources configured for the terminal; and the first network device sends the V2X resource configuration information to the terminal. Thus, the terminal can receive the V2X resource configuration information so as to obtain V2X resources of more cells except the cell of the first network device, and initiate the V2X service by using the V2X resources so as to improve the data throughput rate of the V2X.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种确定终端移动性管理类型的方法和系统，其中，移动终端向网络侧上报信息，所上报的信息包括：移动终端所支持的移动性能力信息；网络侧根据所述移动终端的上报信息，以及自己所支持的移动性能力信息，确定出所述移动终端的移动性管理类型。通过本发明的实施例，当移动终端通过不同的接入过程接入网络后，网络侧能够针对不同接入过程中接入的终端，确定相应的移动性管理类型。
content_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for determining the types of terminal mobility management, wherein, the mobile terminal reports information to a network and the reported information comprises mobility ability information supported by the mobile terminal. The network determines the types of mobile terminal mobility management according to the reported information and the mobility ability information supported by the mobile terminal. With the embodiment of the invention, when the mobile terminal accesses the network through different access processes, the network can determine the corresponding types of mobility management according to the mobile terminals connected to the network through different access processes.

content_cn: 一种轨道交通中无线局域网的信道管理方法及相关设备。该方法包括：若第一轨旁接入点与车载接入点已建立无线通信链路且第一信道与第二信道不相同，所述第一轨旁接入点将所述第一轨旁接入点的工作信道改变为所述第二信道，所述第一信道为所述第一轨旁接入点的工作信道改变前所述第一轨旁接入点的工作信道，所述第二信道为第二轨旁接入点的工作信道；所述第一轨旁接入点指示所述车载接入点将所述车载接入点的工作信道改变为所述第二信道。本发明实施例可确保轨旁接入点之间的信道相同。
content_en: The invention relates to a channel management method of a wireless local area network in rail transit and related equipment. The method includes the following steps that: if a wireless communication link has been established between a first trackside access point and an on-board access point, and a first channel and a second channel are different, the first trackside access point changes the working channel of the first trackside access point to the second channel, wherein the first channel is the working channel of the first trackside access point before the working channel of the first trackside access point is changed, and the second channel is the working channel of a second trackside access point; and the first trackside access point instructs the on-board access point to change the working channel of the on-board access point to the second channel. With the method and related equipment provided by the embodiments of the present invention adopted, channels between the trackside access points can be identical.

content_cn: 本申请提供一种通信方法及相应的装置和系统，该方法包括：根据路由信息在第一空口资源上发送第一控制信息，其中，所述路由信息包括所述第一空口资源的特征，所述第一控制信息用于指示第一信息的第一资源；在所述第一信息的第一资源上发送所述第一信息。本申请可以适用于Relay(中继)场景、Mesh(网状)场景、IAB(Integrated Access Backhaul，接入回传一体化)场景、V2X(Vehicle to Everything，车对万物)场景、UC(UE Cooperation，UE协作)场景、高频传输场景、工业场景、机器人协作场景、物联网场景等中的一项或多项。通过本申请提供的方法，装置和系统，可以减少传输时延，提高传输效率。
content_en: Provided are a communication method and a corresponding device and system, the method comprising: sending first control information on a first air interface resource according to routing information, wherein the routing information comprises a feature of the first air interface resource, and the first control information is used for indicating a first resource of first information; and sending the first information on the first resource of the first information. The application can be applied to one or more of a Relay (Relay) scene, a Mesh (mesh) scene, an IAB (International Access Backhaul) scene, a V2X (Vehicle to Everything) scene, a UC (UE coordination) scene, a high-frequency transmission scene, an industrial scene, a robot coordination scene, an Internet of Things scene and the like. Through the method, the device and the system provided by the invention, the transmission delay can be reduced, and the transmission efficiency can be improved.

content_cn: 本发明实施例公开了一种无线网络接入控制方法及设备、系统，其中，所述方法包括：控制设备接收用户设备发送的无线接入请求消息，所述无线接入请求消息中至少包括一个无线网络的标识；确定与所述无线网络的标识对应的控制策略参数，所述控制策略参数包括所述无线网络的标识、接入密码和预设接入条件参数；根据所述控制策略参数中的预设接入条件参数，在确定所述无线网络的当前接入条件参数满足所述预设接入条件参数时，将所述控制策略参数发送给所述用户设备，以使所述用户设备根据所述控制策略参数中的无线网络的标识、接入密码接入所述无线网络，能够灵活控制无线网络的接入，既不会造成无线网络资源的浪费，也不会影响无线网络的接入质量。
content_en: Disclosed are a wireless network access control method, device and system. The method comprises: a control device receives a wireless access request message sent by a user equipment, the wireless access request message comprising an identifier of at least one wireless network; determines control policy parameters corresponding to the identifier of the wireless network, the control policy parameters comprising the identifier of the wireless network, an access password and a preset access condition parameter; and sends the control policy parameters to the user equipment when it is determined, according to the preset access condition parameter in the control policy parameters, that a current access condition parameter of the wireless network satisfies the preset access condition parameter, so that the user equipment accesses the wireless network according to the identifier of the wireless network and the access password in the control policy parameters. The access to the wireless network can be flexibly controlled, wireless network resources are not wasted, and the quality of the access to the wireless network is not affected.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种通讯加密的方法与系统，所述方法包括步骤：A、主机A上的应用客户端模块向本地的SSH安全代理模块发送代理请求，要求连接目标主机B；B、SSH安全代理模块解析代理请求，根据解析出的目标主机的IP地址，获知主机A的应用客户端模块要连接的目标主机为主机B后，向主机B发起连接请求，并请求建立端口转发隧道；C、目标主机B接收到连接请求后，建立安全隧道，主机A和目标主机B通过安全隧道传输数据。所述的系统包括：一台主机，至少一台目标主机，所述主机上包括应用客户端模块和SSH安全代理模块，目标主机上包括SSH Server模块和应用服务端模块。采用上述方法与系统，可实现点到点或点到多点访问时的通讯加密。
content_en: The invention relates to a communication encrypt method and relative system, wherein said method comprises that: a, the application client module of host A sends proxy request to the local SSH safety proxy module, to request to connect target host B; b, SSH safety proxy module analyzes the proxy request, via the IP address of target host, to send connection request to host B, when obtaining the target host is host B, and request to build port transfer tunnel; c, target host B receives connection request, builds safety tunnel, host A and target host B transmit data via safety tunnel. And the system comprises a host, at least one target host, while the host comprises application client module and SSH safety proxy module; the target host comprise SSH Server module and application server module. The invention can realize point-to-point or point-to-multipoint communication encrypt.

content_cn: 一种由第一设备实现的方法，包括：估计所述第一设备与第二设备之间的侧行链路波束对应的、所述第一设备与服务接入节点之间的第一路径损耗，所述侧行链路波束被所述第一设备用于与所述第二设备进行设备到设备(device‑to‑device，D2D)传输；根据所述第一路径损耗确定所述第一设备与所述第二设备之间的用于侧行链路传输的侧行链路发射功率；根据所述侧行链路发射功率与所述第二设备进行所述侧行链路传输。
content_en: A method implemented by a first device, comprising: estimating a first path loss between the first device and a serving access node corresponding to a sidelink beam between the first device and a second device, the sidelink beam being used by the first device for device-to-device (D2D) transmission with the second device; determining sidelink transmitting power for sidelink transmission between the first equipment and the second equipment according to the first path loss; and performing the sidelink transmission with the second device according to the sidelink transmitting power.

content_cn: 本申请提供一种像素采集电路、动态视觉传感器以及图像采集设备。该像素采集电路包括：光电转换电路、模数转换电路、差分电路以及比较电路；光电转换电路，被配置为将采集到的光信号转换成模拟信号；模数转换电路，被配置为接收来自光电转换电路的模拟信号；以及，通过对模拟信号进行模数转换获得数字信号；差分电路，被配置为接收来自模数转换电路的数字信号；以及，获得上一触发时刻的数字信号与当前触发时刻的数字信号的差值信号，其中，上一触发时刻和当前触发时刻至少由数字时钟信号确定；比较电路，被配置为接收来自差分电路的差值信号，输出脉冲信号。在本申请中，利用数字元器件来实现动态视觉传感器中的像素采集电路，以减弱噪声，减少干扰，方便调试。
content_en: The invention provides a pixel acquisition circuit, a dynamic vision sensor and image acquisition equipment. The pixel acquisition circuit comprises a photoelectric conversion circuit, an analog-to-digital conversion circuit, a differential circuit and a comparison circuit, the photoelectric conversion circuit is configured to convert the acquired optical signal into an analog signal; an analog-to-digital conversion circuit configured to receive an analog signal from the photoelectric conversion circuit and performing analog-to-digital conversion on the analog signal to obtain a digital signal; a differential circuit configured to receive the digital signal from the analog-to-digital conversion circuit, and obtaining a difference signal between the digital signal at the previous triggeringmoment and the digital signal at the current triggering moment, the previous triggering moment and the current triggering moment being at least determined by a digital clock signal; and the comparison circuit configured to receive the difference signal from the differential circuit and output a pulse signal. According to the application, the pixel acquisition circuit in the dynamic vision sensoris realized by utilizing the digital components, so that the noise is weakened, the interference is reduced, and the debugging is convenient.

content_cn: 对本发明而言，气凝胶是一种已经通过溶胶-凝胶法生产的多孔材料，其中液相已经在超临界条件下从该凝胶除去。气凝胶和藻酸盐在化妆品组合物中的使用原则上由现有技术已知。气凝胶是超轻的多孔材料。最早的气凝胶由Kristler在1932年制备。它们通常经由溶胶-凝胶法在液体介质中合成并且随后干燥，通常通过用超临界流体—最常用的是超临界CO2萃取而干燥。这类干燥使得可以避免孔和材料的收缩。其他类型的干燥也使得可以由凝胶获得多孔材料，即冻干，这包括在低温下固化凝胶，然后使溶剂升华并通过蒸发干燥。如此得到的材料分别称为冻凝胶和干凝胶。
content_en: For the purposes of the present invention, an aerogel is a porous material which has been produced by a sol-gel process in which the liquid phase has been removed from the gel under supercritical conditions. The use of aerogels and alginates in cosmetic compositions in principle is known from the state of the art. Aerogels are ultra-light porous materials. The first aerogels were made by Kristler in 1932. They are generally synthesized via a sol-gel process in a liquid medium and then dried, usually by extraction with a supercritical fluid, the one most commonly used being supercritical CO2. This type of drying makes it possible to avoid shrinkage of the pores and of the material. Other types of drying also make it possible to obtain porous materials starting from gel, namely cryodesiccation, which consists in solidifying the gel at low temperature and in then subliming the solvent, and drying by evaporation. The materials thus obtained are referred to respectively as cryogels and xerogels.

content_cn: 本发明的一个目标目的是提供用于卫生用品的改良吸水性储存层，特别是用即弃尿布。用于改良吸水性储存层，可使用常规的吸水性聚合物颗粒。并且，所述改良吸水性储存层中应基本上不含纤维素纤维，并且吸水性储存层中的吸水性聚合物颗粒无论是在干燥或湿润状态都既不会滑动也不会或掉出。在本申请的上下本中，“不含纤维素纤维”意指在本发明吸水性储存层中的纤维素的含量优选少于30重量％，优先少于20重量％，更优选少于10重量％，最优选少于5重量％。理想地，根本不存在纤维素。
content_en: It was an object of the present invention to provide improved water-absorbing storage layers for hygiene articles, especially disposable diapers. For the improved water-absorbing storage layers, it should be possible to use the customary water-absorbing polymer particles. Moreover, the improved water-absorbing storage layers should be essentially free of cellulose fibers, and the water-absorbing polymer particles in the water-absorbing storage layer should neither slip nor fall out either in the dry or moist state. In the context of this application, “free of cellulose fibers” means that the cellulose content in the inventive storage layer is preferably less than 30% by weight, preferentially less than 20% by weight, more preferably less than 10% by weight, most preferably less than 5% by weight. Ideally, no cellulose at all is present.

content_cn: 在一个总的方面，一种射线照相系统包括：拍摄单元；包括按钮的操作面板，所述按钮被配置为被按压以指示拍摄单元的移动方向要被限制到特定移动方向；设在操作面板与拍摄单元之间的测量单元，并且所述测量单元被配置为测量施加到操作面板的外力的大小和方向；以及驱动单元，被配置为响应于按钮被按压、基于由测量单元测量到的外力的大小和方向而仅在特定移动方向上移动拍摄单元。驱动单元还可以被配置为响应于按钮被按压、基于由测量单元测量到的外力的大小而输出用于仅在特定移动方向上移动拍摄单元的功率。驱动单元还可以被配置为仅当按钮被按压时仅在特定移动方向上移动拍摄单元，并且响应于所按压的按钮被释放而停止拍摄单元的移动。
content_en: In one general aspect, a radiographic system includes a photographic unit; an operating panel including a button configured to be pressed to indicate that a movement direction of the photographic unit is to be limited to a specific movement direction; a measurement unit provided between the operating panel and the photographic unit and configured to measure a magnitude and a direction of an external force applied to the operating panel; and a drive unit configured to move the photographic unit only in the specific movement direction based on the magnitude and the direction of the external force measured by the measurement unit in response to the button being pressed. The drive unit may be further configured to output power for moving the photographic unit only in the specific movement direction based on the magnitude of the external force measured by the measurement unit in response to the button being pressed. The drive unit may be further configured to move the photographic unit only in the specific movement direction only while the button is pressed, and stop the movement of the photographic unit in response to the pressed button being released.

content_cn: 基本上，光拾取致动器在跟踪方向和焦点方向的两个方向上执行驱动，即两轴驱动。近年来，为了实现高密度光存储设备,物镜的数值孔径 (NA) 不断增大,导致激光光源的波长缩短。因此，光学拾取器致动器的允许倾斜方向误差幅度减小。为了弥补这一缺陷，传统的致动器除了双轴驱动（即在聚焦方向和寻轨方向上驱动）外，还采用三轴驱动的光学拾取器致动器,该致动器也沿倾斜方向驱动。具体而言，需要在光盘的径向进行驱动。这种在聚焦、寻轨和倾斜方向上均进行驱动的三轴驱动光学拾取器致动器被称为倾斜驱动光学拾取器致动器。
content_en: Basically, an optical pickup actuator drives the lens in both the tracking direction and the focusing direction, that is, two-axis driving. In recent years, a numerical aperture (NA) of the objective lens has been increased to assist in an implementation of a high-density optical storage apparatus, and consequently the wavelength of a laser light source is reduced. As such, a permissible tilting direction error margin of the optical pickup actuator is reduced. To compensate for this drawback, conventional actuators in addition to two-axis driving, that is, driving in both the focusing direction and the tracking direction, utilize a three-axis driving optical pickup actuator that is also driven in a tilt direction. In particular, driving in a radial direction of the optical disc is required. The three-axis driving optical pickup actuator that is driven in the focusing, tracking, and tilt directions is referred to as a tilt drive optical pickup actuator.

content_cn: 根据本发明构思的一方面，提供了一种存储设备，所述存储设备包括：存储器件，所述存储器件包括多个存储块；存储器控制器，所述存储器控制器被配置为控制所述存储器件，以及通过基于第一信息和第二信息执行强化学习来执行垃圾收集，所述第一信息指示所述存储器件在写入数据之前的状态，所述第二信息指示所述存储器件在写入数据之后的状态；主机接口，所述主机接口用于在主机与所述存储器控制器之间进行接口连接；以及闪存接口，所述闪存接口用于在所述存储器控制器与所述存储器件之间进行接口连接。
content_en: According to an aspect of the inventive concept, there is provided a storage device including: a memory device including a plurality of memory blocks; a memory controller configured to control the memory device and perform garbage collection by performing reinforcement learning based on first information indicating a state of the memory device before writing data and second information indicating a state of the memory device after writing data; a host interface for interfacing between a host and the memory controller; and a flash interface for interfacing between the memory controller and the memory device.

content_cn: 现在将参照图1对启动器130和响应器140的操作进行描述。首先，当使用USB(或IrDA、IEEE 1394或RS232C)将启动器130连接到响应器140时，启动器130向响应器140请求装置信息(操作S101)。响应器140将装置信息发送给启动器130(操作S102)。当启动器130请求执行OpenSession()时(操作S103)，响应器140为新会话分配各种资源，并为存储在存储器中的所有对象确定ObjectHandle(操作S103-1)。如上所述，可由响应器140提供的所有类型的文件和文件夹(例如，照片、音乐和运动图像)被识别为对象。用于ROOT(根)目录的ObjectHandle必须为0，而其余的ObjectHandle取决于执行。当启动器130请求执行GetObjectHandle()(操作S104)时，响应器140提供如上所述生成的所有对象的ObjectHandle[1至n](操作S105)。启动器130请求启动器130自身所需的对象信息(ObjectInfo)(操作S106)。响应器140提供请求的对象信息(操作S107)。启动器130检查接收的对象信息，并请求与对象信息相应的对象(操作S108)。响应器140将对象发送到启动器130。在完成各种必要的操作之后，启动器130通过调用CloseSession()关闭会话(操作S110)。
content_en: The operations of the initiator 130 and the responder 140 will now be described with reference to FIG. 1. First, when the initiator 130 is connected to the responder 140 using USB (or IrDA, IEEE 1394, or RS232C), the initiator 130 requests device information from the responder 140 (operation S101). The responder 140 transmits the device information to the initiator 130 (operation S102). When the initiator 130 requests OpenSession( ) to be executed (operation S103), the responder 140 allocates various resources for a new session, and determines ObjectHandles for all objects stored in a storage (operation S103-1). As described above, all types of files and folders (e.g., photos, music, and motion pictures) which can be provided by the responder 140 are recognized as an object. An ObjectHandle for a ROOT directory must be 0, and the rest of the ObjectHandles depend on implementation. When the indicator 130 requests GetObjectHandles( ) to be executed (operation S104), the responder 140 provides ObjectHandle[1 to n] for all objects generated as described above (operation S105). The initiator 130 requests object information (ObjectInfo) required by the initiator 130 itself (operation S106). The responder 140 provides the requested object information (operation S107). The initiator 130 checks the received object information, and requests an object corresponding to the object information (operation S108). The responder 140 transmits the object to the initiator 130. After various necessary operations are carried out, the initiator 130 closes the session by calling CloseSession( ) (operation S110).

content_cn: 在一特定实施例中，数据在第一易失性存储器设备104与非易失性存储器设备108之间按地址次序来复制。如本文所使用的，“按地址次序”复制数据意味着从易失性存储器设备复制的每一数据元素被写回易失性存储器设备中的、在禁用易失性存储器设备之前从中复制的同一位置。例如，整个第一易失性存储器设备104(例如，512MB数据映像)的数据映像(例如，快照)可被复制到非易失性存储器设备108，而不管整个DDR第一易失性存储器设备104是否正存储活跃数据(例如，系统100处的硬件组件和/或软件应用正使用的数据)。生成并复制整个第一易失性存储器设备104的数据映像可比压缩数据或只定位并复制活跃数据到非易失性存储器设备108更快。此外，因为非易失性存储器设备108的大小可显著大于第一易失性存储器设备104的大小，所以复制整个第一易失性存储器设备104的快照的存储成本可相对较小且是用户可接受的。另外，因为数据按地址次序被转移到第一易失性存储器设备104且从第一易失性存储器设备104转移，所以在睡眠模式之前使用的存储器映射(例如，虚拟地址到物理地址映射)可在退出睡眠模式之后保持有效。此外，与部分阵列自刷新(PASR)系统不同，第一易失性存储器设备104充满50％以上时的数据损失可被避免。
content_en: In a particular embodiment, data is copied between the first volatile memory device 104 and the non-volatile memory device 108 in order by address. As used herein, copying data “in order by address” means that each element of data that is copied from a volatile memory device is written back to the volatile memory device in the same location it was copied from prior to disabling the volatile memory device. For example, a data image (e.g., snapshot) of the entire first volatile memory device 104 (e.g., a 512 MB data image) may be copied to the non-volatile memory device 108, regardless of whether or not the entire DDR first volatile memory device 104 was storing active data (e.g., data that is in use by a hardware component and/or software application at the system 100). Generating and copying a data image of the entire first volatile memory device 104 may be faster than compressing data or locating and copying only the active data to the non-volatile memory device 108. Moreover, because the size of the non-volatile memory device 108 may be significantly larger than the size of the first volatile memory device 104, the storage cost of copying a snapshot of the entire first volatile memory device 104 may be relatively small and acceptable to a user. In addition, because the data is transferred to and from the first volatile memory device 104 in order by address, memory mappings (e.g., virtual address to physical address mappings) in use prior to sleep mode may remain valid after exiting sleep mode. Further, unlike partial array self refresh (PASR) systems, data loss may be avoided when the first volatile memory device 104 is more than 50% full.

content_en: One aspect provides a method for wireless communication by a user equipment. The method includes receiving scheduling information from a network entity. In some cases, the scheduling information schedules transmission of a plurality of uplink data channel repetitions in a plurality of slots according to a frequency hopping scheme that configures frequency hops between transmissions of repetitions of the plurality of uplink data channel repetitions. Additionally, in some cases, the plurality of slots comprise at least a first full duplex (FD) slot including an uplink subband and a downlink subband of a larger bandwidth part (BWP). Additionally, in some cases, the scheduling information indicates at least one starting resource block (RB) for the plurality of uplink data channel repetitions and at least one RB offset, selected from a set of RB offsets, for the plurality of uplink data channel repetitions. Additionally, the method further includes taking one or more actions related to transmitting, according to the frequency hopping scheme, the plurality of uplink data channel repetitions in the plurality of slots based on the scheduling information.

content_cn: 通常，无线多址通信系统能够同时支持多个移动设备的通信。每个移动设备可以经由前向链路和反向链路的传输与一个或多个基站通信。前向链路(或下行链路)指的是从基站到移动设备的通信链路，反向链路(或上行链路)指的是从移动设备到基站的通信链路。此外，移动设备和基站之间的通信可以通过单输入单输出(SISO)系统、多输入单输出(MISO)系统、多输入多输出(MIMO)系统等来建立。MIMO系统通常采用多付(NT)发射天线和多付(NR)接收天线进行数据传输。由NT付发射天线和NR付接收天线形成的MIMO信道可以分解成NS个独立信道，这些信道称作空间信道。NS个独立信道中的每一个都对应于一个维度。另外，如果能够利用多付发射天线和接收天线形成的另外的维度，则MIMO系统可以由此改善性能(例如，提高频谱效率、更高的吞吐量和/或更高的可靠性)。
content_en: Generally, wireless multiple-access communication systems can simultaneously support communication for multiple mobile devices. Each mobile device can communicate with one or more base stations via transmissions on forward and reverse links. The forward link (or downlink) refers to the communication link from base stations to mobile devices, and the reverse link (or uplink) refers to the communication link from mobile devices to base stations. Further, communications between mobile devices and base stations can be established via single-input single-output (SISO) systems, multiple-input single-output (MISO) systems, multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems, and so forth. MIMO systems commonly employ multiple (NT) transmit antennas and multiple (NR) receive antennas for data transmission. A MIMO channel formed by the NT transmit and NR receive antennas can be decomposed into NS independent channels, which can be referred to as spatial channels. Each of the NS independent channels corresponds to a dimension. Moreover, MIMO systems can provide improved performance (e.g., increased spectral efficiency, higher throughput and/or greater reliability) if the additional dimensionalities created by the multiple transmit and received antennas are utilized.

content_en: Referring to FIG. 1, a DAB frame 100 includes a Synchronization Channel (SCH) 102, a Fast Information Channel (FIC) 104, and a Main Service Channel (MSC) 106. The SCH 102 includes information for synchronization in decoding of the DAB frame 100. The FIC 104 includes various kinds of control information, urgent data requiring high-speed transmission, and service information. Unlike the MSC 106, since signals of the FIC 104 do not pass through a time interleaver, the FIC 104 has an advantage in that high-speed transmission is possible, but has a disadvantage in that the amount of data transmitted is limited to 32 bytes. The MSC 106 includes data for a plurality of audio services, video services, and data services. As illustrated in FIG. 1, a single DAB frame 100 includes a plurality of service channels 108, each service channel 108 including a plurality of sub-channels 110. Individual sub-channels 110 are multiplexed into the MSC 106 by independently undergoing an encoding and interleaving process.

content_cn: 无线通信系统被广泛部署以提供各种类型的通信内容，诸如语音、视频、分组数据、消息接发、广播等等。这些系统可以能够通过共享可用系统资源(例如，时间、频率和功率)来支持与多个用户的通信。此类多址系统的示例包括第四代(4G)系统(诸如长期演进(LTE)系统、高级LTE(LTE-A)系统或LTE-A Pro系统)和第五代(5G)系统(其可以被称为新空口(NR)系统)。这些系统可以采用诸如码分多址(CDMA)、时分多址(TDMA)、频分多址(FDMA)、正交频分多址(OFDMA)或离散傅里叶变换扩展正交频分复用(DFT-S-OFDM)之类的技术。无线多址通信系统可包括一个或多个基站或一个或多个网络接入节点，每个基站或网络接入节点同时支持用于多个通信设备的通信，这些通信设备可以另外被称为用户装备(UE)。
content_en: Wireless communications systems are widely deployed to provide various types of communication content such as voice, video, packet data, messaging, broadcast, and so on. These systems may be capable of supporting communication with multiple users by sharing the available system resources (e.g., time, frequency, and power). Examples of such multiple-access systems include fourth generation (4G) systems such as Long Term Evolution (LTE) systems, LTE-Advanced (LTE-A) systems, or LTE-A Pro systems, and fifth generation (5G) systems which may be referred to as New Radio (NR) systems. These systems may employ technologies such as code division multiple access (CDMA), time division multiple access (TDMA), frequency division multiple access (FDMA), orthogonal FDMA (OFDMA), or discrete Fourier transform spread orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (DFT-S-OFDM). A wireless multiple-access communications system may include one or more base stations or one or more network access nodes, each simultaneously supporting communication for multiple communication devices, which may be otherwise known as user equipment (UE).

content_cn: 摘要：本发明涉及一种改进的药物输送装置，其包括一个能够精确控制药物释放速率的机制。该装置适用于多种给药途径，并能够提高药物的生物利用度，减少副作用。 权利要求：1.一种改进的药物输送装置，包括：一个控制单元，用于调节药物释放速率；一个储液单元，用于存储药物溶液；以及一个输送组件，用于将药物输送至目标位置。 2.根据权利要求1所述的药物输送装置，其特征在于，所述控制单元包括一个微处理器和反馈传感器，以实时监测并调整药物释放。 技术领域：本发明涉及药物输送技术，特别是涉及一种能够精确控制药物释放的装置及其相关方法。 背景技术：传统的药物输送装置常常存在释放不均匀、效果不持续的问题，这可能导致患者的疗效不佳或产生不必要的副作用。因此，开发一种能够有效控制药物释放并提高治疗效果的装置显得尤为重要。 概述：本发明提供了一种新型的药物输送装置，集成了智能控制单元和多功能输送组件，能够根据患者需求自动调节药物释放速率，从而实现个性化治疗。 附图说明：图1为本发明药物输送装置的结构示意图，其中1为控制单元，2为储液单元，3为输送组件。 具体实施方式：实施例1：将药物溶液加入储液单元，通过微处理器设定所需的释放速率，装置启动后，药物将通过输送组件以稳定的速率释放至患者体内。在整个过程中，反馈传感器实时监测并调整释放速率，以确保药物浓度维持在治疗窗内。

content_cn: 摘要：本发明涉及一种用于诊断和治疗呼吸道疾病的创新性医疗装置。该装置能够实时监测患者的呼吸参数，并通过无线技术传输数据，便于医疗人员进行远程分析和诊断。 权利要求：1.一种用于呼吸道疾病诊断的医疗装置，包括：a.一呼吸传感器，用于检测患者的呼吸频率和气流量；b.一数据处理单元，与所述呼吸传感器通信，用于分析呼吸参数并生成诊断指标；c.一无线通信模块，用于将所述诊断指标传输至远程医疗平台。 技术领域：本发明属于医疗设备技术领域，尤其涉及一种用于呼吸道疾病诊断和监测的智能医疗装置。 背景技术：当前市场上的呼吸道疾病监测设备大多仅能提供基础的呼吸频率数据，缺乏综合分析和远程诊断功能，这限制了其在临床应用中的有效性。 概述：本发明旨在提供一种能够综合分析呼吸参数的医疗装置，从而提高对呼吸道疾病的诊断精度，并支持远程医护人员的诊疗决策。 附图说明：附图1示出了本发明中呼吸传感器与数据处理单元的连接结构图示；附图2为无线通信模块的数据传输示意图；附图3展示了整体装置的外观及各部件布局。 具体实施方式：实施例中，患者佩戴本发明提供的呼吸传感器，数据处理单元实时获取呼吸信息，通过内置算法分析生成多个呼吸指标。所述无线通信模块将这些指标发送至医护人员的终端设备，以便于进行进一步的临床分析和个性化治疗方案制定。数据处理单元的算法可根据不同疾病类型进行调整，支持个性化参数优化。

content_cn: 摘要：本发明涉及一种用于提高抗菌药物效果的组合物，尤其是一种包含特定比例抗生素和植物提取物的组合物。通过本发明的组合物，可以显著增强抗菌活性，并减少细菌的耐药风险。 权利要求：1. 一种抗菌组合物，包含有效量的抗生素和植物提取物，其中所述植物提取物包括绿茶多酚和迷迭香提取物。2. 根据权利要求1所述的抗菌组合物，其中绿茶多酚的浓度范围为0.5%至5%。3. 根据权利要求1所述的抗菌组合物，其中迷迭香提取物的浓度范围为0.1%至3%。4. 根据权利要求1至3中任一项所述的抗菌组合物，还包括可接受的药用载体。 技术领域：本发明涉及药学，尤其涉及一种新型抗菌药物组合物的制备及其在治疗感染性疾病中的应用。 背景技术：传统抗菌药物在临床应用中长期面临耐药性增加的问题，这对公共卫生构成严重威胁。近年来，植物提取物因其天然来源及多样的生物活性受到关注，结合使用抗生素和植物提取物成为提高药物效果的新策略。 概述：本发明提出了一种由抗生素和植物提取物组成的组合物，其通过协同作用增强抗菌效果，并有效降低传统抗生素的用量，减缓耐药性发展。研究表明，该组合物在多种细菌株上表现出良好的抑菌能力。 附图说明：附图1示出了本发明组合物在不同细菌菌株中的抑菌效果。附图2示出了组合物中各组分的协同作用实验结果。 具体实施方式：本发明的抗菌组合物通过将抗生素与植物提取物混合制备而成。在具体实施例中，将1克绿茶多酚、0.5克迷迭香提取物与98.5克抗生素混合，制成100克组合物。通过多次实验验证，该组合物在体外实验中对多种耐药菌株表现出显著的抑菌效果。

content_cn: 摘要：本发明涉及一种新型医疗设备，其能够提高诊断精度和治疗效果。该设备集成多项先进技术，可用于多种疾病的检测与治疗。 权利要求：1. 一种用于疾病诊断的医疗设备，其特征在于包括：a) 图像采集模块，用于获取目标区域的高分辨率影像；b) 数据处理单元，能够对采集的影像进行分析与处理以识别异常；c) 显示装置，用于展示分析结果并提供实时反馈。 技术领域：本发明涉及医疗技术领域，尤其涉及一种用于提高诊断精度的医疗设备。 背景技术：现有技术中，许多医疗设备在诊断过程中存在精度不足的问题，导致误诊和漏诊的风险增加。此外，现有设备在操作过程中的反馈延迟也对诊断效率产生不利影响。因此，亟需一种能够克服这些缺点的创新型设备。 概述：本发明提供了一种结合多种先进技术的医疗设备，通过改进的图像处理技术和高效的数据分析算法，提高了设备的诊断精度和处理速度，从而提高医疗机构的服务水平。 附图说明：图1为本发明医疗设备的整体结构示意图；图2为设备中图像采集模块的详细结构图；图3显示了设备的数据处理单元的工作流程。 具体实施方式：在本实施例中，设备采用高灵敏度的摄像头作为图像采集模块，能够在低光环境下获取清晰的影像。数据处理单元配备先进的AI算法，可实时分析并标注异常区域。此外，显示装置为触屏设计，操作便捷，且可实时更新分析结果。设备操作简单，适用于各类医疗机构。

content_cn: 标题：一种用于诊断心血管疾病的创新性生物传感器系统 摘要：本发明公开了一种用于诊断心血管疾病的创新性生物传感器系统，旨在提供一种更为精确且响应迅速的检测方法。该系统主要包括多个高灵敏度传感器、数据处理模块和无线通信装置。通过实时监测血液中多种生物标志物的浓度变化，系统能够对心血管疾病的早期症状进行快速分析和诊断。 权利要求：1. 一种用于诊断心血管疾病的生物传感器系统，其特征在于，包括：a) 多个配置用于检测血液中特定生物标志物的高灵敏度传感器，b) 数据处理模块，用于接收与分析传感器数据并生成健康评估报告，c) 无线通信装置，用于将健康评估报告传输至用户的便携式设备。 技术领域：本发明属于医学检测设备技术领域，特别涉及一种用于诊断和监控心血管疾病的高性能生物传感器系统。 背景技术：目前，心血管疾病已成为全球的主要健康威胁，而现有的检测方法通常需要复杂且耗时的实验室分析，无法及时提供诊断结果。随着技术的发展，对便携、快速、高效的生物传感器系统需求日益增加。 概述：本发明提供了一种新型生物传感器系统，能够快速响应并准确检测血液中多个心血管相关生物标志物，通过先进的信号处理技术提高诊断的准确性和可靠性。此外，系统的无线通信功能便于用户随时获取健康状态信息。 附图说明：图1示意性地展示了本发明生物传感器系统的结构布局；图2为系统中传感器与血液样本接触的示意图；图3描述了数据处理模块的信号处理流程。 具体实施方式：在一个实施例中，生物传感器被集成到一种智能手表中，用户只需佩戴在手腕上，即可持续监测心血管状态。传感器利用微型采样针头从皮肤下层收集微量血液样本。数据处理模块采用先进的算法，以解析生物标志物浓度的变化并评估心血管健康状况，通过蓝牙模块将结果传输至用户的智能手机，实现实时监控和预警。

content_cn: 摘要：本发明涉及一种新型的药物输送系统，尤其适用于靶向治疗。该系统具有高效、精准、低毒副作用等优点，能够显著提高药物的治疗效果。 权利要求：1. 一种用于靶向治疗的药物输送系统，其特征在于包含：（a）纳米颗粒载体，所述载体能够通过生物相容性聚合物修饰以提高稳定性；（b）药物活性成分，所述成分通过化学结合方式连接至载体表面；（c）靶向配体，所述配体特异性识别并结合目标细胞。 技术领域：本发明属于生物医学工程技术领域，涉及药物输送系统的开发与应用，具体涉及通过纳米技术实现的靶向药物递送方法。 背景技术：传统的药物治疗方法通常存在药物生物利用度低、副作用大、缺乏细胞特异性等问题。近年来，随着纳米技术的发展，研究人员不断探索纳米颗粒在药物递送领域的应用潜力，试图通过纳米载体实现药物的精准递送，从而提高治疗效果。 概述：本发明旨在解决现有技术中的不足，提供一种新型的纳米颗粒药物输送系统，该系统能够通过靶向配体的识别作用，实现药物的精准递送，减少对非目标细胞的影响。 附图说明：图1示出了本发明药物输送系统的结构示意图。图2示出了纳米颗粒载体的制备工艺流程图。图3示出了靶向配体与目标细胞结合的示意图。 具体实施方式：实施例1中，通过聚乳酸-羟基乙酸共聚物（PLGA）作为载体材料，采用乳化-溶剂挥发法制备纳米颗粒。通过羧基活化将抗体作为靶向配体连接到颗粒表面，并负载抗癌药物阿霉素。体外细胞实验中，该系统显示了对肿瘤细胞的高效识别和抑制作用。

content_cn: 摘要：本发明涉及一种用于提高患者诊断准确率的医学成像系统，具体包括高分辨率成像设备和图像处理软件。该系统能够提供多模态成像，并结合人工智能技术对图像进行分析，从而提高早期疾病检测的准确性。 权利要求：1. 一种医学成像系统，包括：a) 高分辨率成像设备，用于获取患者目标区域的多模态图像；b) 图像处理软件，用于分析所述多模态图像并生成诊断报告。2. 根据权利要求1所述的系统，其中图像处理软件配置为利用人工智能算法进行病变区域的自动识别和标记。 技术领域：本发明涉及医学成像技术领域，尤其涉及一种结合多模态成像与人工智能分析的医学诊断系统。 背景技术：随着疾病谱的改变，早期诊断变得尤为重要。然而，现有的成像设备在分辨率和准确性方面存在一定的局限性，且传统的图像分析依赖于医生的经验，存在主观性和误判的风险。 概述：本发明提出了一种创新的医学成像系统，结合高分辨率成像技术与先进的人工智能分析方法，从而克服现有技术中的上述缺点，提高了临床诊断的准确性和效率。 附图说明：附图1是本发明医学成像系统的总体结构图；附图2是图像处理软件分析流程示意图。 具体实施方式：在一个优选实施方案中，本发明的医学成像系统包括一个高分辨率的磁共振成像设备，能够获取不同层面的图像数据。所述图像通过传输模块输入至图像处理软件，软件对图像进行预处理，利用卷积神经网络对目标区域进行分析，自动识别出可能的病变区域并生成详细的诊断报告，供医生参考。

content_cn: 摘要：本专利涉及一种新型医用设备，旨在提高手术过程中对重要器官的保护。该设备结合了传感技术和智能算法，能够实时监控手术区域并提供即时反馈，以确保手术的安全性与有效性。 权利要求：1.一种新型医用设备，其特征在于包括一传感模块和一智能处理单元，所述传感模块用于收集手术区域内的实时数据；2.如权利要求1所述的设备，其中所述智能处理单元能够分析所述实时数据并提供即时操作建议。技术领域：本发明涉及医学领域，特别是涉及一种能够提升外科手术精确度和安全性的医用设备。背景技术：近年来，随着外科手术的复杂性增加，术中对重要器官的保护变得尤为重要。然而，现有技术中缺乏一种能够实时监控并提供即时反馈的设备，导致手术风险增加。概述：本专利提供一种新型医用设备，通过传感技术与智能算法的结合，实现对手术区域的实时监控，并提供操作决策支持，从而提升手术安全性。附图说明：图1示出了本发明所述设备的结构示意图；图2为本设备在手术中应用的流程图；图3显示了传感模块与智能处理单元的交互示意图。具体实施方式：本实施例中，设备被应用于腹腔镜手术中，传感模块安装于手术器械上，能够实时采集术中参数数据，智能处理单元则依据预设算法分析数据，并在显示屏上提示最佳操作路径，确保手术精确进行。

content_cn: 摘要：本发明涉及一种用于治疗特定疾病的药物组合物及其制备方法。该组合物通过创新的活性成分配比，实现了显著的治疗效果，适用于多种病症的综合治疗，并具有良好的安全性和耐受性。 权利要求：1. 一种药物组合物，其特征在于包含以下组分：a) 有效剂量的第一药物，b) 有效剂量的第二药物，以及c) 适量的药学上可接受的载体。2. 根据权利要求1所述的药物组合物，其中所述第一药物为XXX，所述第二药物为YYY。3. 根据权利要求1或2所述的药物组合物，其中所述载体包括增溶剂及稳定剂。 技术领域：本发明涉及制药领域，特别是涉及一种用于治疗XX疾病的组合物及其制备方法。 背景技术：现有技术中，针对XX疾病的治疗方案多种多样，但常需长期用药，且副作用较为明显。此外，单一药物的治疗效果往往有限，难以满足患者的临床需求。 概述：本发明提供了一种新的药物组合物，通过合理的药物配伍，能够在提高疗效的同时减少不良反应。这一创新不仅提高了药物的综合治疗能力，还为临床应用提供了新的选择。 附图说明：图1为本发明药物组合物的制备流程示意图。图2为实施例中药物组合物对XX疾病模型的疗效曲线图。 具体实施方式：实施例1：将第一药物XXX和第二药物YYY按1:1的重量比溶解于生理盐水中，加入适量的增溶剂ZZZ，搅拌均匀，分装于无菌容器中，得药物组合物。本实施例中，组合物在XX动物模型中显示出显著的疗效，治疗过程中未见明显副作用。

content_cn: 摘要: 本发明涉及一种新型的医疗装置，用于提高手术过程中的精准度和安全性。该装置结合了先进的成像技术和机器人操作系统，能够实时监控和调整手术参数，从而改善手术效果并减少术后并发症的发生。 权利要求: 1.一种用于辅助手术的医疗装置，包括: a.成像模块，用于获取实时手术图像; b.控制模块，与成像模块通信，用于分析图像数据并生成手术指令; c.机器人操作模块，响应控制模块生成的指令，执行手术操作。 技术领域: 本发明属于医疗器械技术领域，具体涉及一种用于手术过程的智能辅助装置。 背景技术: 传统的外科手术依赖于医生的经验和手工操作，容易受到人体因素的影响，存在一定的风险。近年来，机器人技术的发展为提高手术的稳定性和精准性提供了新的可能。然而，现有的手术机器人系统在某些复杂情况下仍然存在不足之处。 概述: 本发明提供了一种结合成像技术和机器人操作的医疗装置，它能够通过实时图像分析和自动控制系统，实现对手术过程的精准操控。该装置旨在解决现有技术中的不足，提高手术的安全性和效果。 附图说明: 图1是本发明所述医疗装置的结构示意图; 图2是成像模块的工作流程图; 图3是控制模块的信息处理流程图; 图4是机器人操作模块的执行示意图。 具体实施方式: 在一个优选实施例中，本发明的医疗装置通过成像模块获取手术区域的实时三维图像，控制模块对这些图像进行分析，识别出手术位置和目标结构，并生成最优手术路径。机器人操作模块依据控制模块的指令进行导航和操作，实现精准的外科干预。系统还包括一个反馈模块，用于收集实时数据并对手术过程进行动态调整，以确保最佳的手术效果。

content_cn: 摘要：本发明涉及一种新型电流传感器，用于精确测量电流值。该传感器通过使用集成的磁场检测组件和数字信号处理器，实现对电流信号的高精度采集和处理，具有响应速度快、灵敏度高的优点。 权利要求：1. 一种用于电流测量的传感装置，包含：一个磁场感应组件，用于检测电流产生的磁场；一个放大电路，将磁场感应组件的输出信号放大；以及一个数字信号处理器，与放大电路连接，用于对放大后的信号进行处理和输出。2. 如权利要求1所述的传感装置，其特征在于，所述磁场感应组件为霍尔效应传感器。3. 如权利要求1所述的传感装置，其特征在于，所述数字信号处理器能够通过软件校准补偿温度漂移。 技术领域：本发明涉及电学测量设备领域，尤其涉及一种新型电流传感器设备，适用于工业和家用电气设备中的电流检测。 背景技术：现有电流传感器大多存在体积大、成本高、测量精度低等问题，无法满足现代电子产品小型化和精密化的要求。因此，亟需开发一种具备高精度、高灵敏度的新型电流传感器以满足市场需求。 概述：本发明提供了一种采用先进磁场感应技术和数字信号处理技术的电流传感器，通过对传统传感器技术的改进，实现了更高的测量精度和稳定性，并具有更小的体积和更低的成本。 附图说明：图1为本发明电流传感器的结构示意图，示出了主要部件的布局和连接方式。图2为数字信号处理过程的流程图，展示了信号放大、数字化及输出的步骤。 具体实施方式：实施例中，本发明电流传感器包含一个霍尔效应传感器，该传感器安装在被测电流导体的侧面，通过检测导体周围的磁场绕组变化检测电流。转化后的电信号经放大电路放大，并通过模数转换器进入数字信号处理器。在处理器中，信号经过滤波、校准等处理后，输出精确的电流值。本发明实施例使得电流传感器具备高精度、高速响应的特点，适用于多种复杂电流环境下的测量。

content_cn: 摘要：本发明涉及一种用于提高电力传输效率的电学装置。具体而言，该装置通过改进的导电材料和新颖的结构设计，显著降低了电能传输过程中的损耗。装置还集成了一种高效的热管理系统，确保设备在各种操作条件下的稳定性能。基于此，发明提供了一种在电力输送中具有潜在经济效益的解决方案。 权利要求：1.一种电力传输装置，包括：a.导电元件，其由高导电材料制成，用于在传输过程中最大限度地减少电能损耗；b.散热系统，能够有效地管理和散发在传输过程中产生的热量；c.绝缘保护层，覆盖导电元件并提供必要的电气和热保护。2.根据权利要求1所述的装置，其中所述导电元件采用优化的几何结构，以进一步提高传输效率。 技术领域：本发明属于电学技术领域，尤其涉及一种新型电力传输系统，用于提升电能输送过程中的效率和稳定性。 背景技术：传统的电力传输系统在能量损耗和热管理上常面临诸多挑战，尤其在长距离输电中，电能损失显著增加。当前市场上的一些解决方案无法同时兼顾导电性、散热性和耐用性。 概述：本发明提供了一种改进的电力传输装置，通过使用先进的材料和设计优化，解决了传统系统在传输效率和热管理上的不足。该装置可以更好地适应现代电力网络对于高效、可靠输电系统的需求，并具有广泛的应用前景。 附图说明：图1为本发明电力传输装置的示意图；图2为该装置中导电元件的结构细节；图3为热管理系统的工作示意图；图4为装置的安装示例图。 具体实施方式：参阅图1，本发明的电力传输装置包括主要的导电元件1、散热系统2和绝缘保护层3。导电元件1由新型高导电材料制成，其几何结构经过优化以减少损耗。散热系统2包括多个热导管和散热片，能够有效降低装置的工作温度。绝缘保护层3则用以保护导电元件免受外部环境影响，同时确保装置的电气安全。

content_cn: 摘要：本发明涉及一种用于提高电路板散热效率的创新型电路设计。通过优化电路板的线路布局和材料选用，以提高电路板在高负载运行下的散热性能，从而延长设备的使用寿命并提高其可靠性。 权利要求： 1. 一种电路板，其特征在于包括：至少一层热导材料用于有效传导热量； 2. 根据权利要求1所述的电路板，其中所述热导材料为高导热性的金属合金； 3. 根据权利要求1所述的电路板，还包括多个通孔，以增强空气流通效果。 技术领域：本发明涉及电子工程技术领域，特别是涉及一种能够有效提高电路板散热性能的设计技术。 背景技术：目前，随着电子设备功能的不断增强，电路板的发热问题日益严重。传统的散热手段无法满足现代高密度电路板的散热需求，因此，迫切需要一种改进的技术来解决这一问题。 概述：为了应对上述挑战，本发明提出了一种创新的电路设计，通过使用先进的热导材料和独特的结构设计，显著提升电路板的散热能力，为电子设备的稳定运行提供保障。 附图说明：图1为本发明实施例中电路板的结构示意图；图2为本发明实施例中热导材料在电路板上的应用示意图。 具体实施方式：在一个实施例中，电路板的基板材料采用纯铝，以其优异的导热性能为基础，然后在电路板的关键发热区域植入铜导热片，进一步增强热量传导效率。同时，优化电路板的布局设计，确保每个组件的热量能够迅速传导到散热通道。

content_cn: 摘要：本发明涉及一种用于提高电力系统稳定性的新型电网控制装置及其方法，该装置通过智能化监测和调节技术，实现电网运行的实时优化和故障快速响应，从而提升整体电力系统的安全性和可靠性。 权利要求：1. 一种电网控制装置，包括：a. 多参数传感模块，用于实时采集电网运行状态数据；b. 数据处理单元，连接所述多参数传感模块，用于分析和评估电网状态；c. 控制决策模块，连接所述数据处理单元，用于根据所述数据生成控制策略指令；d. 执行单元，连接所述控制决策模块，用于执行所述控制策略指令以调整电网运行参数。 技术领域：本发明涉及电力工程技术领域，特别是涉及一种增强电网稳定性和故障响应能力的控制系统和方法。 背景技术：传统的电网控制系统由于依赖于固定参数设置，难以适应现代电力系统中日益复杂的动态变化和突发事件，导致电网存在较大的安全隐患和稳定性挑战。因此，亟需一种智能化的电网控制装置以适应当前及未来电网的复杂需求。 概述：为解决现有技术中存在的问题，本发明提供了一种能够智能识别电网状态变化并进行实时调整的电网控制装置。该装置集成多种传感、处理、决策和执行功能，能够迅速响应电网故障并采取适当的控制措施，从而有效提高电网的稳定性与安全性。 附图说明：图1示出了本发明所述电网控制装置的系统架构图；图2示出了控制决策模块的内部工作流程图；图3示出了执行单元的操作示意图。 具体实施方式：实施例中，所述电网控制装置的多参数传感模块包括电压传感器、电流传感器和频率传感器，实时监测电网的运行状态数据。数据处理单元采用先进的神经网络算法，对所采集的数据进行快速分析，以生成电网状态的实时评估报告。控制决策模块基于预设的优化算法和评估报告，计算出最佳的控制策略，并通过执行单元及时调整电网的运行参数，包括负载分布、发电机输出等，从而确保电网的稳定运行和高效能耗管理。

content_cn: 摘要: 本发明涉及一种新型电流转换装置，旨在提高电流转换的精度和效率。该装置通过集成的控制模块自动调整输入电流，并通过优化的转换电路实现高效输出，适用于多种工业应用场景。 权利要求: 1.一种电流转换装置，包括: a.输入接口，用于接收输入电流; b.控制模块，与输入接口相连，用于检测输入电流参数并自动调整; c.转换电路，与控制模块相连，用于将调整后的电流转换为所需输出电流; d.输出接口，与转换电路相连，用于输出转换后的电流。 2.根据权利要求1所述的电流转换装置，其中控制模块包括一个微处理器，能够实时监控输入电流参数并自适应调节转换电路的输出。 3.根据权利要求1所述的电流转换装置，其中转换电路包括至少一个变压器和多个电感线圈，以确保高效的电流转换。 技术领域: 本发明属于电学技术领域，具体涉及一种用于工业设备的高精度电流转换装置。 背景技术: 随着工业自动化进程的加速，各类设备对电流转换装置的需求日益增加。传统的电流转换装置通常存在转换效率低、输出精度不高的问题，难以满足现代工业应用的要求。因此，迫切需要一种能够提供高精度、高效率电流转换的装置。 概述: 本发明提供了一种新型电流转换装置，通过集成先进的控制模块和优化设计的转换电路，实现了高效电流转换。该装置能够在不同输入电流条件下稳定运行，并提供稳定的输出电流，大幅度提高了工业应用中的电流转换效率。 附图说明: 图1是本发明电流转换装置的结构示意图。 图2是本发明中控制模块与转换电路连接关系的示意图。 具体实施方式: 如图1所示，本发明的电流转换装置包括输入接口、控制模块、转换电路和输出接口。输入接口用于接收来自电源的输入电流，并传递给控制模块。控制模块包括一个微处理器，用于检测输入电流的参数，自动调节电流的输入信号，确保其在可控范围内。转换电路采用高效变压器和多组电感线圈的组合设计，能够在控制模块的指令下，将输入电流高效地转换为所需的输出电流。输出接口则将转换后的电流传递给后续设备使用。通过这样的一种设计，本发明的电流转换装置能够在广泛的工业应用中实现电流高效转换。

content_cn: 摘要：本发明公开了一种智能电能管理系统，旨在提高电力传输和使用的效率。该系统包括数据采集模块、分析模块和控制模块，其中数据采集模块用于实时收集电网的运行数据，分析模块利用机器学习算法对数据进行处理与优化，控制模块根据分析结果对电力的分配进行智能调度。通过应用本发明，可以显著降低电能损耗，提高电力资源的利用效率。 权利要求：一种智能电能管理系统，包括： 1.数据采集模块，用于收集包括但不限于电压、电流、功率等电网参数； 2.分析模块，连接至数据采集模块，配置为对收集的数据进行分析和建模，以预测电力需求并优化电网运行； 3.控制模块，连接至分析模块，配置为基于分析结果自动调整电力分配方案，以实现电力资源的最优利用。 技术领域：本发明涉及电力工程领域，尤其涉及一种适用于智能电网的电能管理系统。 背景技术：目前，在传统电网系统中，电力的分配和调度通常依赖于人工经验和预设的固定策略，无法动态响应实际的电力需求变化，导致电能浪费和资源分配不均的问题。随着电力需求的日益增加，亟需一种更为智能化的管理系统以提高电网运行效率。 概述：本发明的目的在于提供一种新型的电能管理系统，能够通过实时数据分析和机器学习算法实现电力的智能调度，从而减少能源浪费，提高电力利用率。 附图说明：图1是本发明所述智能电能管理系统的结构示意图。图2是本发明中数据采集模块的工作流程图。 具体实施方式：在一实施例中，数据采集模块由多个传感器单元组成，分布在电网的不同节点，用于监测电流、电压等参数。分析模块采用基于历史数据的回归模型，对未来的电力需求进行预测，并输出
